zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 面向真实工程师的 AI 代理技能集
zh.what: 这是一套由资深工程师设计的 AI 代理技能（skills），旨在帮助开发者进行真正的工程开发，而非简单的“氛围编码”。它提供可组合、易定制的小型技能模块，适用于任何模型，并支持通过 skills.sh 或 Claude Code 插件安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个可选的技能模块（如 /triage、/setup-matt-pocock-skills 等），以及一个快速安装脚本和 Claude Code 插件配置。用户通过 npx 命令选择安装，并运行设置向导完成配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Shell 脚本和 Node.js（npx），可选集成 Claude Code 插件。依赖 skills.sh 生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 18.6 万+ Star 和每日 2251 新增，该项目因解决 AI 编程中“真实工程”痛点而爆火，提供比 GSD、BMAD 等更可控、可定制的方案。
uses: 专业开发者 —— 希望用 AI 辅助真实工程开发，而非简单代码生成
AI 代理用户 —— 使用 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的工程师，需要结构化技能集
技术团队 —— 统一团队 AI 工作流，提升代码质量和可维护性

en.tag: AI agent skills for real engineers
en.what: A set of AI agent skills designed by a senior engineer for real engineering work, not vibe coding. It offers small, composable, and customizable skill modules that work with any model, installable via skills.sh or as a Claude Code plugin.
en.content: The repo contains multiple optional skill modules (e.g., /triage, /setup-matt-pocock-skills), a quick install script, and a Claude Code plugin configuration. Users select skills via npx and run a setup wizard to configure.
en.stack: Built on Shell scripts and Node.js (npx), with optional Claude Code plugin integration. Depends on the skills.sh ecosystem.
en.hot: With 186k+ stars and 2251 daily additions, this project exploded by addressing the pain point of 'real engineering' in AI coding, offering a more controllable and customizable alternative to GSD, BMAD, etc.
uses: Professional developers — who want AI to assist real engineering, not just code generation
AI agent users — engineers using Claude Code, Codex, etc., needing structured skill sets
Tech teams — to standardize AI workflows and improve code quality and maintainability

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的一套技能框架与软件开发方法论
zh.what: Superpowers 是一套完整的软件开发方法论，基于一组可组合的技能和初始指令，让编码代理在开发时自动遵循。它强调先明确需求、制定规范，再通过子代理驱动开发，实现真正的红绿 TDD、YAGNI 和 DRY 原则。
zh.content: 仓库包含方法论文档、可组合的技能定义、安装指南（支持多种代理如 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等），以及社区和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本，作为技能框架与代理无关，可适配多种编码代理工具。
zh.hot: Star 数高达 27.4 万，今日新增 557，因其提供了一套即插即用的代理开发方法论，大幅提升编码代理的自主性和代码质量，契合当前 AI 编程热潮。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编码工具的开发者，希望提升代理开发效率和质量
团队或企业，需要标准化 AI 辅助开发流程，确保代码规范与测试覆盖
对 AI 代理开发方法论感兴趣的技术爱好者，想了解前沿的 agentic 开发实践

en.tag: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology for coding agents
en.what: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills and initial instructions. It emphasizes spec-first development, subagent-driven implementation, and true red/green TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles.
en.content: The repo contains methodology docs, composable skill definitions, installation guides for multiple harnesses (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, etc.), and community/contributing guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily Shell scripts, agent-agnostic, adaptable to various coding agent harnesses.
en.hot: With 274k stars and +557 today, it's hot because it offers a plug-and-play methodology that boosts coding agent autonomy and code quality, riding the AI coding wave.
uses: Developers using AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, seeking to improve agent productivity and quality
Teams/enterprises needing standardized AI-assisted development workflows with code standards and test coverage
Tech enthusiasts interested in agentic development methodologies and cutting-edge practices

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与精选插件集
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方发布的插件仓库，包含插件规范（manifest 格式）和一系列官方/第三方插件，覆盖代码审查、文档可视化、CLI 设计、Gmail/Drive 集成等场景。每个插件独立成目录，通过 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 声明。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件一个文件夹，如 continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、pr-review-canvas、orchestrate 等，另有 third_party 目录存放 Gmail、Google Drive 等第三方集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Cursor SDK（@cursor/sdk），插件通过 plugin.json 清单定义，可能涉及 MCP、CLI 工具等。
zh.hot: Cursor 作为 AI 编辑器热度极高，官方插件仓库是生态扩展的关键入口，今日新增 27 星，总星数 2645，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 7 名，开发者关注如何用插件增强 AI 代理工作流。
uses: Cursor 用户：安装官方插件提升代码审查、文档浏览等效率
插件开发者：参考规范与示例创建自己的 Cursor 插件
团队协作：利用 Team Kit、Orchestrate 等插件优化 CI/CD 和并行任务处理

en.tag: Official Cursor plugin spec and curated plugins
en.what: This is the official Cursor plugin repository, containing the plugin specification (manifest format) and a collection of first-party and third-party plugins for code review, docs visualization, CLI design, Gmail/Drive integration, and more. Each plugin lives in its own directory with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest.
en.content: Each plugin is a standalone folder at the repo root, e.g., continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, pr-review-canvas, orchestrate, plus a third_party directory for Gmail, Google Drive, etc.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on the Cursor SDK (@cursor/sdk), plugins defined via plugin.json manifests, may involve MCP, CLI tools, etc.
en.hot: Cursor is a hot AI editor, and this official plugin repo is a key entry point for ecosystem expansion. With +27 stars today and 2,645 total, it ranks #7 on the TypeScript daily trending list, drawing developers interested in enhancing AI agent workflows via plugins.
uses: Cursor users: install official plugins to boost code review and docs navigation
Plugin developers: reference the spec and examples to create your own plugins
Teams: leverage Team Kit, Orchestrate, etc. to streamline CI/CD and parallel task handling

zh.tag: 开源 AI 求职代理：扫描职位、评分、定制简历、跟踪申请
zh.what: career-ops 是一个开源 AI 求职系统，运行在本地 AI 编码 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode）中。它自动扫描招聘网站，用 A-F 评分标准将职位评为 1.0-5.0 分，定制简历并跟踪申请进度。作者称其为“多代理求职系统”，旨在让求职者用 AI 选择公司，而非被公司 AI 筛选。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的文档（多语言 README）、演示 GIF、媒体提及（WIRED、Business Insider）以及核心代码。它支持多语言界面，并集成了 Product Hunt 和 Trendshift 徽章。核心功能包括职位扫描、评分、简历定制和申请跟踪，全部在本地 CLI 环境中运行。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，依赖 AI 编码 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode）作为运行时。它可能使用 AI 模型进行职位评估和简历定制，但具体依赖未在摘要中明确。
zh.hot: 6.4 万星标，今日新增 218，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 7。它解决了求职痛点，作者声称评估了 740+ 职位、生成了 100+ 定制简历并成功入职，加上媒体（WIRED、Business Insider）报道，引发共鸣。
uses: 求职者：自动化扫描职位、评分和定制简历，节省时间
开发者：在本地 CLI 中集成 AI 求职工具，可自定义评分标准
AI 爱好者：学习如何构建多代理系统，用于实际场景

en.tag: Open-source AI job search agent: scan, score, tailor, track — locally in your coding CLI
en.what: career-ops is an open-source AI job search system that runs locally in your AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc.). It scans job portals, evaluates listings with a structured A-F rubric into a 1.0-5.0 score, tailors your CV, and tracks applications. The author calls it a 'multi-agent job search system' to let candidates use AI to choose companies, rather than being filtered by company AI.
en.content: The repo includes comprehensive docs (multi-language README), demo GIF, press mentions (WIRED, Business Insider), and core code. It supports multiple languages and integrates Product Hunt and Trendshift badges. Core features include job scanning, scoring, CV tailoring, and application tracking, all running locally in the CLI environment.
en.stack: Primary language is JavaScript, and it relies on AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) as the runtime. It likely uses AI models for job evaluation and CV tailoring, but specific dependencies are not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: With 64.6k stars and +218 today, it ranks #7 on GitHub Trending daily. It addresses job search pain points; the author claims 740+ listings evaluated, 100+ tailored CVs, and a dream role landed, plus media coverage (WIRED, Business Insider), driving its popularity.
uses: Job seekers: automate job scanning, scoring, and CV tailoring to save time
Developers: integrate AI job search tools in local CLI, customizable scoring rubric
AI enthusiasts: learn to build multi-agent systems for real-world use cases

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供长期记忆，跨工具无缝交接
zh.what: ai-memory 是一个 Rust 编写的解决方案，为 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编码代理提供长期记忆。它能在你中途退出一个代理后，用另一个代理在相同目录继续工作，无需重新解释架构、失败尝试或未决问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档（如 macOS 和 Windows 指南）、Docker 镜像发布配置，以及支持矩阵。提供原生二进制和安装脚本，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows（WSL2 和实验性原生）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 1.95+，通过 MCP（Model Context Protocol）与代理集成，并利用生命周期钩子（lifecycle hooks）捕获会话信息。支持多种代理的配置格式。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，跨工具切换的痛点日益凸显。该项目精准解决了长期记忆缺失的问题，上线不久即获 3597 星，今日新增 332 星，位列日榜第 7。
uses: 频繁切换 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code 和 Codex）的开发者，希望保留上下文
团队协作中需要交接编码任务，确保新代理快速了解项目状态
使用 Linux/macOS 或 WSL2 环境，追求高效编码工作流的开发者

en.tag: Long-term memory for AI coding agents, enabling seamless handoff across tools
en.what: ai-memory is a Rust-based solution that provides long-term memory for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It lets you quit one agent mid-task and start another in the same directory, continuing without re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches, or open questions.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, documentation (e.g., macOS and Windows guides), Docker image release config, and a support matrix. It provides native binaries and install scripts for Linux, macOS, and Windows (WSL2 and experimental native).
en.stack: Primarily Rust 1.95+, integrates with agents via MCP (Model Context Protocol) and lifecycle hooks to capture session info. Supports configuration formats for multiple agents.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, the pain point of switching between tools becomes prominent. This project precisely addresses the lack of long-term memory, gaining 3597 stars shortly after launch, with 332 stars today, ranking 7th on the daily trend.
uses: Developers who frequently switch between AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code and Codex) and want to retain context
Teams that need to hand off coding tasks, ensuring new agents quickly understand project state
Developers on Linux/macOS or WSL2 seeking efficient coding workflows

zh.tag: 一键生成高清短视频的AI自动化工具
zh.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据用户提供的主题或关键词，自动生成视频脚本、匹配素材、生成字幕和背景音乐，并合成高清短视频的一站式工具。用户只需输入一个主题或关键词，即可获得完整的短视频成品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 源代码、WebUI 界面、API 接口、文档和示例，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。提供 WebUI 和 API 两种交互方式，方便用户通过图形界面或程序化调用生成视频。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，依赖 AI 大模型（如 Kimi K3）进行文案生成和素材匹配，使用自动化工作流整合视频合成、字幕和背景音乐生成。
zh.hot: 凭借 10 万+ Star 和今日新增 470 星，它成为 GitHub Python 趋势榜第 13 名，因其极大降低了短视频创作门槛，让任何人都能快速生成专业级视频，满足了内容创作者和营销人员的强烈需求。
uses: 内容创作者：快速生成短视频素材，提升内容产出效率。
营销人员：根据产品关键词自动生成宣传视频，用于社交媒体推广。
教育工作者：将知识点转化为生动的视频讲解，辅助教学。
开发者：通过 API 集成到自己的应用或工作流中，实现自动化视频生成。

en.tag: One-click AI tool to auto-generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword
en.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an all-in-one AI tool that leverages large language models and automated workflows to generate HD short videos from a user-provided topic or keyword. It automatically creates the script, matches stock footage, generates subtitles and background music, and composes the final video.
en.content: The repository contains full Python source code, a WebUI, API endpoints, documentation, and examples, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It offers both a graphical WebUI and an API for programmatic video generation.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.11+, it relies on AI LLMs (e.g., Kimi K3) for script writing and material matching, and uses automated workflows to integrate video composition, subtitles, and background music generation.
en.hot: With over 100k stars and 470 new stars today, it ranks #13 on GitHub Trending (Python). Its popularity stems from dramatically lowering the barrier to short-video creation, enabling anyone to quickly produce professional-looking videos, meeting the strong demand from content creators and marketers.
uses: Content creators: Quickly generate short video material to boost output efficiency.
Marketers: Auto-generate promotional videos from product keywords for social media campaigns.
Educators: Turn knowledge points into engaging video explanations to aid teaching.
Developers: Integrate via API into their own apps or workflows for automated video generation.

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 3，今日新增 26 颗星，总星数达 1270。其核心卖点——亚秒级挂起/恢复和高密度多路复用——解决了 Agent 部署中的关键痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要大规模运行 AI Agent 的团队，希望降低基础设施成本并提高资源利用率
构建 Agent 编排平台的开发者，需要底层生命周期管理和流量路由
从事强化学习（RL）场景的工程师，需要统一管理 Agent、推理和训练基础设施

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments

zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers 等，支持 OpenAI、Hugging Face 等模型接口，并集成 NetworkX 等图处理库。

uses: 开发者：快速集成 RAG 能力到应用中
研究人员：作为 RAG 算法实验的基线
企业：构建知识库问答系统，降低开发成本

en.tag: Simple and fast retrieval-augmented generation framework
en.what: LightRAG is a lightweight and efficient retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework designed to simplify the construction and deployment of RAG systems. It uses graph-based indexing and hybrid retrieval strategies to improve answer quality and speed for knowledge-intensive tasks.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, providing APIs, CLI tools, and a web demo, with support for multiple LLM backends, along with detailed documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10, relies on PyTorch, Transformers, etc., supports OpenAI, Hugging Face model APIs, and integrates graph processing libraries like NetworkX.
en.hot: With its simplicity and high performance, LightRAG has gained nearly 40k stars on GitHub, becoming a popular choice in the RAG field.
uses: Developers: quickly integrate RAG capabilities into applications
Researchers: use as a baseline for RAG algorithm experiments
Enterprises: build knowledge base Q&A systems with reduced development cost

zh.tag: 用 OpenStreetMap 数据绘制精美地图的 Python 库
zh.what: prettymaps 是一个极简的 Python 库，利用 OpenStreetMap 数据绘制定制化地图。它基于 osmnx、matplotlib、shapely 和 vsketch 构建，能够生成风格化、艺术感强的地图图像。
zh.content: 仓库包含库的源代码、文档、教程（marimo 笔记本）、Colab 演示以及示例图片。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+，依赖 osmnx、matplotlib、shapely、vsketch。
zh.hot: 因其能轻松生成美观的地图而广受欢迎，在 Hacker News 上被报道，并拥有专门的 subreddit。今日新增 63 星，总星数达 13112，位列日榜第 12 名。
uses: 数据可视化爱好者：快速生成艺术风格的地图用于展示或分享。
城市规划与地理分析：可视化城市街道网络和地理特征。
教育工作者：用于地理或编程教学中的地图绘制示例。

en.tag: A minimal Python library to draw customized maps from OpenStreetMap data
en.what: prettymaps is a minimal Python library for drawing customized maps from OpenStreetMap data. Built on osmnx, matplotlib, shapely, and vsketch, it generates stylized, artistic map images.
en.content: The repository contains the library's source code, documentation, a tutorial (marimo notebook), Colab demo, and example images.
en.stack: Python 3.11+, with dependencies on osmnx, matplotlib, shapely, and vsketch.
en.hot: Popular for its ability to easily create beautiful maps, featured on Hacker News and with a dedicated subreddit. Gained 63 stars today, reaching 13112 total, ranking 12th on the daily trending list.
uses: Data visualization enthusiasts: quickly generate artistic maps for display or sharing.
Urban planning and geographic analysis: visualize street networks and geographic features.
Educators: use as examples for map drawing in geography or programming courses.

zh.tag: 实时语音与多模态 AI 代理的开源框架
zh.what: Pipecat 是一个用于构建实时语音和多模态对话代理的 Python 框架。它支持构建单个语音代理或完整的多代理系统，其中专家代理可以交接、并行扩展，并通过共享总线进行协调，支持本地或分布式部署。该框架简化了音频/视频、AI 服务、传输和对话管道的编排。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、客户端 SDK（JavaScript、React、React Native、Swift、Kotlin、C++）、文档、示例和测试。提供 `pipecat init quickstart` 命令快速启动项目。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，支持多种 AI 服务（语音识别、文本转语音等），使用 WebSockets 或 WebRTC 进行实时传输，并支持多代理编排。
zh.hot: 随着实时 AI 代理需求的增长，Pipecat 提供了灵活、可组合的框架，吸引了大量开发者。其 14k+ 星标和持续增长（今日 +41）表明社区活跃，且被 Daily 维护，可信度高。
uses: 开发者构建语音助手、多代理系统或 AI 伴侣等实时对话应用
需要低延迟语音交互的客户服务、支持机器人等业务场景
研究人员或爱好者探索多模态 AI 交互与编排

en.tag: Open-source framework for real-time voice & multimodal AI agents
en.what: Pipecat is a Python framework for building real-time voice and multimodal conversational agents. It enables building single voice agents or full multi-agent systems where specialists hand off, fan out in parallel, and coordinate over a shared bus, locally or distributed. It simplifies orchestrating audio/video, AI services, transports, and conversation pipelines.
en.content: The repo contains the core Python library, client SDKs (JavaScript, React, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, C++), documentation, examples, and tests. It offers a `pipecat init quickstart` command for quick project setup.
en.stack: Built on Python, integrates various AI services (speech recognition, text-to-speech), uses WebSockets or WebRTC for real-time transport, and supports multi-agent orchestration.
en.hot: With the growing demand for real-time AI agents, Pipecat offers a flexible, composable framework that attracts many developers. Its 14k+ stars and steady growth (+41 today) indicate an active community, and being maintained by Daily adds credibility.
uses: Developers building real-time conversational apps like voice assistants, multi-agent systems, or AI companions
Business scenarios needing low-latency voice interaction, such as customer service and support bots
Researchers or enthusiasts exploring multimodal AI interaction and orchestration

zh.tag: 内置本地模型的开源 AI 代理，完全隐私离线，开箱即用
zh.what: Magnitude 是一个开源 AI 代理，内置本地模型，所有推理都在本地完成，无需联网或外部 API。它能自动检测硬件并推荐合适的模型，安装后即可使用，支持通过技能扩展功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具、核心代理引擎、模型管理模块，以及用于扩展的技能系统。提供文档、演示 GIF 和社区链接，支持通过 npm 安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 环境，通过 npm 分发。支持 macOS 和 Linux，Windows 可通过 WSL 使用。
zh.hot: 凭借完全本地化、隐私保护和零成本运行的特点，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 106 星，总星数达 1454，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 4。
uses: 注重隐私的开发者，希望在本地运行 AI 代理而不泄露数据
需要离线 AI 辅助的场景，如无网络环境或敏感数据
希望快速上手本地模型，无需配置 Ollama 等外部服务的用户
希望扩展代理能力，处理 Excel、PDF、Chrome 等任务的用户

en.tag: Open-source agent with built-in local models, fully private & offline, works out of the box
en.what: Magnitude is an open-source AI agent with built-in local models, running all inference locally without internet or external APIs. It profiles your hardware, recommends suitable models, and works out of the box, with extensible skills.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool, core agent engine, model management module, and a skills system for extensions. It provides docs, demo GIFs, and community links, installable via npm.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, runs on Node.js, distributed via npm. Supports macOS and Linux, with Windows via WSL.
en.hot: It's gaining traction for its fully local, private, and free-to-run approach, with 106 stars today and 1454 total, ranking #4 on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious developers who want an AI agent running locally without data leaks
Scenarios requiring offline AI assistance, such as no-network environments or sensitive data
Users who want to quickly start with local models without configuring external services like Ollama
Users who want to extend the agent to handle Excel, PDF, Chrome, and other tasks

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web 应用源码、桌面应用构建配置、CLI 工具以及文档（入门指南、远程访问、架构概览等）。支持通过 npx 快速运行或安装桌面应用。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Vite+（Vite 的增强版）构建，依赖各代理的 CLI 工具（Codex CLI、Claude Code 等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 14459，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 18。它填补了多代理统一管理界面的空白，吸引了大量对 AI 编码工具感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Vite+ (enhanced Vite), depends on each agent's CLI tool (Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, total 14459, ranked #18 on TypeScript weekly trending. It fills the gap for a unified multi-agent management UI, attracting many developers interested in AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want to switch between multiple AI coding assistants in one interface
Teams or individuals needing remote access to coding agents
Early adopters exploring AI-assisted programming workflows

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: 全网广告与追踪拦截的 DNS 服务器
zh.what: AdGuard Home 是一款全网广告与追踪拦截软件，部署后即可保护家中所有设备，无需在每台设备上安装客户端。它作为 DNS 服务器运行，将追踪域名重定向到“黑洞”，从而阻止设备连接这些服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、安装脚本、API 说明、构建指南和贡献指南，以及与其他解决方案（如 Pi-Hole）的比较。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言编写，基于 AdGuard DNS 公共服务器所用软件，共享大量代码。支持 Docker 部署，并提供 Web 界面。
zh.hot: 随着隐私保护意识增强，用户需要简单有效的全网广告拦截方案，AdGuard Home 免费开源且功能强大，在 GitHub 上持续获得关注，今日新增 31 星，总星数达 36k+。
uses: 家庭用户：希望保护家中所有设备免受广告和追踪，无需逐台配置。
技术爱好者：喜欢自托管服务，可自定义 DNS 过滤规则。
小型企业或组织：需要为内部网络提供统一的广告拦截和隐私保护。

en.tag: Network-wide ads & trackers blocking DNS server
en.what: AdGuard Home is a network-wide ads and trackers blocking software. Once set up, it covers all your home devices without needing client-side software. It operates as a DNS server that reroutes tracking domains to a 'black hole', preventing devices from connecting to them.
en.content: The repository includes complete source code, documentation, installation scripts, API docs, build guides, contribution guidelines, and comparisons with other solutions like Pi-Hole.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, based on software used for AdGuard DNS public servers, sharing much code. Supports Docker deployment and provides a web interface.
en.hot: With growing privacy awareness, users need simple and effective network-wide ad blocking. AdGuard Home is free, open-source, and powerful, gaining steady attention on GitHub with 31 new stars today and 36k+ total.
uses: Home users: want to protect all devices from ads and tracking without per-device setup.
Tech enthusiasts: prefer self-hosted services and custom DNS filtering rules.
Small businesses or organizations: need unified ad blocking and privacy protection for internal networks.

zh.tag: 开源自主编码代理，支持 IDE、终端与 SDK
zh.what: Cline 是一个开源的自主编码代理，可在 IDE（VS Code、JetBrains）和终端中运行，也能作为 SDK 集成到自定义应用中。它能够创建文件、运行命令、浏览网页，并通过人工审批循环使用各种工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个组件：CLI（终端交互或 headless 模式）、Kanban（基于 Web 的任务板，可并行运行多个代理）、VS Code 扩展、JetBrains 插件，以及 SDK（Node.js 程序化 API）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 Node.js 生态，支持 npm 安装。
zh.hot: Cline 拥有 66,555 颗星，今日新增 76 颗，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 9。其多功能性（IDE、终端、SDK）和开源特性吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在 IDE 中获得 AI 编码助手，提升编码效率。
团队需要并行运行多个编码代理，通过任务板管理复杂项目。
希望构建自定义 AI 代理或集成到现有工作流的开发者。
CI/CD 场景中需要 headless 模式进行自动化编码和脚本执行。

en.tag: Open-source autonomous coding agent for IDE, terminal, and SDK
en.what: Cline is an open-source autonomous coding agent that runs in IDEs (VS Code, JetBrains) and the terminal, and can be integrated as an SDK. It can create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval.
en.content: The repo includes multiple components: CLI (terminal UI or headless mode), Kanban (web-based task board for parallel agents), VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, and SDK (Node.js programmatic API).
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, built on the Node.js ecosystem, installable via npm.
en.hot: Cline has 66,555 stars, with 76 added today, ranking #9 on the TypeScript daily trending. Its versatility (IDE, terminal, SDK) and open-source nature attract many developers.
uses: Developers seeking an AI coding assistant in their IDE to boost productivity.
Teams needing to run multiple coding agents in parallel via a task board.
Developers building custom AI agents or integrating into existing workflows.
CI/CD scenarios requiring headless mode for automated coding and scripting.

zh.tag: 轻量级 GPU 加速 RAW 图像编辑器，替代 Lightroom
zh.what: RapidRAW 是一款现代、高性能的 RAW 图像编辑器，支持非破坏性编辑，并利用 GPU 加速处理。它提供简洁美观的编辑体验，安装包小于 20MB，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Android。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面和移动端应用源码，基于 Tauri 构建，前端使用 React，后端使用 Rust 和 wgpu 进行 GPU 渲染。还包含文档、图标和发布资源。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Rust、wgpu（WebGPU 实现）、React、Tauri，以及 TypeScript。依赖较少，注重性能。
zh.hot: 作为 Lightroom 的轻量级替代品，RapidRAW 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 9500 颗星，今日新增 35 颗，位列 TypeScript 趋势榜第 10。其高性能和跨平台特性吸引了大量摄影爱好者和开发者。
uses: 摄影爱好者：需要快速、轻量的 RAW 编辑工具，且不想付费订阅 Lightroom。
开发者：对 Rust、wgpu 和 Tauri 构建高性能应用感兴趣，可学习其架构。
跨平台用户：需要在 Windows、macOS、Linux 或 Android 上使用同一款编辑器。

en.tag: A lightweight, GPU-accelerated RAW editor as a Lightroom alternative
en.what: RapidRAW is a modern, high-performance RAW image editor with non-destructive editing and GPU acceleration. It offers a clean and beautiful editing experience in a lightweight package under 20MB, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for desktop and mobile apps, built with Tauri, React for the frontend, and Rust with wgpu for GPU rendering. It also includes docs, icons, and release assets.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Rust, wgpu (WebGPU implementation), React, Tauri, and TypeScript. Minimal dependencies, performance-focused.
en.hot: As a lightweight Lightroom alternative, RapidRAW has gained nearly 9.5k stars, with 35 new stars today, ranking #10 on the TypeScript trending list. Its high performance and cross-platform appeal attract photographers and developers.
uses: Photography enthusiasts: need a fast, lightweight RAW editor without Lightroom's subscription.
Developers: interested in building high-performance apps with Rust, wgpu, and Tauri, can learn from its architecture.
Cross-platform users: need one editor across Windows, macOS, Linux, or Android.

zh.tag: 自托管个人图书馆与阅读平台
zh.what: BookOrbit 是一个自托管的图书馆和阅读平台，支持电子书、PDF、有声书和漫画。它提供网页阅读器、Kobo 和 KOReader 支持，并同步阅读进度、高亮和状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务端和前端代码，提供仪表盘、书架管理、阅读统计、成就系统、OPDS 和 Send-to-Kindle 等功能，并支持多用户和 OIDC/SSO 认证。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于现代 Web 技术栈构建，支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种第三方服务（如 Crowdin 翻译、Codecov 覆盖率）。
zh.hot: BookOrbit 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 248 星，总星数达 2613，因其自托管、跨设备同步和丰富功能而备受关注。
uses: 喜欢自托管服务的阅读爱好者，希望完全掌控自己的书籍数据。
需要在不同设备（如 Kobo、KOReader）间无缝同步阅读进度的用户。
注重隐私和自主权的用户，希望避免依赖商业云服务。
开发者或技术爱好者，希望扩展或定制自己的阅读平台。

en.tag: Self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics
en.what: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It offers a web reader, Kobo and KOReader support, and syncs progress, highlights, and reading status across devices.
en.content: The repository contains full server and frontend code, featuring a dashboard, bookshelf management, reading stats, achievements, OPDS and Send-to-Kindle delivery, multi-user accounts with OIDC/SSO, and automatic sync to Hardcover, Readwise, and StoryGraph.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on modern web technologies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates with third-party services like Crowdin for translation and Codecov for coverage.

Learners of AI coding practices: those wanting to build efficient AI dev workflows.

zh.tag: 比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的 S3 兼容对象存储
zh.what: RustFS 是一个基于 Rust 构建的高性能分布式对象存储系统，兼容 S3 API。它针对小对象（如 4KB）进行了极致优化，性能可达 MinIO 的 2.3 倍，同时支持与 MinIO、Ceph 等平台无缝迁移和共存。
zh.content: 仓库包含 RustFS 核心存储引擎、S3 API 网关、CLI 工具、Docker 部署配置以及完整的文档和示例。项目采用模块化架构，支持分布式部署和水平扩展。
zh.stack: 主要编程语言为 Rust，依赖 Tokio 异步运行时、S3 兼容库（如 aws-sdk-s3）、以及 RocksDB 或自研存储引擎。
zh.hot: 凭借比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的性能优势和 Rust 的内存安全特性，RustFS 在 GitHub 上获得 30k+ Stars，并登上 Trending 周榜。其 S3 兼容性降低了迁移成本，吸引了大量数据湖和 AI 场景用户。
uses: 数据湖与 AI 训练场景 —— 需要高性能小对象存储的机器学习平台
替代 MinIO/Ceph —— 追求更高吞吐和更低延迟的 S3 兼容存储
边缘计算与 IoT —— 轻量级分布式存储部署在资源受限环境
云原生基础设施 —— 作为 Kubernetes 的持久化存储后端

en.tag: 2.3x faster than MinIO for small objects, S3-compatible object storage
en.what: RustFS is a high-performance, distributed object storage system built in Rust, compatible with S3 API. It is extremely optimized for small objects (e.g., 4KB), achieving 2.3x the performance of MinIO, while supporting seamless migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms like MinIO and Ceph.
en.content: The repository contains the core storage engine, S3 API gateway, CLI tools, Docker deployment configs, and comprehensive documentation with examples. The project uses a modular architecture supporting distributed deployment and horizontal scaling.
en.stack: Primarily built in Rust, relying on Tokio async runtime, S3-compatible libraries (e.g., aws-sdk-s3), and RocksDB or custom storage engine.
en.hot: With 2.3x performance advantage over MinIO and Rust's memory safety, RustFS has gained 30k+ stars on GitHub and made it to the Trending weekly list. Its S3 compatibility reduces migration costs, attracting users in data lake and AI scenarios.
uses: Data lakes & AI training — high-performance small object storage for ML platforms
MinIO/Ceph replacement — S3-compatible storage with higher throughput and lower latency
Edge computing & IoT — lightweight distributed storage for resource-constrained environments
Cloud-native infrastructure — persistent storage backend for Kubernetes

zh.tag: 终端起家的智能体开发环境，内置 AI 代理与协作工作流
zh.what: Warp 是一个智能体开发环境，源自终端，提供内置编码代理，也支持接入 Claude Code、Codex 等外部 CLI 代理。它通过 Oz 代理实现自动化问题分类、代码实现和 PR 审查，并支持在 Web 编译的 Warp 终端中查看代理会话。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 GPT 模型（OpenAI 为创始赞助商）驱动代理管理工作流，并集成 Oz 代理框架。
zh.hot: Warp 将终端升级为智能体开发环境，结合 AI 代理自动化开发流程，star 数高达 64k+，今日新增 56，位列 Rust 日榜第 5，反映出开发者对 AI 驱动开发工具的高度关注。

开源维护者：通过 Oz for OSS 获得代理管理开源项目的支持
团队协作：在 Web 终端中查看代理会话，跟踪项目进展

en.tag: Agentic development environment born from the terminal, with built-in AI agents and collaborative workflows
en.what: Warp is an agentic development environment that originated from the terminal, offering a built-in coding agent and support for external CLI agents like Claude Code and Codex. It uses Oz agents to automate issue triage, code implementation, and PR review, and allows viewing agent sessions in a web-compiled Warp terminal.
en.content: The repository contains the Warp client codebase, split into crates like warpui_core and warpui (MIT licensed) and the rest under AGPL v3. en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging GPT models (with OpenAI as founding sponsor) to power agentic management workflows, and integrating the Oz agent framework.
en.hot: Warp transforms the terminal into an agentic development environment, automating development workflows with AI agents. With 64k+ stars and 56 new stars today, ranking #5 on the Rust daily trending, it reflects strong developer interest in AI-driven dev tools.
uses: Developers: seeking to accelerate coding and automate issue/PR handling with AI agents
Open-source maintainers: leveraging Oz for OSS to manage projects with agentic workflows
Teams: tracking agent sessions in a web terminal for collaborative visibility

zh.tag: Amadeus 区块链节点，支持本地测试网与合约部署
zh.what: 这是一个用 Rust 编写的区块链节点实现，属于 Amadeus 协议。它支持运行本地测试网、部署和调用智能合约（如 AssemblyScript 编写的计数器合约），并提供了与 RPC API 交互的能力。

en.tag: Amadeus blockchain node with local testnet and contract deployment
en.what: This is a Rust implementation of a blockchain node for the Amadeus protocol. It supports running a local testnet, deploying and invoking smart contracts (e.g., a counter contract written in AssemblyScript), and provides RPC API interaction.

zh.tag: 企业微信终端操作与 AI Agent 命令行工具
zh.what: wecom-cli 是一个用 Rust 编写的企业微信命令行工具，覆盖消息、邮件、文档、待办、日程、会议、微盘、通讯录等核心业务功能。它让用户和 AI Agent 都能在终端中直接操作企业微信，提升办公效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 主程序、Agent Skills 集成、文档（CLI 命令参考、Skills 文档）以及示例配置。支持通过 npm 全局安装，并提供交互式凭证配置。

en.tag: Terminal & AI Agent CLI for WeCom (WeChat Work)
en.what: wecom-cli is a Rust-based command-line tool for WeCom (WeChat Work), covering messaging, email, docs, todos, calendar, meetings, WeDrive, and contacts. It enables both humans and AI agents to operate WeCom directly from the terminal, boosting office productivity.

AI agent developers: use Skills to let AI assistants operate WeCom directly, building smart office bots.
Ops and productivity enthusiasts: manage todos, meetings, and WeDrive files from the terminal, reducing GUI clicks.

zh.tag: 为无服务器计算打造的极速安全微虚拟机
zh.what: Firecracker 是一种开源虚拟化技术，专为创建和管理安全、多租户的容器及函数工作负载而设计。它通过轻量级虚拟机（microVM）结合硬件虚拟化的安全隔离与容器的速度灵活性，支持无服务器运行模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Firecracker 的虚拟化监视器（VMM）核心实现，基于 KVM，采用极简设计，剔除不必要的设备以降低内存占用和攻击面。还提供构建工具、文档（如快速入门、生产环境配置）及与 Kata Containers 等运行时集成的示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Linux KVM 虚拟化技术。构建支持 Unix/Linux 系统，通过 Docker 开发容器和 bash 脚本进行编译。
zh.hot: 作为 AWS Lambda 和 Fargate 背后的技术，Firecracker 在无服务器领域具有标杆地位，36k+ Stars 彰显其广泛认可。今日新增 25 星，持续活跃，是基础设施领域的热门项目。
uses: 无服务器平台开发者：需要安全、快速启动的微VM来运行函数或容器工作负载。
容器运行时集成：如 Kata Containers 和 Flintlock，用于增强隔离性。
云基础设施团队：希望降低开销、提高硬件利用率，同时保证多租户安全。

en.tag: Secure and fast microVMs for serverless computing
en.what: Firecracker is an open-source virtualization technology purpose-built for creating and managing secure, multi-tenant container and function workloads. It runs workloads in lightweight microVMs, combining hardware virtualization security with container speed and flexibility for serverless models.
en.content: The repository contains the core VMM implementation based on KVM, with a minimalist design that excludes unnecessary devices to reduce memory footprint and attack surface. It includes build tools, docs (quickstart, production setup), and integration examples with runtimes like Kata Containers.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging Linux KVM for virtualization. Buildable on Unix/Linux with Docker and bash via devtool scripts.
en.hot: As the technology behind AWS Lambda and Fargate, Firecracker is a benchmark in serverless computing, with 36k+ stars reflecting wide adoption. With 25 stars today, it remains active and popular in infrastructure.
uses: Serverless platform developers needing secure, fast-booting microVMs for functions or containers.
Container runtime integrators like Kata Containers and Flintlock to enhance isolation.
Cloud infrastructure teams aiming to reduce overhead and increase utilization while ensuring multi-tenant security.

zh.tag: Rust 编写的 CLI 代理，压缩命令输出，节省 LLM 令牌
zh.what: RTK 是一个高性能 CLI 代理，在命令输出进入 LLM 上下文之前进行过滤和压缩，可减少 60-90% 的令牌消耗。它拦截 shell 命令并优化输出格式，使 AI 代理读取更少但更有用的信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档（架构、故障排除）、多语言 README（中英法等），以及 CI 配置。核心是单个 Rust 二进制，零依赖，支持 100+ 命令。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，无外部依赖，通过 Homebrew 分发，支持主流 shell 和命令。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程助手普及的背景下，节省令牌成本成为刚需，RTK 以 76k+ star 迅速走红，今日新增 140 star，位列 Rust 日榜第 9。
uses: 使用 AI 编程助手（如 Copilot、Codex）的开发者，希望减少令牌费用
需要处理大量命令行输出的自动化脚本或 CI 流程
对性能敏感，希望低开销（<10ms）过滤输出的用户

en.tag: Rust CLI proxy that compresses command output to cut LLM token usage
en.what: RTK is a high-performance CLI proxy that filters and compresses command output before it reaches the LLM context, reducing token consumption by 60-90%. It intercepts shell commands and optimizes output formats so AI agents read less but more useful information.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, docs (architecture, troubleshooting), multilingual READMEs (English, Chinese, French, etc.), and CI configs. Core is a single Rust binary with zero dependencies, supporting 100+ commands.
en.stack: Written in Rust with zero dependencies, distributed via Homebrew, supports major shells and commands.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants become mainstream, cutting token costs is a must-have. RTK has gained 76k+ stars, with 140 new today, ranking #9 on Rust daily trending.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants (e.g., Copilot, Codex) to reduce token costs
Automation scripts or CI pipelines that handle large command outputs
Users who need low-overhead (<10ms) output filtering for performance-sensitive tasks

zh.tag: Rust 编写的高性能 JS/TS 打包器，兼容 Rollup API
zh.what: Rolldown 是一个用 Rust 编写的 JavaScript/TypeScript 打包器，旨在成为 Vite 未来的底层打包工具。它提供与 Rollup 兼容的 API 和插件接口，但在功能范围上更接近 esbuild，追求极致的性能。

uses: 前端工具链开发者，希望参与下一代打包器的开发或贡献
Vite 用户，关注未来 Vite 的底层性能优化
需要高性能打包的 JavaScript/TypeScript 项目团队
对 Rust 与前端工具链结合感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: Fast Rust bundler for JS/TS with Rollup-compatible API

Vite users looking forward to performance improvements in future Vite versions
Teams needing high-performance bundling for JS/TS projects
Tech enthusiasts interested in Rust and frontend tooling

zh.tag: Rust 原生高性能量化交易平台

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的高性能 JS/TS 工具链集合
zh.what: Oxc（氧化编译器）是用 Rust 编写的高性能 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 工具集合，旨在为 JS 生态提供统一、极速的开发工具链。它驱动了 Rolldown（Vite 的打包器），并支持下一代超快开发工具的无缝协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含解析器（Parser）、转换器（Transformer）、压缩器（Minifier）、模块解析器（Resolver）以及 linter（Oxlint）和格式化器（Oxfmt）等组件，并提供 CLI 工具和库供集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，利用其内存安全和零成本抽象实现高性能；同时提供 npm 包（如 oxlint、oxfmt）以便在 JS 生态中使用。
zh.hot: Oxc 因成为 Vite 下一代打包器 Rolldown 的核心而备受关注，其 Rust 实现带来显著的性能提升，吸引了大量 star（22k+），并在 GitHub Trending 上持续上榜。
uses: 前端工具链开发者：希望构建或集成高性能 JS 解析、转换、压缩功能的开发者。
使用 Vite/Rolldown 的团队：需要极速打包和开发体验的现代前端项目。
需要快速 lint 和格式化的项目：用 oxlint 和 oxfmt 替代传统工具以提升 CI 速度。
对 Rust 与 JS 互操作感兴趣的工程师：学习如何用 Rust 构建高性能 JS 工具。

en.tag: A collection of high-performance JavaScript/TypeScript tools written in Rust
en.what: Oxc (The Oxidation Compiler) is a collection of high-performance tools for JavaScript and TypeScript written in Rust, aiming to provide a unified, ultra-fast toolchain for the JS ecosystem. It powers Rolldown (Vite's bundler) and enables the next generation of seamlessly integrated, ultra-fast development tools.
en.content: The repository contains components such as a parser, transformer, minifier, module resolver, as well as linter (Oxlint) and formatter (Oxfmt), offering CLI tools and libraries for integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging its memory safety and zero-cost abstractions for high performance; also provides npm packages (e.g., oxlint, oxfmt) for use in the JS ecosystem.
en.hot: Oxc gains attention as the core of Rolldown, Vite's next-generation bundler, with its Rust implementation delivering significant performance improvements, attracting over 22k stars and consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Developers building or integrating high-performance JS parsing, transformation, or minification features.
Teams using Vite/Rolldown: modern frontend projects needing blazing-fast bundling and dev experience.
Projects needing fast linting and formatting: replace traditional tools with oxlint and oxfmt to speed up CI.
Engineers interested in Rust-JS interop: learn how to build high-performance JS tools in Rust.

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 透明堡垒机，零客户端接入 SSH/HTTPS/K8s/数据库/RDP/VNC
zh.what: Warpgate 是一个智能且完全透明的堡垒主机，支持 SSH、HTTPS、Kubernetes、MySQL、PostgreSQL、RDP 和 VNC，无需客户端应用或 SSH 包装器。它部署在 DMZ 中，可管理用户并分配访问权限，同时记录所有会话供实时查看或回放。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的服务端二进制、内置 Web 管理界面（支持浏览器 SSH/RDP/VNC）、配置示例、Docker 部署文件及完整文档。
zh.stack: 使用 100% 安全 Rust 编写，单一二进制无依赖；支持 TOTP 和 OpenID Connect 的 2FA/SSO，内置 IP 封禁和用户锁定等暴力破解防护。
zh.hot: Warpgate 以零客户端透明接入和全面协议支持解决了堡垒机痛点，同时提供内置会话录制和 Web 访问，在 Rust 社区持续获得关注（7.6k stars）。
uses: 运维团队：统一管理 SSH/数据库等访问入口，无需安装额外客户端
安全审计：通过会话录制和实时监控满足合规要求
远程办公：通过浏览器直接访问内网 RDP/VNC 资源
开发者：利用 Kubernetes 集成简化集群访问控制

en.tag: Transparent bastion for SSH/HTTPS/K8s/DB/RDP/VNC, no client needed
en.what: Warpgate is a smart and fully transparent bastion host for SSH, HTTPS, Kubernetes, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDP, and VNC, requiring no client app or SSH wrapper. Deployed in the DMZ, it manages users and access, while recording all sessions for live viewing or replay.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust server binary, built-in web admin UI (with browser-based SSH/RDP/VNC), config examples, Docker deployment files, and full documentation.
en.stack: Written in 100% safe Rust, single binary with no dependencies; supports 2FA/SSO via TOTP and OpenID Connect, built-in brute-force protection with IP blocking and user lockout.
en.hot: Warpgate addresses bastion pain points with zero-client transparent access and broad protocol support, plus built-in session recording and web access, gaining steady traction in the Rust community (7.6k stars).
uses: Ops teams: unify access to SSH/DBs without extra clients
Security auditors: session recording and live monitoring for compliance
Remote workers: browser-based access to internal RDP/VNC resources
Developers: simplify cluster access control with Kubernetes integration

zh.tag: 光速开发的多人在线游戏与实时应用后端数据库
zh.what: SpacetimeDB 是一个将数据库与服务器逻辑合二为一的实时平台，让开发者直接用 Rust 或 C# 编写存储过程，并自动同步状态到客户端。它消除了传统后端架构中数据库与应用服务器之间的延迟，使开发多人在线游戏和实时应用变得极其高效。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SpacetimeDB 的完整源代码，包括核心数据库引擎、Rust 与 C# 模块系统、客户端 SDK（Rust、C#、TypeScript）、CLI 工具、文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖包括 Tokio、Serde、WASM 等，支持通过 WebAssembly 运行用户模块，并提供了多种语言的客户端 SDK。
zh.hot: 凭借 25k+ 星标，SpacetimeDB 因其革命性的开发范式而受到关注，大幅简化了实时应用的后端开发，吸引了游戏开发者和实时应用开发者。
uses: 多人在线游戏开发者，快速构建实时同步的游戏后端
实时协作应用（如白板、聊天）开发者，减少后端复杂度
希望用 Rust 或 C# 编写服务端逻辑的全栈开发者
对 WebAssembly 和数据库新技术感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: A database for real-time apps and games, development at the speed of light
en.what: SpacetimeDB is a real-time platform that combines database and server logic into one, letting developers write stored procedures in Rust or C# and automatically sync state to clients. It eliminates the latency between database and application server in traditional backends, making development of multiplayer games and real-time apps highly efficient.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of SpacetimeDB, including the core database engine, Rust and C# module system, client SDKs (Rust, C#, TypeScript), CLI tools, documentation, and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with dependencies like Tokio, Serde, and WASM, supporting user modules via WebAssembly, and offering client SDKs in multiple languages.
en.hot: With 25k+ stars, SpacetimeDB gains attention for its revolutionary development paradigm, greatly simplifying backend development for real-time apps, attracting game developers and real-time application developers.
uses: Multiplayer game developers building real-time synchronized backends quickly
Developers of real-time collaborative apps (e.g., whiteboards, chat) reducing backend complexity
Full-stack developers who want to write server logic in Rust or C#
Tech enthusiasts interested in WebAssembly and new database technologies

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的高性能 Minecraft 服务端
zh.what: Pumpkin 是一个完全用 Rust 编写的 Minecraft 服务器，旨在提供极致的性能和可定制性。它支持最新的 Java 和 Bedrock 版本，同时保持原版游戏机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器核心实现，包括世界加载、区块生成、玩家管理、实体 AI、红石、插件系统等模块，目前处于积极开发中。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Rust，利用多线程和零成本抽象实现高性能；依赖 tokio 异步运行时和自定义网络协议实现。
zh.hot: Rust 语言的高性能和安全性吸引了大量 Minecraft 社区关注，今日新增 108 星，总星数 8415，位列 GitHub 日榜第 18 名。
uses: Minecraft 服务器管理员 —— 希望部署高性能、低资源占用的服务端
Rust 开发者 —— 学习 Rust 在游戏服务器领域的实践
Minecraft 模组/插件开发者 —— 基于其插件系统进行扩展

en.tag: A fast, efficient Minecraft server built entirely in Rust
en.what: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, designed for maximum performance and customizability. It supports the latest Java and Bedrock editions while adhering to vanilla game mechanics.
en.content: The repository contains a full server core implementation, including world loading, chunk generation, player management, entity AI, redstone, plugin system, etc., currently under heavy development.
en.stack: Tech stack is Rust, leveraging multi-threading and zero-cost abstractions for high performance; relies on tokio async runtime and custom network protocol implementation.
en.hot: The high performance and safety of Rust attract massive attention from the Minecraft community, with 108 stars added today and 8415 total, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Minecraft server admins — seeking high-performance, low-resource server software
Rust developers — learning Rust in game server development
Minecraft mod/plugin developers — extending functionality via its plugin system

zh.tag: Rust 编写的全文搜索引擎库，Lucene 的现代替代
zh.what: Tantivy 是一个受 Apache Lucene 启发、用 Rust 编写的全文搜索引擎库。它提供构建搜索引擎所需的底层组件，如索引、查询解析和评分，但并非开箱即用的服务器。开发者可以将其集成到自己的应用中，实现快速、可靠的全文搜索功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码、文档、基准测试和示例。支持可配置的分词器（含多种语言）、BM25 评分、自然语言查询和短语查询。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，依赖较少，可编译为 WebAssembly。支持第三方分词器如 jieba、lindera 等。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态中最成熟的全文搜索引擎库，Tantivy 凭借高性能和低延迟吸引了大量关注，GitHub 星标已超 1.5 万，今日新增 68 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 8。
uses: 需要嵌入式全文搜索功能的 Rust 应用开发者
构建高性能搜索引擎或日志分析工具（如 Quickwit）的团队
希望替代 Lucene 或 Elasticsearch 底层引擎的开发者
对 Rust 和搜索引擎技术感兴趣的学习者

en.tag: Full-text search engine library in Rust, a modern Lucene alternative
en.what: Tantivy is a full-text search engine library written in Rust, inspired by Apache Lucene. It provides low-level components like indexing, query parsing, and scoring, but is not an out-of-the-box server. Developers can integrate it into their applications to add fast, reliable full-text search.
en.content: The repository contains the core library source, documentation, benchmarks, and examples. It supports configurable tokenizers (including multiple languages), BM25 scoring, natural language queries, and phrase queries.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation with minimal dependencies, compilable to WebAssembly. Supports third-party tokenizers like jieba, lindera, etc.
en.hot: As the most mature full-text search library in the Rust ecosystem, Tantivy attracts attention for its high performance and low latency, with over 15k stars and 68 added today, ranking #8 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Rust developers needing embedded full-text search
Teams building high-performance search engines or log analyzers (e.g., Quickwit)
Developers looking to replace Lucene or Elasticsearch internals
Learners interested in Rust and search engine technology

zh.tag: 极速 DataFrame 查询引擎，Rust 编写，支持多语言
zh.what: Polars 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 DataFrame 分析查询引擎，提供惰性/急切执行、查询优化和流式处理，支持超出内存的数据集。它提供 Python、Rust、Node.js、R 和 SQL 绑定，并可选 GPU 加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 库、多语言绑定（Python、Node.js、R）、用户指南、文档和插件接口，以及用于扩展的 I/O 和表达式插件。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 实现，利用多线程和 SIMD 向量化执行，采用 Apache Arrow 列式格式进行零拷贝数据共享，支持 GPU 加速（NVIDIA）。
zh.hot: Polars 凭借其卓越的性能和易用性在数据科学社区广受欢迎，star 数接近 4 万，今日新增 13 个，持续活跃。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师：处理大型数据集，进行快速数据清洗和转换。
数据工程师：构建高效的数据管道，处理超出内存的数据。
Python/R/Node.js 开发者：在各自语言环境中利用高性能 DataFrame 操作。
需要 GPU 加速查询的用户：利用 NVIDIA GPU 加速数据处理。

en.tag: Ultra-fast DataFrame query engine in Rust with multi-language bindings
en.what: Polars is an extremely fast DataFrame analytical query engine written in Rust, featuring lazy/eager execution, query optimization, and streaming for larger-than-RAM datasets. It offers bindings for Python, Rust, Node.js, R, and SQL, with optional GPU acceleration.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust library, multi-language bindings (Python, Node.js, R), user guide, documentation, and plugin interfaces for I/O and expression extensions.
en.stack: Built on Rust with multi-threaded, vectorized (SIMD) execution, uses Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy data sharing, and supports optional NVIDIA GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Polars is highly popular in the data science community for its outstanding performance and ease of use, with nearly 40k stars and 13 new stars today, showing sustained activity.
uses: Data scientists and analysts: for fast data cleaning and transformation on large datasets.
Data engineers: building efficient data pipelines handling larger-than-RAM data.
Python/R/Node.js developers: leveraging high-performance DataFrame operations in their preferred language.
Users needing GPU acceleration: accelerating data processing with NVIDIA GPUs.

zh.tag: 开源通用 AI 代理，桌面/CLI/API 三端齐发
zh.what: goose 是一个运行在本机上的通用 AI 代理，不仅能写代码，还能处理研究、写作、自动化、数据分析等任务。它提供原生桌面应用、完整 CLI 和可嵌入 API，支持多种 LLM 提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（macOS/Linux/Windows）、CLI 工具、API 接口，以及扩展系统（支持 MCP 协议）。
zh.stack: 主要用 Rust 编写，以保证性能和可移植性；支持 15+ 提供商，通过 ACP 使用现有订阅，并通过 MCP 连接 70+ 扩展。
zh.hot: star 数高达 5.3 万，今日新增 47，因其通用性和多端支持而受关注，且属于 Linux 基金会项目，生态潜力大。
uses: 开发者：用 CLI 或 API 将 AI 代理集成到自动化工作流中
普通用户：通过桌面应用完成写作、研究、数据分析等日常任务
企业：利用 MCP 扩展连接内部工具，实现业务流程自动化
AI 爱好者：探索多提供商支持和自定义发行版

en.tag: Open-source general-purpose AI agent with desktop, CLI, and API
en.what: goose is a general-purpose AI agent that runs locally, handling not just code but also research, writing, automation, and data analysis. It offers a native desktop app, a full CLI, and an embeddable API, supporting multiple LLM providers.
en.content: The repo contains a desktop app (macOS/Linux/Windows), a CLI tool, an API, and an extension system supporting the Model Context Protocol.
en.stack: Built primarily in Rust for performance and portability; supports 15+ providers, uses existing subscriptions via ACP, and connects to 70+ extensions via MCP.
en.hot: With 53k stars and 47 new today, it's popular for its versatility and multi-platform support, being a Linux Foundation project with strong ecosystem potential.
uses: Developers: integrate the AI agent into automation workflows via CLI or API
General users: accomplish writing, research, data analysis via the desktop app
Enterprises: connect internal tools via MCP extensions for business process automation
AI enthusiasts: explore multi-provider support and custom distributions

zh.tag: AI 代理的上下文智能层，本地 Rust 二进制，节省 60-90% token
zh.what: LeanCTX 是一个本地运行的上下文工程层，为 AI 编码代理提供上下文管理。它理解任务、路由相关上下文、压缩发送内容，并跟踪成本和结果，从而减少 token 消耗。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的二进制、MCP 工具集（76 个）、支持 30+ 代理集成，以及实时仪表盘和预算控制功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 编写，提供 crates.io、npm、AUR 等分发渠道，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 凭借 60-90% 的 token 节省和零配置、本地优先的特性，迅速获得 3614 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。
uses: AI 编码代理用户，希望减少 token 成本并优化上下文使用。
开发团队，需要跨会话的持久记忆和上下文预算控制。
本地优先工具爱好者，偏好数据不离开本地环境。

en.tag: Context intelligence layer for AI agents — local Rust binary, cuts tokens 60-90%
en.what: LeanCTX is a local context engineering layer for AI coding agents. It understands tasks, routes relevant context, compresses what it sends, and tracks cost and outcomes, reducing token usage.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust binary, 76 MCP tools, support for 30+ agents, plus a real-time dashboard and budget control.
en.stack: Written in Rust, distributed via crates.io, npm, AUR, etc., licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: With 60-90% token savings and zero-config, local-first design, it quickly gained 3614 stars and hit GitHub Trending daily.
uses: AI coding agent users looking to cut token costs and optimize context usage.
Dev teams needing persistent session memory and context budget control.
Local-first enthusiasts who prefer data staying on-premises.

zh.tag: Go 编写的可插拔 DNS 服务器/转发器
zh.what: CoreDNS 是一个用 Go 编写的 DNS 服务器和转发器，通过插件链实现灵活的功能扩展。它支持多种协议（UDP/TCP、DoT、DoH、DoH3、DoQ、gRPC），并可作为 Kubernetes 集群的 DNS 组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CoreDNS 的完整源码、插件系统、文档和构建配置。插件涵盖文件、自动加载、etcd、Kubernetes 后端、缓存、转发、指标、日志等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 gRPC、Prometheus、etcd 等库，支持多种 DNS 协议。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目和 Kubernetes 默认 DNS，CoreDNS 拥有稳定且庞大的用户基础。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但 14k+ 的总 star 和持续维护使其保持热度。
uses: Kubernetes 集群管理员：作为集群 DNS 服务，提供服务发现和解析。
云原生开发者：利用插件机制定制 DNS 行为，如缓存、重写、转发。
网络运维：部署高性能、可扩展的 DNS 服务器，支持 DoT/DoH 等加密协议。

en.tag: A pluggable DNS server/forwarder written in Go
en.what: CoreDNS is a DNS server and forwarder written in Go, with a plugin chain for flexible functionality. It supports multiple protocols (UDP/TCP, DoT, DoH, DoH3, DoQ, gRPC) and serves as the DNS component in Kubernetes clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, plugin system, documentation, and build configuration for CoreDNS. Plugins cover file, auto, etcd, Kubernetes backends, caching, forwarding, metrics, logging, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with dependencies on gRPC, Prometheus, etcd, and supports multiple DNS protocols.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project and the default DNS for Kubernetes, CoreDNS has a stable and large user base. Despite modest daily star gains, its 14k+ total stars and continuous maintenance keep it trending.
uses: Kubernetes cluster admins: use as the cluster DNS for service discovery and resolution.
Cloud-native developers: leverage the plugin system to customize DNS behavior, such as caching, rewriting, and forwarding.
Network operators: deploy a high-performance, extensible DNS server supporting encrypted protocols like DoT/DoH.

zh.tag: Go 语言高性能并行 Lint 工具
zh.what: golangci-lint 是一个快速运行的 Go 语言 linter 聚合工具，它并行执行多个 linter，利用缓存加速，支持 YAML 配置，并集成主流 IDE。它内置超过一百种 linter，帮助开发者发现代码中的错误、风格问题和潜在缺陷。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、文档（位于 golangci-lint.run）、安装脚本、CI 配置、Docker 镜像以及贡献者列表。核心是一个命令行工具，通过配置文件选择并运行多个 linter。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 生态中的各种 linter 库，支持 YAML 配置，并提供 Docker 镜像和 CI 集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 社区的标准 lint 工具，拥有 19k+ star，今日新增 9 星并登上 Go 日榜，因其高效并行和丰富 linter 集成而广受欢迎。
uses: Go 开发者：在本地开发或 CI 中运行 lint 检查，提升代码质量
团队协作：统一代码风格和规范，减少 review 时间

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理和 IDE 打造的高性能代码智能引擎
zh.what: Gortex 是一个高性能的代码智能引擎，专为 AI 代理和 IDE 设计。它将代码索引为图结构，并通过 CLI、MCP 服务器和 Web UI 提供访问，支持多仓库，默认支持 257 种语言。它通过只暴露必要信息，可将 token 消耗降低最多 50 倍。

IDE 用户：通过 MCP 或 CLI 获取代码智能，提升编码效率。
多仓库项目团队：利用其多仓库支持进行跨服务分析。

en.what: Gortex is a high-performance code-intelligence engine designed for AI agents and IDEs. en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging tree-sitter for parsing, with MCP server, CLI, and web UI. Supports 19 coding agents and offers 175 configurable MCP tools.
en.hot: Gained 144 stars today, ranking #10 in Go on GitHub Trending. Its ability to cut token usage by up to 50x and being 100% local attracts AI coding agent users.
