en.hot: gRPC is a standard communication framework in cloud-native and microservices architectures, with 45k+ stars and widespread use in large systems like Google. Although today's new stars are few, it maintains high popularity as infrastructure.
uses: Service-to-service communication in microservices, replacing REST with higher performance and type safety
Distributed systems requiring cross-language communication, e.g., Python backend interacting with C++ services
Streaming and bidirectional communication scenarios, such as real-time data push, chat apps
Mobile-to-server communication, supporting Objective-C and Java, etc.

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整 C++ 源代码、文档、扩展机制以及多种客户端（Python、R、Java、Wasm 等）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持 Python、R、Java 等客户端，并与 pandas、dplyr 等库深度集成。
zh.hot: DuckDB 因其嵌入式、零配置的分析查询能力而广受欢迎，今日新增 58 星，总星数超 4 万，在 C++ 趋势榜排名第一。
uses: 数据科学家：在 Python 中快速分析大型数据集，无需复杂数据库设置。
数据分析师：直接查询 CSV/Parquet 文件，简化数据导入流程。
应用开发者：将 DuckDB 嵌入应用，提供高性能本地分析功能。

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database for fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect with complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, documentation, extension mechanisms, and integrations for multiple clients (Python, R, Java, Wasm, etc.).
en.stack: Written in C++17, built with CMake, supports Python, R, Java clients, and integrates deeply with pandas and dplyr.
en.hot: DuckDB is popular for its embedded, zero-configuration analytical querying; it gained 58 stars today, with over 40k total, ranking #1 on C++ trending.
uses: Data scientists: quickly analyze large datasets in Python without complex database setup.
Data analysts: directly query CSV/Parquet files, simplifying data import.
Application developers: embed DuckDB for high-performance local analytics.

zh.tag: 高效相似度搜索与稠密向量聚类库
zh.what: Faiss 是 Meta 开发的高效相似度搜索与稠密向量聚类库。它能在任意规模的向量集合中进行搜索，甚至支持超出内存容量的数据集，并提供评估与参数调优的辅助代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含多种索引结构（如精确搜索、HNSW、NSG）和 GPU 实现，支持 CPU/GPU 无缝切换，并提供 Python 封装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，依赖 BLAS，可选支持 CUDA/ROCm 和 Python 接口，可通过 cmake 构建。
zh.hot: Faiss 是向量检索领域的标杆工具，被广泛应用于推荐、搜索等场景，拥有 4 万+ Star，持续活跃。
uses: 机器学习工程师：用于大规模向量相似度搜索，如推荐系统、图像检索
数据科学家：进行聚类分析和近邻搜索
研究机构：作为向量检索算法的基准和实验平台

en.tag: Library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors
en.what: Faiss is a library developed by Meta for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors. It can search in sets of vectors of any size, even those that do not fit in RAM, and includes supporting code for evaluation and parameter tuning.
en.content: The repository contains various index structures (e.g., exact search, HNSW, NSG) and GPU implementations, supporting seamless CPU/GPU switching with Python wrappers.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, depends on BLAS, with optional CUDA/ROCm and Python interfaces, built with cmake.
en.hot: Faiss is a benchmark tool in vector retrieval, widely used in recommendation and search, with 40k+ stars and ongoing activity.
uses: ML engineers: for large-scale vector similarity search in recommendation and image retrieval
Data scientists: for clustering and nearest neighbor search
Research institutions: as a benchmark and experimentation platform for vector retrieval algorithms

zh.tag: 开源计算机视觉库，图像处理与AI视觉的基石
zh.what: OpenCV 是一个开源的计算机视觉和机器学习软件库，提供数百种图像和视频分析算法，广泛应用于人脸识别、物体检测、自动驾驶等领域。它支持多种编程语言和操作系统，是学术界和工业界最流行的视觉工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 源码、头文件、构建脚本、文档和测试用例，以及用于扩展功能的 opencv_contrib 模块（单独仓库）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、Java、JavaScript 等语言绑定，依赖 CMake 构建，支持多种操作系统和硬件加速（如 CUDA、OpenCL）。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 9 万 star，是计算机视觉领域的事实标准，持续活跃开发，今日新增 19 星，仍稳居 C++ 趋势榜前列。
uses: 学生和研究人员：学习和实验图像处理、机器学习算法
开发者：构建人脸识别、物体检测、AR 等应用
企业：用于工业质检、安防监控、自动驾驶等场景

en.tag: Open-source computer vision library, foundation for image processing and AI vision
en.what: OpenCV is an open-source computer vision and machine learning software library that provides hundreds of algorithms for image and video analysis, widely used in face recognition, object detection, autonomous driving, and more. It supports multiple programming languages and operating systems, making it the most popular vision tool in academia and industry.
en.content: The repository contains core C++ source code, headers, build scripts, documentation, and tests, along with the opencv_contrib modules (separate repo) for extended functionality.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for Python, Java, JavaScript, etc. Built with CMake, supports multiple OSes and hardware acceleration (CUDA, OpenCL).
en.hot: With over 90k stars, it's the de facto standard in computer vision, actively developed, gaining 19 stars today, still ranking high on C++ trending.
uses: Students and researchers: learn and experiment with image processing and ML algorithms
Developers: build face recognition, object detection, AR apps
Enterprises: use in industrial inspection, security surveillance, autonomous driving

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库
zh.what: 这是一个广受欢迎的头文件优先 JSON 库，为 C++ 开发者提供直观、STL 风格的 API 来解析、生成和操作 JSON 数据。它支持将 JSON 与 C++ 数据结构无缝互转，大幅降低了现代 C++ 项目中处理 JSON 的复杂度。
zh.content: 仓库以单头文件（json.hpp）为核心分发形态，同时包含完整的测试套件、基准测试、文档网站源码及多包管理器（Conan、vcpkg 等）支持配置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11/14/17 标准库实现，无需外部依赖，仅依赖 STL 容器和模板元编程，支持通过 CMake 构建测试与示例。
zh.hot: 凭借超 5 万 Star 和今日新增 17 Star 登上 C++ 日榜第 10，它已成为 C++ 生态的事实标准 JSON 库。其“像 STL 一样直观”的 API 设计和单头文件即用的便捷性持续吸引开发者。
uses: C++ 后端/客户端开发者需要轻量、高性能 JSON 解析与序列化
嵌入式与游戏项目团队希望以单头文件引入依赖，简化构建流程
基础设施开发者在微服务、配置系统或协议网关中进行结构化数据交换

en.tag: Modern C++ JSON parsing and serialization library
en.what: A widely-adopted, header-only JSON library for C++ offering an intuitive, STL-like API to parse, generate, and manipulate JSON. It enables seamless mapping between JSON and C++ data structures, dramatically simplifying JSON handling in modern C++ projects.
en.content: The repository centers around a single-header distribution (json.hpp), complemented by comprehensive tests, benchmarks, documentation site sources, and package manager integrations like Conan and vcpkg.
en.stack: Built on C++11/14/17 with zero external dependencies, relying solely on STL containers and template metaprogramming; tests and examples are built via CMake.
en.hot: With over 50k stars and 17 new stars today, ranking 10th on the C++ daily trending list, it has become the de facto standard JSON library in the C++ ecosystem. Its STL-intuitive API design and single-header convenience continue to attract developers.
uses: C++ backend and client developers needing lightweight, high-performance JSON parsing and serialization
Embedded and game teams looking to simplify builds with a single-header dependency
Infrastructure developers performing structured data exchange in microservices, config systems, or protocol gateways

zh.tag: 多平台世嘉 Dreamcast/Naomi 模拟器
zh.what: Flycast 是一款多平台模拟器，支持世嘉 Dreamcast、Naomi、Naomi 2 和 Atomiswave 街机系统。它源自 reicast 项目，提供高兼容性和性能，可在多种设备上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器源代码、构建配置、文档和持续集成工作流。支持 Android、Windows、Linux、macOS、Switch、Xbox 等平台，提供稳定版和开发版构建。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenGL/Vulkan 等图形 API，并集成多种平台 SDK。构建系统支持 CMake，持续集成覆盖多平台。
zh.hot: 今日新增 10 星，总星数 2470，位列 C++ 日榜第 8。作为经典主机模拟器，持续更新和跨平台支持吸引复古游戏爱好者。
uses: 复古游戏玩家：在 PC、手机等设备上重温 Dreamcast 经典游戏。
开发者：研究模拟器实现或贡献代码，改进兼容性。
街机爱好者：体验 Naomi 和 Atomiswave 街机游戏。

en.tag: Multi-platform Sega Dreamcast/Naomi emulator
en.what: Flycast is a multi-platform emulator for Sega Dreamcast, Naomi, Naomi 2, and Atomiswave arcade systems. Derived from reicast, it offers high compatibility and performance across various devices.
en.content: The repository contains emulator source code, build configurations, documentation, and CI workflows. It supports platforms like Android, Windows, Linux, macOS, Switch, and Xbox, with stable and dev builds.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on graphics APIs like OpenGL/Vulkan, and integrates various platform SDKs. Build system uses CMake with CI for multiple platforms.
en.hot: Gained 10 stars today, total 2470, ranking #8 on C++ daily trending. As a classic console emulator, continuous updates and cross-platform support attract retro gaming enthusiasts.
uses: Retro gamers: replay classic Dreamcast games on PC, mobile, etc.
Developers: study emulator implementation or contribute code to improve compatibility.
Arcade enthusiasts: experience Naomi and Atomiswave arcade games.

zh.tag: 多核友好的刚体物理与碰撞检测库
zh.what: Jolt Physics 是一个用 C++ 编写的刚体物理和碰撞检测库，专为游戏和 VR 应用设计。它强调多核友好，支持在后台线程加载/卸载物理体，并允许碰撞查询与物理模拟并行运行。已被《地平线：西之绝境》和《死亡搁浅2》等大作采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的物理引擎源码、示例程序（Samples）、文档（Docs）以及构建脚本。示例涵盖 ragdoll 堆叠等演示，并配有 YouTube 视频链接。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖，支持多平台（Windows、Linux、macOS、Android、iOS 等）。使用 CMake 构建，并集成了 CI（GitHub Actions）和代码质量检查（SonarCloud）。
zh.hot: 因其高性能和已被 3A 大作采用而备受关注，Star 数已超 1.1 万，今日新增 9 个，位列 C++ 日榜第 9。
uses: 游戏开发者：需要高性能物理引擎的 3A 或独立游戏项目。
VR 应用开发者：需要实时、精确的物理模拟。
研究/学习：对物理引擎内部实现感兴趣，或希望学习多线程物理模拟。

en.tag: Multi-core friendly rigid body physics and collision detection library
en.what: Jolt Physics is a rigid body physics and collision detection library written in C++, designed for games and VR applications. It emphasizes multi-core friendliness, supporting background loading/unloading of physics bodies and parallel collision queries with the simulation. It is used by major titles like Horizon Forbidden West and Death Stranding 2.
en.content: The repository contains the full physics engine source code, sample programs (Samples), documentation (Docs), and build scripts. Samples include demos like ragdoll piles, with links to YouTube videos.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with no external dependencies, supporting multiple platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, etc.). Built with CMake, integrated with CI (GitHub Actions) and code quality checks (SonarCloud).
en.hot: It gains attention for its high performance and adoption by AAA titles, with over 11k stars and 9 new stars today, ranking 9th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Game developers: for AAA or indie projects requiring a high-performance physics engine.
VR application developers: needing real-time, accurate physics simulation.
Researchers/learners: interested in physics engine internals or multi-threaded physics simulation.

zh.tag: NVIDIA 推理通信加速库，为 Dynamo 等框架优化点对点传输
zh.what: NIXL 是 NVIDIA 推出的推理传输库，旨在加速 AI 推理框架（如 Dynamo）中的点对点通信。它通过模块化插件架构，抽象了多种内存（CPU/GPU）和存储（文件、块、对象存储）类型，提供统一的数据传输接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 库、Python API 绑定、文档（架构、后端开发指南、遥测等）、以及基准测试工具（NIXLBench 和 KVBench）。
zh.stack: 基于 C++20，依赖 UCX 和 GDRCopy 以获得最佳性能，提供 PyPI 包（nixl），支持 CUDA 12/13 后端自动选择。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方库，与 Dynamo 生态紧密相关，专为推理场景优化，填补了推理通信库的空白，尽管 star 数不高但增长稳定。
uses: AI 推理框架开发者，需要高效点对点通信
NVIDIA Dynamo 用户，优化多 GPU 推理性能
系统工程师，构建跨内存/存储类型的数据传输层

en.tag: NVIDIA's inference communication acceleration library for point-to-point transfers in AI frameworks
en.what: NIXL is NVIDIA's inference transfer library designed to accelerate point-to-point communications in AI inference frameworks like Dynamo. It abstracts various memory (CPU/GPU) and storage (file, block, object store) types through a modular plug-in architecture, providing a unified data transfer interface.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ library, Python API bindings, documentation (architecture, backend guide, telemetry), and benchmark tools (NIXLBench and KVBench).
en.stack: Built on C++20, depends on UCX and GDRCopy for maximum performance, available via PyPI (nixl) with automatic CUDA 12/13 backend selection.
en.hot: As an official NVIDIA library closely tied to the Dynamo ecosystem, it fills a gap in inference-specific communication libraries, showing steady growth despite modest star count.
uses: Developers of AI inference frameworks needing efficient point-to-point communication
NVIDIA Dynamo users optimizing multi-GPU inference performance
Systems engineers building data transfer layers across memory/storage types

zh.tag: ROCm 系统项目统一超级仓库，加速 PyTorch 构建
zh.what: 这是一个将多个 ROCm 系统项目整合到单一仓库的超级仓库，旨在简化开发、CI 和集成流程。首批项目聚焦于构建 PyTorch 所需的基础组件，如 AMD SMI、ROCm 核心库和调试工具等。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个已迁移完成的组件，如 amdsmi、aqlprofile、clr、hip、hip-tests、rdc、rocdbgapi、rocdecode、rocjpeg、rocm-core、rocminfo、rocm-smi-lib、rocprofiler 等，每个组件都有对应的 CI 状态和迁移状态。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 ROCm 生态，包括 HIP、ROCm 核心库和调试工具，并利用 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为 ROCm 官方超级仓库，它集中管理多个关键系统项目，简化了 PyTorch 在 AMD GPU 上的构建流程，吸引了 464 颗星并登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: AMD GPU 开发者：需要构建或定制 PyTorch 的 ROCm 版本
系统集成者：希望统一管理 ROCm 系统组件和 CI 流程
性能优化工程师：使用 rocprofiler 等工具进行性能分析

en.tag: Super-repo consolidating ROCm systems projects for streamlined PyTorch builds
en.what: This is a super-repo that consolidates multiple ROCm systems projects into a single repository to streamline development, CI, and integration. The initial set of projects focuses on the requirements for building PyTorch, including AMD SMI, ROCm core libraries, and debugging tools.
en.content: The repository contains multiple fully migrated components such as amdsmi, aqlprofile, clr, hip, hip-tests, rdc, rocdbgapi, rocdecode, rocjpeg, rocm-core, rocminfo, rocm-smi-lib, and rocprofiler, each with its own CI and migration status.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it leverages the ROCm ecosystem including HIP, ROCm core libraries, and debugging tools, with GitHub Actions for continuous integration.
en.hot: As the official ROCm super-repo, it centralizes management of multiple key system projects, simplifying PyTorch builds on AMD GPUs, which has attracted 464 stars and a spot on the C++ trending list.
uses: AMD GPU developers: need to build or customize PyTorch with ROCm support
System integrators: want to manage ROCm system components and CI in one place
Performance engineers: use tools like rocprofiler for profiling

zh.tag: 极速 C++ 日志库，头文件或编译可用
zh.what: spdlog 是一个极速的 C++ 日志库，支持头文件模式和编译模式，提供丰富的格式化、异步日志、多线程/单线程日志器以及多种日志目标（如控制台、文件、syslog 等）。它基于 fmt 库实现格式化，性能优异，并支持运行时和编译时日志级别过滤。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件目录（include/spdlog）、示例代码（example）、CMake 构建配置，以及支持多种平台和包管理器（如 apt、brew、vcpkg 等）的安装说明。
zh.stack: C++11 及以上，依赖 fmt 库（用于格式化），可选支持异步模式。构建系统为 CMake。
zh.hot: 拥有近 3 万 star，是 C++ 社区最受欢迎的日志库之一，因其高性能、易用性和丰富的功能而广受好评。
uses: C++ 开发者需要高性能日志记录时
需要跨平台日志解决方案（Linux、Windows、macOS 等）
需要异步日志或自定义日志目标的场景
作为依赖库集成到大型 C++ 项目中

en.tag: Fast C++ logging library, header-only or compiled
en.what: spdlog is a fast C++ logging library supporting header-only and compiled modes. It offers feature-rich formatting via fmt, asynchronous logging, multi/single-threaded loggers, and various sinks (console, files, syslog, etc.). It provides runtime and compile-time log level filtering.
en.content: The repo contains the header directory (include/spdlog), examples (example), CMake build configuration, and installation instructions for multiple platforms and package managers (apt, brew, vcpkg, etc.).
en.stack: C++11 or later, depends on the fmt library for formatting, optional async mode. Build system: CMake.
en.hot: With nearly 30k stars, it's one of the most popular C++ logging libraries, praised for its high performance, ease of use, and rich features.
uses: C++ developers needing high-performance logging
Cross-platform logging solutions (Linux, Windows, macOS, etc.)
Scenarios requiring async logging or custom sinks
Integration as a dependency in large C++ projects

zh.tag: Google 跨语言结构化数据序列化协议
zh.what: Protocol Buffers 是 Google 开发的跨语言、跨平台的数据交换格式，用于高效序列化结构化数据。它通过定义 .proto 文件，自动生成多种语言的代码，实现数据的快速编码与解码。
zh.content: 仓库包含协议编译器（protoc）的 C++ 实现、各语言运行时库、以及丰富的文档和构建配置（如 Bazel 和 CMake）。
zh.stack: 核心使用 C++ 编写，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建，并集成 OpenSSF Scorecard 安全评估。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，被无数项目和系统依赖，star 数高达 7 万+，持续稳定更新。
uses: 后端服务间通信协议定义（如 gRPC）
大数据与分布式系统的数据存储与交换
跨语言 API 开发，需要高效序列化的场景
学习高性能序列化设计与实现

en.tag: Google's language-neutral data serialization protocol
en.what: Protocol Buffers is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It uses .proto files to generate code in multiple languages for efficient encoding and decoding.
en.content: The repository contains the C++ implementation of the protocol compiler (protoc), runtime libraries for various languages, and extensive documentation and build configurations (e.g., Bazel and CMake).
en.stack: Core written in C++, built with Bazel and CMake, and integrated with OpenSSF Scorecard for security assessment.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, it is relied upon by countless projects and systems, with over 70k stars and continuous stable updates.
uses: Defining communication protocols between backend services (e.g., gRPC)
Data storage and exchange in big data and distributed systems
Cross-language API development requiring efficient serialization
Learning high-performance serialization design and implementation

zh.tag: 每秒解析数GB JSON的高性能C++库
zh.what: simdjson 是一个利用 SIMD 指令和微并行算法实现超高速 JSON 解析的 C++ 库。它比 RapidJSON 快 4 倍以上，比 JSON for Modern C++ 快 25 倍，同时保持完整的 JSON 和 UTF-8 验证。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的库源码、文档、性能测试、绑定和移植（如 Python、Go、Rust 等），以及真实世界使用案例列表。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 实现，利用 SIMD 指令集（如 AVX2、NEON），支持运行时自动选择 CPU 适配的解析器。
zh.hot: 虽然今日新增 star 不多，但累计 24k+ star 且被 Node.js、ClickHouse、Meta Velox 等重量级项目采用，证明了其作为 JSON 解析基础设施的不可替代性。
uses: 需要极致 JSON 解析性能的服务端开发，如 API 网关、日志处理
数据库和数据处理引擎（如 ClickHouse、Doris）的 JSON 解析层
移动端或嵌入式环境，利用 SIMD 加速 JSON 解析
语言绑定或移植的开发者，为其他语言提供高性能 JSON 能力

en.tag: High-performance C++ library parsing gigabytes of JSON per second
en.what: simdjson is a C++ library that leverages SIMD instructions and microparallel algorithms to parse JSON at blazing speed. It is over 4x faster than RapidJSON and 25x faster than JSON for Modern C++, while maintaining full JSON and UTF-8 validation.
en.content: The repository contains full library source code, documentation, performance benchmarks, bindings and ports (e.g., Python, Go, Rust), and a list of real-world usage examples.
en.stack: Implemented in C++, leveraging SIMD instruction sets (e.g., AVX2, NEON), with runtime auto-selection of CPU-tailored parsers.
en.hot: Despite modest daily stars, its 24k+ total stars and adoption by heavyweights like Node.js, ClickHouse, and Meta Velox underscore its indispensable role as JSON parsing infrastructure.
uses: Server-side development requiring extreme JSON parsing performance, e.g., API gateways, log processing
JSON parsing layer in databases and data processing engines (e.g., ClickHouse, Doris)
Mobile or embedded environments leveraging SIMD for JSON parsing acceleration
Developers creating bindings or ports to bring high-performance JSON to other languages

zh.tag: GNU 编译器套件，C/C++ 等语言的工业级编译器
zh.what: GCC 是 GNU 编译器套件，包含 C、C++、Fortran、Ada 等语言的编译器，以及相关的运行时库和工具。它是自由软件，广泛用于构建操作系统、应用程序和嵌入式系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GCC 的完整源代码，包括编译器前端、后端、运行时库（如 libstdc++）、文档（如 gcc/doc/）和安装说明（INSTALL 目录）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，也包含 C、Ada、Fortran 等语言的代码。构建依赖 GNU Make、GNU Bison、Flex 等工具。
zh.hot: GCC 是编译器领域的基石，持续维护和更新。虽然今日新增 star 不多，但长期保持高关注度，是开发者必备的工具链。
uses: 系统程序员：编译 Linux 内核和系统软件
嵌入式开发者：交叉编译用于 ARM、RISC-V 等架构
编译器爱好者：学习编译器实现和优化技术
开源贡献者：参与大型 C++ 项目的开发

en.tag: GNU Compiler Collection, industrial-grade compilers for C/C++ and more
en.what: GCC is the GNU Compiler Collection, containing compilers for C, C++, Fortran, Ada, and other languages, along with related runtime libraries and tools. It is free software widely used to build operating systems, applications, and embedded systems.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of GCC, including compiler frontends, backends, runtime libraries (e.g., libstdc++), documentation (e.g., gcc/doc/), and installation instructions (INSTALL directory).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with code in C, Ada, Fortran, etc. Build dependencies include GNU Make, GNU Bison, Flex, and other tools.
en.hot: GCC is a cornerstone in the compiler field, continuously maintained and updated. Although today's star increase is modest, it maintains high long-term attention as an essential toolchain for developers.
uses: System programmers: compile Linux kernel and system software
Embedded developers: cross-compile for ARM, RISC-V, etc.
Compiler enthusiasts: learn compiler implementation and optimization techniques
Open source contributors: participate in large C++ project development

zh.tag: 开源回合制奇幻策略游戏，经典之作
zh.what: 《韦诺之战》是一款开源、回合制的战术策略游戏，背景设定在高奇幻世界。游戏包含单人战役和多人对战（在线或本地热座），玩家需要指挥军队、管理资源，完成各种任务。

游戏开发学习者，可研究其架构、AI 和模组系统。

en.tag: Open-source turn-based fantasy strategy game, a classic
en.what: The Battle for Wesnoth is an open-source, turn-based tactical strategy game set in a high fantasy world. It features single-player campaigns and multiplayer battles (online or hotseat), where players command armies and manage resources to complete quests.
en.content: The repository contains the full game source code, assets (sprites, animations, music), a map editor, multiple campaigns, and modding support. The project is well-organized with build/install instructions and supports multiple platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, mobile).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, using SDL, Boost, and other libraries, with CMake as the build system. It also uses Lua for modding and AI, and Python for tools and build scripts.

uses: Players who enjoy strategy and fantasy games, offering rich campaigns and multiplayer battles.
Game development learners can study its architecture, AI, and modding system.
Open-source contributors can participate in translation, testing, art, or code development.

zh.tag: 跨平台 PS4 模拟器，C++ 编写，早期阶段
zh.what: shadPS4 是一个用 C++ 编写的 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它目前处于早期开发阶段，但已经能够运行《血源诅咒》《黑暗之魂重制版》等游戏。该项目提供模拟器核心，用户可通过 QtLauncher 图形界面使用。

en.tag: Cross-platform PS4 emulator in C++, early stage
en.what: shadPS4 is a PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD. It is in early development but can already run games like Bloodborne and Dark Souls Remastered. The project provides the emulator core, with a QtLauncher GUI for end users.

Emulator developers: research PS4 hardware/architecture, contribute to open source
Tech enthusiasts: track progress, test compatibility, report issues

zh.tag: C++ 即时模式 GUI 库，零依赖高性能
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个为 C++ 设计的轻量级图形用户界面库，采用即时模式（immediate mode）范式，输出优化后的顶点缓冲区，可随时在 3D 渲染管线中绘制。它旨在快速迭代，帮助程序员构建内容创作工具、可视化工具和调试工具，而非面向终端用户的常规 UI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Dear ImGui 的核心源码、示例、文档、构建配置（如 CMake）以及测试相关文件。核心代码位于根目录，包括 imgui.cpp、imgui.h 等，另有 examples/ 目录提供多种后端集成示例。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖，支持 OpenGL、DirectX、Vulkan 等多种渲染后端，通过后端适配器集成。
zh.hot: 拥有 75k+ star，是 C++ 社区最受欢迎的 GUI 库之一，因其轻量、高效和易用性而广受游戏开发、工具开发者的青睐。今日新增 32 star，持续保持热度。
uses: 游戏开发中的调试工具和编辑器界面
内容创作工具（如关卡编辑器、动画工具）
可视化工具和数据监控面板
需要快速原型 UI 的 C++ 项目

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++. It outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered anytime in a 3D-pipeline-enabled application. It is designed for fast iterations, empowering programmers to create content creation tools, visualization/debug tools, rather than typical end-user UI.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code, examples, documentation, build configurations (e.g., CMake), and test-related files. Core code is in the root directory (imgui.cpp, imgui.h, etc.), with an examples/ directory providing integration demos for various backends.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with no external dependencies, supporting multiple rendering backends like OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, integrated via backend adapters.
en.hot: With 75k+ stars, it's one of the most popular GUI libraries in the C++ community, favored by game developers and tool builders for its lightweight, efficient, and easy-to-use design. Gaining 32 stars today, it remains highly popular.
uses: Debug tools and editor UIs in game development
Content creation tools (e.g., level editors, animation tools)
Visualization tools and data monitoring dashboards
C++ projects needing rapid UI prototyping

zh.tag: 在 Windows 上原生运行 Linux 的官方子系统
zh.what: WSL 是微软官方的 Windows 子系统，允许用户在 Windows 上直接运行 Linux 命令行工具、实用程序和应用程序，无需传统虚拟机或双系统。它提供完整的 Linux 内核兼容层，并支持 GUI 应用（通过 WSLg）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WSL 的源代码、构建脚本、文档和贡献指南，以及相关的子仓库链接（如 WSL2-Linux-Kernel 和 WSLg）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Windows 内核接口和 Linux 内核组件，涉及系统级编程和虚拟化技术。
zh.hot: WSL 是开发者必备工具，今日新增 14 星，总星数超 3.3 万，持续受到 Windows 开发者社区的广泛关注。
uses: Windows 开发者：在 Windows 上无缝使用 Linux 工具链和脚本
跨平台开发：无需虚拟机即可测试和运行 Linux 应用
学习 Linux：在 Windows 上体验 Linux 环境，降低门槛
DevOps 工程师：在 Windows 上运行容器和自动化任务

en.tag: Official subsystem to run Linux natively on Windows
en.what: WSL is Microsoft's official subsystem that lets users run Linux command-line tools, utilities, and applications directly on Windows without a traditional VM or dual-boot setup. It provides a full Linux kernel compatibility layer and supports GUI apps via WSLg.
en.content: The repo contains WSL source code, build scripts, documentation, contribution guidelines, and links to related sub-repos like WSL2-Linux-Kernel and WSLg.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on Windows kernel interfaces and Linux kernel components, involving system-level programming and virtualization.
en.hot: WSL is a must-have tool for developers, gaining 14 stars today and over 33k total, consistently popular among the Windows developer community.
uses: Windows developers: seamlessly use Linux toolchains and scripts on Windows
Cross-platform development: test and run Linux apps without a VM
Linux learners: experience Linux environment on Windows with low barrier
DevOps engineers: run containers and automation tasks on Windows

zh.tag: 工业级 C++ RPC 框架，高性能服务基石
zh.what: bRPC 是 Apache 基金会下的工业级 C++ RPC 框架，专为搜索、存储、机器学习等高并发场景设计。它支持多种协议（如 HTTP/gRPC/Redis/Thrift）同端口提供服务，并内置了同步/异步调用、组合通道、服务治理和性能分析等能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源码、文档（中英文）、示例代码、测试以及构建脚本。核心库位于 src/brpc 目录，提供服务器、客户端、协议实现和工具类。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11，依赖 protobuf、gflags、gtest 等常见库，支持 Linux 和 macOS。可选集成 gRPC、Thrift、RDMA 等。
zh.hot: 作为 Apache 顶级项目，bRPC 在 GitHub 上拥有 17.5k+ stars，是 C++ RPC 领域的标杆。其高性能、多协议支持和丰富的功能使其成为众多互联网公司的首选。
uses: 后端服务开发：构建高并发、低延迟的分布式服务
微服务架构：作为服务间通信的基础设施
性能敏感场景：如广告推荐、搜索排序等
学习研究：了解工业级 RPC 框架的设计与实现

en.tag: Industrial-grade C++ RPC framework for high-performance systems
en.what: bRPC is an industrial-grade C++ RPC framework under the Apache Foundation, designed for high-concurrency scenarios like search, storage, and machine learning. It supports multiple protocols (HTTP/gRPC/Redis/Thrift) on the same port, and includes sync/async calls, combo channels, service governance, and profiling tools.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, docs (in Chinese and English), examples, tests, and build scripts. The core library is in src/brpc, providing server, client, protocol implementations, and utilities.
en.stack: Built on C++11, depends on protobuf, gflags, gtest, etc. Supports Linux and macOS. Optional integrations with gRPC, Thrift, RDMA.
en.hot: As an Apache top-level project, bRPC has 17.5k+ stars on GitHub, setting the standard for C++ RPC. Its high performance, multi-protocol support, and rich features make it a top choice for many internet companies.
uses: Backend service development: build high-concurrency, low-latency distributed services
Microservices architecture: as the communication infrastructure between services
Performance-critical scenarios: ads recommendation, search ranking, etc.
Learning: study the design and implementation of an industrial-grade RPC framework

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 打造 29 种编辑级图表，纯 HTML+SVG
zh.what: 这是一个 Claude Code 技能（skill），能生成 29 种编辑级质量的图表，如架构图、流程图、时序图等。所有图表均为自包含的 HTML+SVG，无外部依赖，可直接在浏览器打开。它还能将 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源文件重绘为指定格式、尺寸和细节级别。

en.tag: 29 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, self-contained HTML+SVG
en.what: A Claude Code skill that generates 29 editorial-quality diagram types, including architecture, flowchart, sequence, and more. zh.tag: DHH 出品的精美现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是由 DHH 打造的一款注重美观与现代感的 Linux 发行版，内置大量精选工具和配置，提供开箱即用的体验。它强调“有主见”的设计，通过详尽的官方手册指导用户完成从安装到日常使用的全过程。

希望快速上手一套完整、现代化 Linux 环境的用户
对 DHH 个人开发风格和理念感兴趣的粉丝

en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution crafted by DHH, focusing on beauty and modernity, with a curated set of tools and configurations for an out-of-the-box experience. It emphasizes an opinionated design, guiding users through everything from installation to daily use with an extensive official manual.

Users who want to quickly adopt a complete, modern Linux environment
Fans interested in DHH's personal development style and philosophy
Learners who need a comprehensive Linux configuration guide

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源图原生上下文与决策基础设施
zh.what: Semantica 是一个图原生的基础设施，用于构建上下文感知且可问责的 AI 系统。它能够摄取企业数据，提取关键信息，构建上下文图与知识图谱，并支持图分析和因果推理，同时内置完整的决策溯源。该系统强调可解释、可追踪和可信赖，专为高风险和受监管领域设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档和示例，支持多语言图存储（RDF 和 LPG），遵循 W3C 标准，提供本体管理和知识建模功能。项目采用模块化设计，便于自托管和审计。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python（3.8+），依赖图数据库和知识图谱技术，支持 RDF 和 LPG 存储，遵循 W3C 标准。可能涉及因果推理和决策智能相关库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1102 星，总星数达 3323，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 13 名。其定位为“AI 代理的开源 Palantir”，填补了企业级上下文管理和决策溯源的需求，在 AI 信任与合规领域引发关注。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要为代理系统构建可解释、可审计的上下文管理平台。
受监管行业（金融、医疗）：要求决策可追溯、符合合规要求。
知识图谱开发者：希望利用图原生基础设施进行知识建模和因果推理。

en.tag: Open-source graph-native infrastructure for context and accountable AI systems

en.content: The repository contains the mlx_lm package with command-line tools (e.g., mlx_lm.generate and mlx_lm.chat) and a Python API for loading, generating, quantizing, and converting models. It also includes examples and documentation.
en.stack: Built on MLX (Apple's machine learning framework), written in Python, and depends on Hugging Face Hub and transformers libraries.
en.hot: With 120 stars added this week and 6,702 total, it ranks #16 on GitHub Trending (Python) this week. It allows Apple users to easily run and fine-tune LLMs locally without cloud GPUs, making it popular among Mac users.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally for privacy and offline use.
Developers who need to quickly test or fine-tune models from Hugging Face with quantization support.
Researchers performing low-rank or full fine-tuning, leveraging distributed capabilities on Apple silicon.

zh.tag: 一条命令微调大模型，无需SSH和复杂配置
zh.what: Soup 是一个命令行工具，让你通过一个 YAML 配置文件即可完成大语言模型的微调与后训练。它简化了训练流程，无需管理 SSH 或复杂配置，一条命令即可启动训练。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包 soup-cli，提供命令行接口、配置解析、训练执行等功能，并附带文档、示例配置和测试。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10-3.12，依赖 PyTorch 等训练库，支持流式层训练以降低显存占用。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1786 星，总星数达 2529，因其让 8B 模型可在 4GB 显存笔记本上微调，大幅降低门槛而爆火。
uses: 个人开发者：在本地笔记本上微调小模型，无需昂贵云GPU
研究人员：快速实验不同配置，无需繁琐环境搭建
教育场景：教学演示LLM微调流程，降低学习门槛

en.tag: Fine-tune LLMs with one command, no SSH or config hell
en.what: Soup is a CLI tool that lets you fine-tune and post-train LLMs using a single YAML config file. It simplifies the training workflow, eliminating SSH and configuration complexity—one command starts the training.
en.content: The repo contains the Python package soup-cli, offering CLI, config parsing, and training execution, along with docs, example configs, and tests.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.10-3.12, relies on PyTorch and other training libraries, supports layer streaming to reduce memory usage.
en.hot: Gained 1786 stars this week (total 2529), going viral for enabling fine-tuning of 8B models on a 4GB laptop GPU, dramatically lowering the barrier.
uses: Individual developers: fine-tune small models on local laptops without expensive cloud GPUs
Researchers: quickly experiment with different configs without complex environment setup
Educational settings: demonstrate LLM fine-tuning workflows with a low learning curve

zh.tag: 规范驱动开发工具包，让 AI 编码代理按规格构建软件
zh.what: Spec Kit 是一个开源工具包，帮助开发者在使用任何 AI 编码代理时，先定义规范再编写代码，从而构建高质量软件。它提供了一套可执行的规范驱动流程，使规范直接生成可工作的实现，而非仅仅作为指导。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Specify CLI 工具、文档、示例、扩展与预设（presets），以及基于角色的捆绑包（bundles），支持多种 AI 编码代理集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 uv 进行安装，可通过 git 或 PyPI 安装 specify-cli 包。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3535 星，总星数超 13 万，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 16 名，因其理念新颖且由 GitHub 官方推出，引发广泛关注。
uses: 使用 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望通过规范驱动流程提升代码质量
团队希望统一开发流程，确保 AI 生成代码符合业务需求
对规范驱动开发（SDD）方法论感兴趣的技术人员

en.tag: Spec-driven development toolkit for building software with any AI coding agent
en.what: Spec Kit is an open-source toolkit that helps developers define specifications before coding when using any AI coding agent, enabling high-quality software development. It provides an executable spec-driven process where specifications directly generate working implementations rather than just guiding them.
en.content: The repository includes the Specify CLI tool, documentation, examples, extensions and presets, and role-based bundles, with integrations for various AI coding agents.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, requires uv for installation, and the specify-cli package is available via git or PyPI.
en.hot: With 3,535 new stars this week and over 130k total, it ranks #16 on GitHub Trending (Python). Its novel concept and official GitHub backing have sparked significant interest.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents who want to improve code quality through spec-driven processes
Teams looking to standardize development workflows and ensure AI-generated code meets business requirements
Technologists interested in the Spec-Driven Development (SDD) methodology

zh.tag: 让所有软件原生支持AI代理的CLI生成与托管平台
zh.what: CLI-Anything 是一个将任意软件（GUI或API）转化为AI代理可调用的命令行接口（CLI）的框架。它通过自动生成CLI包装器，使AI代理能够像人类一样操作软件，并支持预览、实时反馈和轨迹循环，从而生成真实产物（如CAD模型、3D场景等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心Python库、CLI-Hub（社区CLI市场，可浏览/安装/管理）、18个应用演示、2461个通过的测试、技术报告（arXiv）及贡献指南。
zh.stack: 基于Python（≥3.10），依赖Click（≥8.0）构建CLI，使用pytest进行单元与端到端测试，输出支持JSON及人类可读格式。
zh.hot: 本周新增924星，总星数近4.8万，位列Python周榜第17。它解决了AI代理与现有软件之间的关键鸿沟，提供即装即用的CLI-Hub，社区贡献活跃，技术报告和丰富演示增强了可信度。
uses: AI代理开发者：快速为任意软件生成CLI，使代理能操作真实应用
软件用户：通过CLI-Hub安装社区CLI，用自然语言或脚本控制软件
贡献者：为特定软件构建CLI包装器，加入社区并获得认可
研究者：探索代理-软件交互，参考技术报告和测试结果

en.tag: Make all software agent-native via auto-generated CLIs and a community hub
en.what: CLI-Anything is a framework that converts any software (GUI or API) into command-line interfaces (CLIs) callable by AI agents. It auto-generates CLI wrappers, enabling agents to operate software like humans, with preview, live feedback, and trajectory loops to produce real artifacts (e.g., CAD models, 3D scenes).
en.content: The repo includes the core Python library, CLI-Hub (community CLI marketplace for browsing/installing/managing), 18 app demos, 2,461 passing tests, a tech report (arXiv), and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built with Python (≥3.10), uses Click (≥8.0) for CLI construction, pytest for unit and e2e tests, and outputs in JSON plus human-readable formats.
en.hot: With 924 stars added this week and ~47.8k total, ranking #17 on Python weekly, it bridges the critical gap between AI agents and existing software. The plug-and-play CLI-Hub, active community contributions, tech report, and rich demos boost its appeal.
uses: AI agent developers: quickly generate CLIs for any software to let agents operate real apps
Software users: install community CLIs via CLI-Hub to control software via natural language or scripts
Contributors: build CLI wrappers for specific software, join the community and gain recognition
Researchers: explore agent-software interaction, referencing the tech report and test results

zh.tag: 开源智能体操作系统，让 AI 代理自主运行
zh.what: elizaOS 是一个开源的 TypeScript 框架和产品栈，用于构建和运行自主 AI 代理。它提供核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务和原生桥接，支持从聊天、语音到设备控制等多种能力。
zh.content: 该仓库是一个 monorepo，包含核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务、原生桥接和第一方插件。可引导的 Linux 和 Android 发行版在单独的 elizaOS/os 仓库中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Bun 和 Node.js，使用 Turbo 进行构建，支持子模块和补丁。
zh.hot: 本周新增 115 颗星，总星数达 19064，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 19 名。其“智能体操作系统”的定位和全栈能力吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者：使用 CLI 和文档构建自定义 AI 代理或插件
企业：通过 Eliza Cloud 部署和管理 AI 代理
个人用户：下载 Eliza 应用用于个人助理、自动化等场景
研究者：探索自主代理和操作系统级集成的可能性

en.tag: Open-source agentic operating system for autonomous AI agents
en.what: elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for building and running autonomous AI agents. It provides a core runtime, the Eliza app, CLI, cloud services, and native bridges, enabling capabilities from chat and voice to device control.
en.content: This repository is a monorepo containing the core runtime, the Eliza app, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, and first-party plugins. Bootable Linux and Android distributions live in a separate elizaOS/os repository.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Bun and Node.js dependencies, built using Turbo, supporting submodules and patches.
en.hot: Gained 115 stars this week, reaching 19,064 total, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) weekly. Its positioning as an 'agentic operating system' with full-stack capabilities attracts many developers.
uses: Developers: build custom AI agents or plugins using the CLI and docs
Enterprises: deploy and manage AI agents via Eliza Cloud
Individuals: download the Eliza app for personal assistant, automation, etc.
Researchers: explore autonomous agents and OS-level integration

zh.tag: 无限画布上的终端与AI代理管理器
zh.what: nodeterm 是一个基于节点的终端管理器，将多个真实终端作为可拖拽节点放在无限画布上，支持平移和缩放。它专为 AI 编码代理设计，每个项目可变成 Trello 风格的看板，展示并行的 Claude Code 会话。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面应用（macOS/Linux）、自托管浏览器版（Server Edition）和 iOS 伴侣应用，共享同一服务层。提供安装包（.dmg、.AppImage、.deb）、文档、架构说明和源码构建指南。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 和 TypeScript，使用 tmux 作为终端后端。支持 macOS (arm64/x64) 和 Linux (x64)，浏览器版通过服务端部署，iOS 伴侣应用可附加到同一会话。
zh.hot: 今日新增 78 星，总星数 956，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（TypeScript）第 9 名。其独特卖点在于用空间画布替代传统标签页，专为 ADHD 和分散工作流设计，同时深度集成 AI 代理，切中开发者痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：需要并行管理多个 Claude Code 会话，以看板形式跟踪进度。
多任务开发者：在无限画布上组织多个终端，避免标签页混乱，保持上下文。
远程工作场景：通过 Server Edition 在浏览器中访问同一画布，或使用 iOS 伴侣应用随时查看。
ADHD 或偏好视觉化工作流的人群：用空间布局代替隐藏标签，提升专注和效率。

en.tag: Terminal & AI agent manager on an infinite canvas
en.what: nodeterm is a node-based terminal manager that places multiple real terminals as draggable nodes on an infinite pan/zoom canvas. Built for AI coding agents, it turns every project into a Trello-style board of live Claude Code sessions.
en.content: The repo includes an Electron desktop app (macOS/Linux), a self-hosted browser version (Server Edition), and an iOS companion, all sharing a common service seam. It provides installers (.dmg, .AppImage, .deb), docs, architecture notes, and build-from-source instructions.
en.stack: Built with Electron and TypeScript, using tmux for terminal backend. Supports macOS (arm64/x64) and Linux (x64), with a browser Server Edition and an iOS companion that attaches to the same live sessions.
en.hot: Gained 78 stars today, reaching 956 total, ranking #9 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) daily. Its unique selling point is replacing stacked tabs with a spatial canvas, designed for ADHD and scattered workflows, while deeply integrating AI agents—hitting a nerve with developers.
uses: AI coding agent users: need to manage multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, tracking progress via a kanban board.
Multitasking developers: organize multiple terminals on an infinite canvas to avoid tab clutter and maintain context.
Remote work scenarios: access the same canvas via the browser Server Edition or check in with the iOS companion.
People with ADHD or visual workflow preferences: spatial layout replaces hidden tabs, boosting focus and efficiency.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理统一工作台，运行任意代理并共享记忆与工具
zh.what: holaOS 是一个开源的 All-in-One AI 代理工作台，让你在同一个本地优先的工作空间中运行 Claude Code、Codex 或内置的 holaOS 代理。它整合了 100+ 集成和 MCP，支持跨工具、应用、浏览器和文件操作，并提供共享记忆。内置前沿模型，也支持自带 API 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面应用（支持 macOS、Windows、Linux）、TypeScript 运行时、文档和示例配置。核心功能包括多代理并行运行、统一记忆、技能与集成市场，以及本地优先的数据存储。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 和 TypeScript 构建，支持跨平台桌面。依赖 MCP（模型上下文协议）和 100+ 第三方集成，内置模型或 BYOK。
zh.hot: 本周新增超 4300 星，总星数破万，登上 TypeScript 周榜第六。它解决了 AI 代理碎片化问题，让用户无需切换即可使用多个代理并共享上下文，契合当前多代理工作流趋势。
uses: 开发者：在统一工作台中对比使用 Claude Code 和 Codex，无需切换环境
AI 重度用户：通过共享记忆和工具链，跨应用和文件自动化复杂任务
团队：利用本地优先特性，在保证数据隐私的前提下协作 AI 工作流

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace to run any agent with shared memory & tools
en.what: holaOS is an open-source All-in-One AI agent workspace that lets you run Claude Code, Codex, or the built-in holaOS agent in one local-first workspace. It integrates 100+ tools and MCP, operates across apps, browser, and files, with shared memory. Frontier models are built in, or you can bring your own keys.
en.content: The repo contains an Electron desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux), TypeScript runtime, docs, and example configs. Key features include running multiple agents side-by-side, unified memory, skills & integrations marketplace, and local-first data storage.
en.stack: Built with Electron and TypeScript for cross-platform desktop. Leverages MCP (Model Context Protocol) and 100+ third-party integrations, with built-in models or BYOK.
en.hot: Gained 4,300+ stars this week, surpassing 10k total and ranking #6 on TypeScript weekly. It solves AI agent fragmentation by letting users run multiple agents with shared context, aligning with the multi-agent workflow trend.
uses: Developers: compare and use Claude Code and Codex in one workspace without switching
Power users: automate complex tasks across apps and files with shared memory and tools
Teams: collaborate on AI workflows with local-first privacy

zh.tag: 隐私优先的开源简历生成器
zh.what: Reactive Resume 是一款免费开源的简历生成器，简化了创建、更新和分享简历的流程。它提供多种模板，用户填写信息后即可导出为 PDF，无需注册账户即可使用基本功能。该应用以隐私为核心，用户完全拥有自己的数据，且支持自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用（apps/web）、后端服务（apps/server）以及相关文档，采用 monorepo 结构。支持 Docker 部署，提供多语言界面，并集成了赞助商展示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端基于 React（Next.js），后端使用 NestJS，数据库支持 PostgreSQL 和 MongoDB，使用 Docker 进行容器化部署。
zh.hot: 该项目拥有超过 4 万星标，今日新增 255 星，位列 GitHub 趋势榜（TypeScript）第 5 名。其隐私保护、开源免费和自托管特性吸引了大量用户，且持续更新维护。
uses: 求职者：快速制作专业简历并导出 PDF，无需注册。
注重隐私的用户：希望完全掌控个人数据，可自托管部署。
开发者：可定制和扩展简历生成器，或贡献代码。

en.tag: Privacy-first open-source resume builder
en.what: Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder that simplifies creating, updating, and sharing resumes. It offers templates, lets you fill in details and export to PDF, no account required for basic use. Built with privacy as a core principle, it gives users complete ownership of their data and can be self-hosted.
en.content: The repository contains a frontend app (apps/web), backend server (apps/server), and documentation, structured as a monorepo. It supports Docker deployment, offers multi-language UI, and includes sponsor showcases.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, frontend built with React (Next.js), backend with NestJS, databases support PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and Docker for containerized deployment.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 255 new stars today, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its privacy-first, open-source, free, and self-hostable features attract many users, and it is actively maintained.
uses: Job seekers: quickly create professional resumes and export to PDF without registration.
Privacy-conscious users: want full control over personal data and can self-host.
Developers: can customize and extend the resume builder or contribute code.

zh.tag: AI 模型规格、定价与能力的开源数据库
zh.what: Models.dev 是一个全面的开源 AI 模型数据库，收录了模型规格、定价和能力信息。它通过社区贡献维护，并提供 API 供开发者查询。项目内部也被 opencode 使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含按提供商和模型组织的 TOML 数据文件，以及 SVG 格式的提供商 logo。这些数据用于生成网站和 API。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，数据以 TOML 格式存储，通过 API 提供 JSON 输出。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 模型数量激增，开发者需要一个统一的模型信息源。该项目填补了这一空白，本周新增 136 星，登上 TypeScript 周榜第 9 名。
uses: 开发者查询模型规格、定价和能力，用于选型
AI 工具链集成，如 opencode 等
研究人员追踪模型发布和基准数据
社区贡献者维护和更新模型数据

en.tag: Open-source database of AI model specs, pricing, and capabilities
en.what: Models.dev is a comprehensive open-source database of AI model specifications, pricing, and capabilities. It is community-contributed and provides an API for developers. It is also used internally by opencode.
en.content: The repo contains TOML data files organized by provider and model, along with SVG logos for providers. This data powers the website and API.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, data stored in TOML, served via API as JSON.
en.hot: With the proliferation of AI models, developers need a unified source for model info. This project fills that gap, gaining 136 stars this week and ranking #9 on the TypeScript weekly trending.
uses: Developers looking up model specs, pricing, and capabilities for selection
AI toolchains integrating model data, e.g., opencode
Researchers tracking model releases and benchmarks
Community contributors maintaining and updating model data

zh.tag: 开源即时通讯与 VoIP 聊天应用
zh.what: Fluxer 是一款免费开源的即时通讯和 VoIP 聊天应用，专为朋友、群组和社区设计。它提供类似 Discord 的体验，支持文字、语音和视频通话。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端代码、静态资源（如品牌标识和截图）、文档链接以及自托管指南。目前 API 和自托管文档正在完善中，Canary 版本已可体验。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，技术栈包括实时通信、VoIP 和跨平台客户端技术。具体依赖未在摘要中列出，但项目采用 AGPLv3 许可证。
zh.hot: 凭借 10k+ stars 和 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5 名，Fluxer 因其开源、免费且功能丰富的聊天应用而受到关注，尤其是作为 Discord 的替代品。
uses: 寻找自托管聊天解决方案的社区或团队
对 Discord 替代品感兴趣的开源爱好者
需要 VoIP 和群组通信的个人用户
希望参与开发或贡献的开发者

en.tag: Open-source instant messaging & VoIP chat app
en.what: Fluxer is a free and open-source instant messaging and VoIP chat app built for friends, groups, and communities. It offers a Discord-like experience with text, voice, and video calls.
en.content: The repository contains the full client code, static assets (branding, screenshots), documentation links, and self-hosting guides. The API and self-hosting docs are being finalized, with a Canary version available for testing.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, the tech stack includes real-time communication, VoIP, and cross-platform client technologies. Specific dependencies are not listed in the summary, but the project is licensed under AGPLv3.
en.hot: With 10k+ stars and #5 on GitHub Trending daily, Fluxer gains attention as an open-source, free, feature-rich chat app, especially as a Discord alternative.
uses: Communities or teams seeking self-hosted chat solutions
Open-source enthusiasts interested in Discord alternatives
Individuals needing VoIP and group communication
Developers wanting to contribute or build upon the project

zh.tag: AI 智能体工具链：统一 LLM API、代理循环、TUI 与编程代理 CLI
zh.what: 提供模块化 AI 代理开发框架，整合多厂商 LLM API、代理运行时与终端交互界面。内置可自扩展的编程代理 CLI，支持工具调用、状态管理与交互式编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库采用 monorepo 结构，包含 pi-ai（统一 LLM 接口）、pi-agent-core（代理运行时）、pi-coding-agent（交互式编码 CLI）和 pi-tui（差分渲染终端 UI）四个核心包。README 还提供了容器化与沙箱隔离方案，以及面向人类和代理的协作规范。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 npm 管理 monorepo 依赖与生命周期脚本。支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流 LLM 提供商，并可通过 Docker 或 Gondolin micro-VM 进行容器化隔离。
zh.hot: 一周内新增 2,741 Star 使其冲上 TypeScript 周榜第 17 名，目前总 Star 数已突破 7.2 万。开发者对统一 LLM 接口与自扩展编程代理的结合表现出强烈兴趣。
uses: 需要构建多模型 AI 代理的开发者——统一接口降低集成成本
追求终端原生体验的 CLI 用户——内置 TUI 与差分渲染提升交互效率
关注代码安全隔离的团队——提供 Docker、micro-VM 等多种沙箱方案
希望人机与 AI 代理协作的项目维护者——贡献指南同时面向人类与 Agent

en.tag: AI agent toolkit with unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding agent CLI
en.what: A modular AI agent development framework that unifies multi-provider LLM APIs, agent runtime, and terminal UI. It features a self-extensible coding agent CLI with tool calling, state management, and interactive coding capabilities.

zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心引擎、桌面应用（op-host-desktop）、内置 MCP 服务器、多模型支持，以及多语言 README 和演示视频。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 构建，可能涉及 Tauri 或类似框架用于桌面应用，集成 MCP 服务器和多模型 AI 能力。
zh.hot: 作为首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，概念新颖，结合 AI 代理团队和实时生成，吸引了大量关注。今日新增 32 星，总星数达 4772，位列 Rust 趋势榜第三。
uses: 设计师和开发者：快速将想法转化为 UI 原型，提升设计效率。
产品经理：用自然语言描述需求，即时生成界面方案。
AI 爱好者：探索多智能体协作在创意工具中的应用。
开源社区：参与开发，扩展 MCP 服务器和模型集成。

en.tag: Open-source AI-native vector design tool with concurrent agent teams
en.what: OpenPencil is the world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent agent teams. Users can describe UI in natural language and watch it appear on an infinite canvas in real-time, then modify designs through chat. It embraces Design-as-Code and serves as a modern alternative to Pencil.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust-based core engine, desktop app (op-host-desktop), built-in MCP server, multi-model intelligence, along with multilingual READMEs and demo videos.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, likely using Tauri or similar for the desktop app, integrating MCP server and multi-model AI capabilities.
en.hot: As the first open-source AI-native vector design tool, its novel concept combining AI agent teams and real-time generation attracts attention. With 32 stars today and 4772 total, it ranks #3 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Designers and developers: quickly turn ideas into UI prototypes, boosting design efficiency.
Product managers: describe requirements in natural language and get instant interface proposals.
AI enthusiasts: explore multi-agent collaboration in creative tools.
Open-source community: contribute to development, extend MCP server and model integrations.

zh.tag: 本地优先的极速微虚拟机运行时与库
zh.what: Microsandbox 是一个用 Rust 编写的微虚拟机运行时，可在本地快速启动隔离环境，用于运行不受信任的工作负载，如 AI 代理、用户代码、插件、CI 任务等。它提供硬件级隔离，兼容 OCI 镜像，并支持 Docker 类似的工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的运行时库、命令行工具、Agent Skills 和 MCP 服务器集成，以及用于嵌入的 API。支持跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows），平均启动时间低于 100 毫秒。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，依赖微虚拟机技术（如 Firecracker 或类似），支持 OCI 容器镜像，并提供 MCP 服务器和 Agent Skills 集成。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的兴起，对安全隔离的需求激增，Microsandbox 提供了极速、本地优先的解决方案，star 数已达 7.4k，今日新增 100，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 7。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供安全的沙箱环境，执行代码或工具调用。
平台工程师：在 CI/CD 或插件系统中隔离不受信任的代码。
安全研究人员：测试恶意软件或不受信任的二进制文件，无需担心主机安全。
本地开发：快速启动干净的开发环境或测试环境。

en.tag: Easy, fast, local-first microVM runtime and library
en.what: Microsandbox is a Rust-based microVM runtime that quickly launches isolated environments locally for untrusted workloads like AI agents, user code, plugins, CI jobs, and more. It offers hardware-level isolation, OCI compatibility, and Docker-like workflows.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust runtime library, CLI tool, Agent Skills and MCP server integrations, and an embeddable API. It supports cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows) with average boot times under 100ms.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, leveraging microVM technology (e.g., Firecracker), OCI container image support, and integrations with MCP server and Agent Skills.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, the need for secure isolation has surged; Microsandbox offers a fast, local-first solution, amassing 7.4k stars with 100 new today, ranking #7 on Rust trending.
uses: AI agent developers: provide secure sandboxes for agents to execute code or tool calls.
Platform engineers: isolate untrusted code in CI/CD or plugin systems.
Security researchers: test malware or untrusted binaries without host risk.
Local development: spin up clean dev or test environments quickly.

zh.tag: Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，基于 GPUI 构建跨平台应用
zh.what: 这是一个基于 GPUI 的 Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，提供 60+ 跨平台组件，包括表格、列表、图表、代码编辑器等。它分为两层：gpui-component 提供开箱即用的样式组件，gpui-base 提供无样式的基础行为与基础设施，让开发者可以自由定制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的组件库源码、文档、示例和测试。核心是 gpui-component 和 gpui-base 两个 crate，以及用于展示的 website 目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 GPUI 框架，以及 Tree Sitter 用于语法高亮，支持 Markdown 渲染和虚拟化列表/表格。
zh.hot: 凭借丰富的组件、高性能和双层架构设计，在 Rust 社区迅速走红，今日新增 123 星，总星数达 12809，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 7。
uses: Rust 开发者：希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，需要现成 UI 组件。
桌面应用团队：需要高性能表格、编辑器等复杂组件，同时希望保持设计一致性。
设计系统开发者：希望基于 gpui-base 构建自己的设计系统，同时复用交互逻辑。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library for building cross-platform apps with GPUI
en.what: This is a Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI, offering 60+ cross-platform components including tables, lists, charts, and a code editor. It is structured in two layers: gpui-component provides styled, ready-to-use components, while gpui-base offers unstyled behavior and infrastructure for full customization.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for the component library, documentation, examples, and tests. The core is two crates: gpui-component and gpui-base, along with a website directory for showcasing.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the GPUI framework, with Tree Sitter for syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering, and virtualized lists/tables.
en.hot: With its rich components, high performance, and two-layer architecture, it has quickly gained popularity in the Rust community, adding 123 stars today and reaching 12,809 total, ranking #7 on GitHub Trending for Rust today.
uses: Rust developers: Want to build cross-platform desktop apps with Rust and need ready-made UI components.
Desktop app teams: Need high-performance complex components like tables and editors while maintaining design consistency.
Design system developers: Want to build their own design system on gpui-base while reusing interaction logic.

zh.tag: 高性能多人协作代码编辑器，Atom 与 Tree-sitter 作者打造
zh.what: Zed 是一款由 Rust 编写的高性能多人协作代码编辑器，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它强调极快的响应速度和流畅的多人实时协作体验，旨在让开发者“以思维的速度编码”。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Zed 编辑器源代码，涵盖编辑器核心、协作功能、UI 组件、以及针对各平台的构建脚本和文档。还包含贡献指南、许可证信息以及第三方依赖的许可证管理工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Tree-sitter 进行语法解析，使用 cargo-about 管理开源许可证，并利用 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 凭借其卓越的性能和多人协作特性，Zed 在开发者中广受好评，目前拥有 88k+ 星标，今日新增 81，持续位列 Rust 趋势榜前列。
uses: 追求极致响应速度和流畅编辑体验的开发者
需要实时多人协作编码的团队
对 Rust 或编辑器开发感兴趣的开源贡献者
希望使用现代、高性能编辑器的程序员

en.tag: High-performance multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter
en.what: Zed is a high-performance multiplayer code editor written in Rust, available on macOS, Linux, and Windows. It emphasizes lightning-fast responsiveness and seamless real-time collaboration, aiming to let developers 'code at the speed of thought'.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the Zed editor, including the editor core, collaboration features, UI components, and build scripts and documentation for each platform. It also includes contribution guidelines, license information, and tools for managing third-party dependency licenses.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Tree-sitter for syntax parsing, using cargo-about for open-source license compliance, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With its outstanding performance and multiplayer collaboration features, Zed has gained wide acclaim among developers, currently holding 88k+ stars, with 81 added today, consistently ranking high on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers seeking ultimate responsiveness and smooth editing experience
Teams needing real-time collaborative coding
Open-source contributors interested in Rust or editor development
Programmers wanting a modern, high-performance editor

zh.tag: 用廉价热点检测手机基站模拟器（IMSI捕获器）的开源工具
zh.what: Rayhunter 是一个用于检测 IMSI 捕获器（又称基站模拟器或 Stingray）的 Rust 工具。它最初设计运行在廉价的 Orbic RC400L 移动热点上，现在也支持其他设备。该项目旨在让不同技术水平的用户都能轻松安装和使用，并尽量减少误报。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、安装指南、用户文档（Rayhunter Book）、支持设备列表以及社区支持渠道。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，可能依赖一些用于处理蜂窝网络信号的库，但具体依赖未在摘要中列出。
zh.hot: 该项目由 EFF 发起，关注隐私保护，近期在 GitHub 上获得 5593 颗星，本周新增 106 颗，进入 Rust 周榜第 15 名，反映了公众对手机监控的担忧。
uses: 隐私倡导者和记者：用于检测周围是否存在 IMSI 捕获器，保护通信安全。
安全研究人员：研究基站模拟器的工作原理和检测方法。
普通用户：希望了解自己是否被监控，并愿意使用低成本硬件进行检测。

en.tag: Open-source tool to detect IMSI catchers using a cheap mobile hotspot
en.what: Rayhunter is a Rust tool for detecting IMSI catchers, also known as cell-site simulators or Stingrays. It was initially designed to run on a cheap mobile hotspot (Orbic RC400L) but now supports other devices. The project aims to be easy to install and use for users of all skill levels, minimizing false positives.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, installation guides, user documentation (Rayhunter Book), a list of supported devices, and community support channels.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, likely with dependencies for cellular signal processing, though specific dependencies are not listed in the summary.
en.hot: Initiated by EFF, this project addresses privacy concerns. It has gained 5,593 stars on GitHub, with 106 added this week, ranking 15th on the Rust weekly trending list, reflecting public concern about cell phone surveillance.
uses: Privacy advocates and journalists: to detect IMSI catchers in their vicinity and protect communication security.
Security researchers: to study the working principles and detection methods of cell-site simulators.
General users: who want to know if they are being monitored and are willing to use low-cost hardware for detection.

zh.tag: 零知识跨链桥，去信任高安全，兼容 Cosmos 与 EVM
zh.what: Union 是一个基于零知识证明的跨链桥协议，旨在实现去信任、抗审查和极高安全性的资产转移与通用消息传递。它不依赖可信第三方、预言机或多签，而是通过共识验证和 IBC 协议实现跨链互操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个组件：节点实现 uniond、零知识证明器 galoisd、跨生态中继器 voyager、CosmWasm 和 EVM 智能合约、轻客户端、节点管理工具 unionvisor、水龙头、前端应用和 TypeScript SDK。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，也涉及 Go、Solidity、TypeScript 等；依赖 CometBLS、Gnark、CosmWasm、Svelte、Astro 等。
zh.hot: 凭借零知识证明实现的高安全性和去信任特性，在 DeFi 领域备受关注，尽管本周新增 star 不多，但总星数已超 7.3 万，位列 Rust 周榜前列。
uses: DeFi 开发者：构建跨链资产转移和消息传递应用
Cosmos 生态项目：通过 IBC 与 EVM 链互操作
安全敏感场景：需要去信任桥接的机构或协议

en.tag: Trust-minimized ZK bridging protocol for Cosmos & EVM, high security
en.what: Union is a zero-knowledge based bridging protocol designed for trust-minimized, censorship-resistant, and highly secure asset transfers and general message passing. It relies on consensus verification and IBC, without trusted third parties, oracles, or multisig.
en.content: The repo contains multiple components: uniond node, galoisd prover, voyager relayer, CosmWasm and EVM contracts, light clients, unionvisor, faucet, frontend apps, and TypeScript SDK.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with Go, Solidity, TypeScript; uses CometBLS, Gnark, CosmWasm, Svelte, Astro.
en.hot: Its high security and trust-minimized design via ZK proofs attract DeFi attention; despite modest weekly stars, total stars exceed 73k, ranking high in Rust weekly.
uses: DeFi developers building cross-chain asset transfers and messaging
Cosmos ecosystem projects needing EVM interoperability via IBC
Security-sensitive use cases requiring trust-minimized bridging

zh.tag: 桌面 AI 代理，把任务变成可打开的 App
zh.what: BitFun 是一个桌面 AI 代理，能写代码、生成文档并操控桌面，同时将每个任务转化为独立的界面（Mini Apps）。它结合了 Rust 高性能运行时与桌面应用，提供开放、通用的能力，适用于软件开发之外的工作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心运行时、桌面应用（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、Mini Apps 框架、自托管设备同步服务器，以及文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，桌面应用跨平台，模型无关，支持 MCP/Skills/Hooks 等定制层。
zh.hot: 本周新增 101 星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜，因其创新的 Mini Apps 概念和自托管多设备控制而受到关注。
uses: 开发者：在真实 Git 仓库中进行编码、调试和代码审查。
办公人员：用于研究、写作、制作演示文稿和会议纪要。
高级用户：通过 MCP、Skills 和 Hooks 定制代理行为。
隐私敏感用户：自托管同步服务器，实现零知识多设备控制。

en.tag: Desktop AI agent that turns every task into an app you can open
en.what: BitFun is a desktop AI agent that writes code, produces documents, and drives the desktop, turning each task into its own interface (Mini Apps). It combines a high-performance Rust runtime with a polished desktop app, offering open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust core runtime, desktop apps for macOS/Windows/Linux, the Mini Apps framework, a self-hostable device-sync server, plus documentation and contribution guides.
en.stack: Primary language is Rust; the desktop app is cross-platform and model-agnostic, with customization via MCP/Skills/Hooks.
en.hot: Gained 101 stars this week, trending on GitHub's Rust weekly list, thanks to its innovative Mini Apps concept and self-hosted multi-device control.
uses: Developers: coding, debugging, and code review in real Git repos.
Office workers: research, writing, presentations, meeting notes.
Power users: customize agent behavior via MCP, Skills, and Hooks.
Privacy-conscious users: self-host sync server for zero-knowledge multi-device control.

zh.tag: 零配置终端 IDE，兼具 VS Code 体验与极速性能
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代、功能齐全的终端文本编辑器，无需任何配置即可使用。它提供熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持和 IDE 级功能，如命令面板、多光标编辑和 LSP 支持，旨在让用户无需学习曲线即可高效编辑。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、官方文档、演示 GIF 和安装脚本。核心功能包括文件管理、编辑、搜索替换、导航、分屏、主题定制、LSP 集成以及多任务编排器（基于 git worktree）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 LSP 客户端。支持多平台，通过脚本安装。
zh.hot: 凭借零配置、类 VS Code 的体验和高效处理超大文件的能力，Fresh 在开发者中迅速走红，本周新增 117 星，总星数达 8372，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）第 16 名。
uses: 终端爱好者：希望在终端中获得现代 IDE 体验，无需离开命令行。
服务器/远程开发：通过 SSH 在远程机器上编辑代码，享受本地 IDE 的便利。
性能敏感场景：需要打开超大文件或追求低延迟输入的用户。
极简主义者：厌倦了繁琐配置，想要开箱即用的编辑器。

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE with VS Code-like UX and blazing performance
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor that works with zero configuration. It offers familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features like command palette, multi-cursor editing, and LSP support, aiming to provide a seamless editing experience without a learning curve.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, official documentation, demo GIFs, and installation scripts. Key features include file management, editing, search & replace, navigation, split views, theming, LSP integration, and an orchestrator for multitasking with git worktrees.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LSP client. Cross-platform with script-based installation.
en.hot: Fresh has gained rapid popularity among developers due to its zero-config, VS Code-like experience and ability to handle multi-gigabyte files efficiently, adding 117 stars this week to reach 8372 total, ranking #16 on GitHub Trending (Rust) weekly.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts: want a modern IDE experience in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Remote development: edit code on remote machines via SSH with local IDE conveniences.
Performance-sensitive tasks: need to open huge files or desire low-latency input.
Minimalists: tired of complex configuration, want an out-of-the-box editor.

zh.tag: 高性能可观测性数据管道，统一采集、转换、路由日志与指标
zh.what: Vector 是一个端到端的可观测性数据管道，用于采集、转换和路由日志与指标数据。它支持作为 agent 或 aggregator 部署，提供统一的数据处理平台，并声称比同类工具快 10 倍。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、网站、集成测试、组件特性等。核心是高性能的数据管道引擎，支持多种 sources、transforms 和 sinks，以及配置和部署相关文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Tokio 等异步运行时，支持多种协议和数据格式。项目还包含用于测试和 CI 的 GitHub Actions 工作流。
zh.hot: Vector 在 GitHub 上拥有 22k+ star，今日新增 23，位居 Rust 趋势榜第二。其高性能、开源、可替代商业工具的特性吸引了大量关注，且由 Datadog 维护，社区活跃。
uses: 需要统一采集日志和指标并降低可观测性成本的基础设施团队
希望灵活切换监控供应商而不中断工作流的 DevOps 工程师
需要高性能数据管道以处理大规模日志和指标数据的平台工程师
对 Rust 高性能系统编程感兴趣，想学习数据管道架构的开发者

en.tag: High-performance observability data pipeline for collecting, transforming, and routing logs and metrics
en.what: Vector is an end-to-end observability data pipeline for collecting, transforming, and routing logs and metrics. It can be deployed as an agent or aggregator, providing a unified platform for data processing, and claims to be up to 10x faster than alternatives.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, website, integration tests, and component features. The core is a high-performance data pipeline engine supporting various sources, transforms, and sinks, along with configuration and deployment files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging async runtime like Tokio, supporting multiple protocols and data formats. The project also includes GitHub Actions workflows for testing and CI.
en.hot: With over 22k stars and 23 new stars today, Vector ranks #2 on the Rust trending list. Its high performance, open-source nature, and ability to replace commercial tools attract attention, backed by Datadog's maintenance and an active community.
uses: Infrastructure teams needing unified log and metric collection to reduce observability costs
DevOps engineers wanting to switch monitoring vendors without disrupting workflows
Platform engineers requiring high-performance data pipelines for large-scale log and metric data
Developers interested in Rust high-performance systems programming and data pipeline architecture

zh.tag: 为AI代理与编辑器打造的超快文件搜索SDK
zh.what: fff 是一个为 AI 代理和人类用户设计的文件搜索工具包，提供防错路径和内容搜索、频率排序的文件访问、后台监视器以及轻量级内存内容索引。它比 ripgrep 和 fzf 等 CLI 工具在长时间运行的进程中搜索多次时更快。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库、MCP 服务器、Neovim 插件、CLI 工具以及安装脚本。提供 ffgrep、fffind 和 fff-multi-grep 等工具，并支持多种语言绑定。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 C、Python、Bun 和 NodeJS 的绑定。MCP 服务器支持 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等客户端。
zh.hot: 在 AI 代理和编辑器中提供极快的文件搜索，显著减少 grep 往返和上下文浪费。已获得 10k+ star，并支持多种流行工具。
uses: AI 代理开发人员，需要为代理集成快速文件搜索能力
Neovim 用户，希望获得更快的文件搜索插件
需要高性能文件搜索的 Rust/C/Python/NodeJS 开发者

en.tag: Ultra-fast file search SDK for AI agents and editors
en.what: fff is a file search toolkit for AI agents and humans, offering typo-resistant path and content search, frequency-ranked file access, a background watcher, and a lightweight in-memory content index. It is faster than CLIs like ripgrep and fzf in long-running processes that search more than once.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust core library, MCP server, Neovim plugin, CLI tools, and install scripts. It provides tools like ffgrep, fffind, and fff-multi-grep, with bindings for multiple languages.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, with bindings for C, Python, Bun, and NodeJS. The MCP server works with clients like Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc.
en.hot: Provides extremely fast file search for AI agents and editors, reducing grep roundtrips and wasted context. Has gained 10k+ stars and supports many popular tools.
uses: AI agent developers needing fast file search integration
Neovim users wanting a faster file search plugin
Rust/C/Python/NodeJS developers requiring high-performance file search

zh.tag: AI代理的操作系统，让多个代理协作自动化

zh.what: Kueue 是一组 API 和控制器，用于在 Kubernetes 上实现作业级排队。它决定作业何时被准入（开始创建 Pod）以及何时停止（删除活跃 Pod），支持基于优先级的多种排队策略。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kueue 的控制器、API 定义、文档站点以及示例。核心概念包括 ClusterQueue、LocalQueue 和 Workload，提供公平共享、抢占、资源 flavor 互换等功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 Kubernetes 的 controller-runtime 构建，与集群自动缩放器集成，支持 Prometheus 指标。
zh.hot: 随着 Kubernetes 上 AI/ML 工作负载（如 Kubeflow、Ray）的增多，对作业排队的需求上升。Kueue 作为 CNCF 沙箱项目，提供原生解决方案，今日新增 22 星，总星数 2827，持续受到关注。
uses: 平台团队：为多租户 Kubernetes 集群提供统一的作业排队和资源配额管理。

SRE/运维：通过公平共享和队列策略优化集群资源利用率。

en.tag: Kubernetes-native job queueing and admission control
en.what: Kueue is a set of APIs and controllers for job-level queueing on Kubernetes. It decides when a job should be admitted (pods can be created) and when it should stop (active pods deleted), supporting priority-based queueing strategies.
en.content: The repo contains the Kueue controller, API definitions, documentation site, and examples. Core concepts include ClusterQueue, LocalQueue, and Workload, with features like fair sharing, preemption, and flavor fungibility.
en.stack: Developed in Go, built on Kubernetes controller-runtime, integrates with cluster-autoscaler, and supports Prometheus metrics.
en.hot: With the rise of AI/ML workloads on Kubernetes (e.g., Kubeflow, Ray), demand for job queueing grows. As a CNCF sandbox project, Kueue offers a native solution; gaining 22 stars today (total 2827) reflects sustained interest.
uses: Platform teams: provide unified job queueing and resource quota management for multi-tenant K8s clusters.
AI/ML engineers: run training jobs like Kubeflow or Ray with priority and preemption control.
SRE/ops: optimize cluster resource utilization via fair sharing and queue strategies.
