en.tag: Go backend for OCTO: AI agent orchestration + real-time messaging control plane
en.what: octo-server is the core backend of the OCTO open workplace platform, exposing REST and WebSocket APIs for web and admin clients. It handles business logic, orchestrates Lobster (AI agent) scheduling, and drives WuKongIM for real-time messaging.
en.content: The repo contains the Go backend source, config templates (e.g., configs/tsdd.yaml), build/quickstart docs, and Docker files (now moved to octo-deployment). It integrates Lobster agent orchestration, pluggable storage, and an IM control plane.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with MySQL-compatible DB, object storage adapters, WuKongIM for real-time messaging, and Docker Compose for one-command deployment (including Redis, MinIO, etc.).
en.hot: As the core backend of OCTO, it gains attention for first-class AI agent (Lobster) support and pluggable architecture. With +146 stars this week, ranking #22 on Go trending, it reflects demand for AI-native workplace backends.
uses: Developers building on OCTO web/admin, needing backend APIs
Teams/enterprises wanting a self-hosted AI-agent collaborative workspace
Engineers interested in Go backend architecture, AI agent orchestration, or real-time messaging
Developers needing a customizable backend with pluggable storage and IM

zh.tag: 本地运行 GitHub Actions 的 CLI 工具
zh.what: act 是一个命令行工具，让你在本地运行 GitHub Actions 工作流。它读取 .github/workflows/ 中的定义，使用 Docker 模拟 GitHub 的运行环境，提供快速反馈，也可作为本地任务运行器替代 Makefile。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 act 命令行工具，支持从 .github/workflows/ 读取工作流，通过 Docker API 拉取或构建镜像并运行容器。还提供用户指南和 VS Code 扩展支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Docker API 来管理容器和镜像。
zh.hot: 拥有 71.5k stars，本周新增 100，因其能极大提升 GitHub Actions 的开发调试效率，避免频繁提交推送，受到开发者欢迎。
uses: GitHub Actions 开发者：本地调试工作流，快速验证修改。
CI/CD 工程师：在本地运行集成测试，减少 CI 循环时间。
自动化爱好者：用 GitHub Actions 作为本地任务运行器，替代 Makefile。

en.tag: Run GitHub Actions workflows locally with a CLI
en.what: act is a CLI tool that lets you run GitHub Actions workflows locally. It reads workflow definitions from .github/workflows/, uses Docker to simulate the GitHub environment, providing fast feedback and serving as a local task runner alternative to Makefile.
en.content: The repo contains the act CLI written in Go, which reads workflows from .github/workflows/, uses Docker API to pull or build images and run containers. It also includes a user guide and VS Code extension support.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relies on Docker API for container and image management.
en.hot: With 71.5k stars and 100 new this week, it's popular for greatly improving GitHub Actions development and debugging efficiency by avoiding frequent commits and pushes.
uses: GitHub Actions developers: debug workflows locally and verify changes quickly.
CI/CD engineers: run integration tests locally to reduce CI cycle time.
Automation enthusiasts: use GitHub Actions as a local task runner instead of Makefile.

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: 实时分析型列式数据库管理系统
zh.what: ClickHouse 是一个开源的列式数据库管理系统，专为实时生成分析数据报告而设计。它能够对海量数据进行极速查询，支持 SQL 接口，适用于在线分析处理（OLAP）场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ClickHouse 数据库的完整源代码、构建脚本、测试套件以及文档。提供 Linux、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的安装方式，并有丰富的社区资源如教程、文档、视频和 Slack 群组。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 LLVM、libcxx、zlib-ng 等底层库，支持多种编译器和平台。
zh.hot: ClickHouse 因其极致的查询性能和实时分析能力而广受欢迎，拥有 48k+ Stars，本周新增 159 Stars，在 C++ 周榜排名第 15。
uses: 数据工程师 —— 构建实时 OLAP 数据管道和仪表盘
DevOps/SRE —— 监控和可观测性数据存储与查询
数据分析师 —— 对海量数据进行交互式探索分析
产品经理 —— 了解用户行为分析场景下的技术选型

en.tag: Real-time analytics column-oriented database management system
en.what: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system designed for real-time generation of analytical data reports. It enables blazing-fast queries on massive datasets, supports SQL interface, and is suitable for online analytical processing (OLAP) scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build scripts, test suites, and documentation for the ClickHouse database. It provides installation methods for Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, and offers rich community resources such as tutorials, documentation, videos, and Slack groups.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with dependencies on LLVM, libcxx, zlib-ng, and other low-level libraries, supporting multiple compilers and platforms.
en.hot: ClickHouse is widely popular for its extreme query performance and real-time analytics capabilities, with over 48k Stars and 159 new stars this week, ranking 15th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Data engineers — building real-time OLAP data pipelines and dashboards
DevOps/SRE — storing and querying monitoring and observability data
Data analysts — interactive exploration and analysis of massive datasets
Product managers — understanding technical choices for user behavior analytics

zh.tag: 专为AI训练与推理打造的高性能分布式文件系统
zh.what: 3FS 是 DeepSeek 开源的分布式文件系统，旨在解决 AI 训练和推理工作负载的存储挑战。它利用现代 SSD 和 RDMA 网络提供共享存储层，简化分布式应用的开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含设计文档、部署指南、USRBIO API 参考、P 规格说明，以及性能测试基准（如 fio 引擎）。核心代码采用 C++ 实现，支持数据准备、数据加载、检查点和推理 KVCache 等多样化工作负载。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖 RDMA 网络和 NVMe SSD，使用 FoundationDB 作为事务性键值存储，并采用 CRAQ 实现强一致性。
zh.hot: 凭借 DeepSeek 的品牌效应和 AI 基础设施的热度，3FS 在 GitHub 上迅速获得 1 万+ star，成为 C++ 周榜第 12 名。其高性能（峰值吞吐 6.6 TiB/s）和针对 AI 场景的优化设计吸引了大量关注。
uses: AI 训练和推理平台团队，需要高性能共享存储来加速数据加载和检查点保存
大规模数据分析流水线，需要高效管理中间输出和分层目录结构
对分布式文件系统设计感兴趣的研究者，可参考其架构和实现

en.tag: High-performance distributed file system for AI training and inference
en.what: 3FS is an open-source distributed file system from DeepSeek designed to address storage challenges for AI training and inference workloads. It leverages modern SSDs and RDMA networks to provide a shared storage layer that simplifies distributed application development.
en.content: The repository includes design notes, setup guide, USRBIO API reference, P specifications, and performance benchmarks (e.g., fio engine). Core code is in C++, supporting diverse workloads like data preparation, dataloaders, checkpointing, and KVCache for inference.
en.stack: Developed in C++, relies on RDMA networks and NVMe SSDs, uses FoundationDB as a transactional key-value store, and implements strong consistency via CRAQ.
en.hot: Leveraging DeepSeek's brand and the AI infrastructure hype, 3FS quickly gained 10k+ stars, ranking #12 on the C++ weekly trending. Its high performance (peak throughput 6.6 TiB/s) and AI-specific optimizations have drawn significant attention.
uses: AI training and inference platform teams needing high-performance shared storage for data loading and checkpointing
Large-scale data analytics pipelines requiring efficient management of intermediate outputs and hierarchical directory structures
Researchers interested in distributed file system design, can reference its architecture and implementation

zh.tag: 《皇牌空战6》静态重编译原生 PC 移植
zh.what: 这是一个基于 ReXGlue SDK 的非官方 PC 移植项目，将 Xbox 360 的 PowerPC 游戏代码静态重编译为 x86-64，使《皇牌空战6》能在 PC 上原生运行。目前仍处于早期阶段，可启动并进入游戏，但存在 bug 和崩溃。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的重编译源码、构建脚本、文档（快速开始、控制台变量、模组指南）以及 ReXGlue/Xenia 图形后端。不包含任何游戏数据，需用户自备合法游戏副本。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 C++，依赖 ReXGlue SDK 和 Xenia 图形后端，需要支持 AVX2 的 CPU 和 Direct3D 12 的 GPU。
zh.hot: 本周新增 132 星，进入 GitHub 周榜 C++ 第 9 名。粉丝对经典游戏 PC 移植热情高涨，且项目提供 60 FPS、高清地形、超宽屏等增强功能。
uses: 《皇牌空战6》玩家：希望在 PC 上以更高帧率和分辨率重温经典。
逆向工程爱好者：研究静态重编译技术如何应用于大型游戏。
模组制作者：利用纹理替换功能制作高清材质包。

en.tag: Static recompilation native PC port of Ace Combat 6
en.what: An unofficial PC port of Ace Combat 6 built on the ReXGlue SDK, statically recompiling the Xbox 360 PowerPC game code to x86-64. It can boot and run in-game but is still WIP with bugs and crashes expected.
en.content: The repo contains the full recompilation source, build scripts, documentation (quick start, console variables, modding guide), and the vendored ReXGlue/Xenia graphics backend. No game data is included; users must supply their own legally obtained copy.
en.stack: Primarily C++, depends on the ReXGlue SDK and Xenia graphics backend, requires AVX2-capable CPU and Direct3D 12 GPU.
en.hot: Gained 132 stars this week, ranking #9 on GitHub Trending (C++). Fans are excited about a PC port of a classic, with enhancements like 60 FPS, high-res terrain, and ultrawide support.
uses: Ace Combat 6 fans wanting to play on PC with higher FPS and resolution.
Reverse engineering enthusiasts interested in static recompilation of large games.
Modders who can use texture replacement to create HD packs.

zh.tag: 免费开源跨平台桌面 GIS，功能全面
zh.what: QGIS 是一个功能完整、用户友好的开源地理信息系统，支持 Unix、Windows 和 macOS。它提供灵活强大的空间数据管理、精美的制图、高级地理空间分析以及强大的定制和扩展能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 QGIS 的完整源代码、构建脚本、测试套件、文档和示例数据。主要目录包括 src（核心代码）、python（Python 绑定）、tests（测试）和 resources（图标、样式等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Qt 框架、GDAL/OGR 库、PostGIS 等。支持 Python 插件，并提供 Docker 镜像和多种平台构建配置。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的开源 GIS 软件之一，QGIS 拥有 14k+ 星标，持续活跃开发，本周新增 48 星，进入 GitHub 趋势榜 C++ 第 18 名。其强大的功能和活跃的社区使其长期保持热度。
uses: 地理信息专业人员：进行空间数据分析、制图和地图发布
科研与教育：用于地理教学、环境研究、城市规划等
开发者：基于 QGIS 进行插件开发或定制化 GIS 应用
政府与公共部门：用于土地管理、基础设施规划等

en.tag: Free, open-source, cross-platform desktop GIS with full features
en.what: QGIS is a full-featured, user-friendly, open-source GIS that runs on Unix, Windows, and macOS. It offers flexible and powerful spatial data management, beautiful cartography, advanced geospatial analysis, and powerful customization and extensibility.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build scripts, test suites, documentation, and sample data for QGIS. Main directories include src (core code), python (Python bindings), tests (tests), and resources (icons, styles, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on Qt framework, GDAL/OGR libraries, PostGIS, and more. Supports Python plugins and provides Docker images and build configurations for multiple platforms.
en.hot: As one of the most popular open-source GIS software, QGIS has 14k+ stars and continuous active development, with 48 new stars this week, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending for C++. Its powerful features and active community keep it consistently hot.
uses: GIS professionals: for spatial data analysis, cartography, and map publishing
Research and education: for geography teaching, environmental studies, urban planning, etc.
Developers: for plugin development or custom GIS applications based on QGIS
Government and public sector: for land management, infrastructure planning, etc.

zh.tag: 面向移动端与穿戴设备的混合边缘-云 AI 推理引擎
zh.what: Cactus 是一个专为移动设备、穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人设计的 AI 推理引擎，支持文本、语音和视觉任务。它采用混合边缘-云架构，在设备端运行量化模型，必要时可无缝切换至云端模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含四个核心组件：Cactus Engine（提供 OpenAI 兼容 API）、Cactus Graph（零拷贝计算图）、Cactus Kernels（针对 Apple、Samsung、Pixel 等设备的 CPU/GPU 内核）、Cactus Quants（基于旋转的量化技术）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持跨平台（包括 Mac、移动设备等）。集成了量化、内核优化和推理运行时，并提供 Python 绑定（可能）。
zh.hot: 凭借 5738 颗星和今日新增 22 颗星，Cactus 因填补了移动端高效 AI 推理的空白而受到关注，其混合边缘-云架构和独特的旋转量化技术吸引了开发者。
uses: 移动应用开发者：在 iOS/Android 应用中集成本地 AI 能力，如聊天、语音识别。
硬件厂商：为智能家居、机器人等设备提供低延迟、低功耗的 AI 推理方案。
边缘计算研究者：探索混合边缘-云推理和新型量化技术的实践。

en.tag: Hybrid edge-cloud AI engine for mobile, wearables, and robots
en.what: Cactus is an AI inference engine designed for mobile devices, wearables, smart home, and robots, supporting text, speech, and vision tasks. It uses a hybrid edge-cloud architecture, running quantized models on-device with seamless cloud handoff when needed.
en.content: The repo contains four core components: Cactus Engine (OpenAI-compatible APIs), Cactus Graph (zero-copy computation graph), Cactus Kernels (CPU/GPU kernels for Apple, Samsung, Pixel, etc.), and Cactus Quants (custom rotation-based quantization).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, cross-platform (including Mac and mobile). Integrates quantization, kernel optimization, and inference runtime, with possible Python bindings.
en.hot: With 5,738 stars and 22 new stars today, Cactus gains attention for filling the gap in efficient on-device AI inference, attracting developers with its hybrid edge-cloud architecture and unique rotation-based quantization.
uses: Mobile app developers: integrate on-device AI capabilities like chat and speech recognition into iOS/Android apps.
Hardware vendors: provide low-latency, low-power AI inference for smart home and robotics devices.
Edge computing researchers: explore hybrid edge-cloud inference and novel quantization techniques in practice.

zh.tag: 开源统一XDR与SIEM安全平台，保护端点与云负载
zh.what: Wazuh是一个免费开源的安全平台，用于威胁预防、检测和响应。它由部署在监控系统上的端点安全代理和收集分析代理数据的管理服务器组成，并已与Elastic Stack集成，提供搜索和数据可视化能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含Wazuh的核心组件，包括代理（agent）、管理服务器（manager）、规则集、文档和安装脚本。支持入侵检测、日志分析、文件完整性监控和漏洞检测等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++编写，依赖Elastic Stack（Elasticsearch、Kibana）进行数据存储和可视化，支持跨平台部署（Linux、Windows、macOS等）。
zh.hot: 本月新增431星，总星数达16485，位列C++趋势榜第25。作为开源安全平台的代表，其统一XDR和SIEM能力受到广泛关注。
uses: 安全运维团队：用于集中监控和管理企业安全事件，实现威胁检测与响应。
合规审计人员：利用文件完整性监控和日志分析满足PCI DSS等合规要求。
云原生环境：保护容器和云工作负载，集成威胁情报识别风险。
开源爱好者：学习大型C++安全项目架构和实现。

en.tag: Open-source unified XDR and SIEM platform for endpoint and cloud workload protection
en.what: Wazuh is a free and open-source security platform for threat prevention, detection, and response. It consists of an endpoint security agent deployed on monitored systems and a management server that collects and analyzes agent data, fully integrated with the Elastic Stack for search and visualization.
en.content: The repository contains core components of Wazuh, including agents, manager, rulesets, documentation, and installation scripts. It supports intrusion detection, log analysis, file integrity monitoring, and vulnerability detection.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) for data storage and visualization, and supports cross-platform deployment (Linux, Windows, macOS, etc.).
en.hot: With 431 stars added this month and a total of 16,485, it ranks 25th on the C++ trending list. As a leading open-source security platform, its unified XDR and SIEM capabilities attract significant attention.
uses: Security operations teams: for centralized monitoring and management of security events, enabling threat detection and response.
Compliance auditors: leveraging file integrity monitoring and log analysis to meet regulatory requirements like PCI DSS.
Cloud-native environments: protecting containers and cloud workloads with integrated threat intelligence.
Open-source enthusiasts: learning the architecture and implementation of a large-scale C++ security project.

zh.tag: 自制原生C++魔兽世界客户端，Vulkan渲染器
zh.what: WoWee 是一个开源的《魔兽世界》引擎实验项目，用 C++ 和 Vulkan 实现了自定义客户端。它支持多个经典版本，并兼容多种主流服务端，旨在作为教育和研究用途。
zh.content: 仓库包含客户端源码、文档、资源提取器以及预编译的发布版本。代码组织为模块化结构，涵盖渲染、网络、游戏逻辑和平台适配等部分。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Vulkan 渲染 API，依赖 Unicorn Engine 用于 Warden 模拟，StormLib 用于资源提取。支持 x86-64 和 ARM64 架构，覆盖 Linux、macOS、Windows 和 Android 平台。
zh.hot: 本周新增 54 颗星，总星数达 659，登上 GitHub C++ 周榜第 9 名。其独特的自制客户端定位和对多版本、多平台的支持吸引了大量魔兽世界爱好者和技术研究者。
uses: 魔兽世界玩家：体验自定义客户端，探索经典版本的新玩法
游戏开发学习者：研究现代渲染、网络协议和游戏引擎实现
逆向工程爱好者：分析游戏协议和客户端架构
开源贡献者：参与功能开发、测试和文档完善

en.tag: Custom native C++ WoW client with Vulkan renderer
en.what: WoWee is an open-source World of Warcraft engine experiment, implementing a custom client in C++ with a Vulkan renderer. It supports multiple classic expansions and is compatible with several popular server emulators, intended for educational and research purposes.
en.content: The repository contains client source code, documentation, an asset extractor, and prebuilt releases. The code is organized modularly, covering rendering, networking, game logic, and platform adaptation.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Vulkan rendering API, leveraging Unicorn Engine for Warden emulation and StormLib for asset extraction. Supports x86-64 and ARM64 architectures across Linux, macOS, Windows, and Android.
en.hot: Gained 54 stars this week, reaching 659 total, ranking #9 on GitHub's C++ weekly trending. Its unique custom client approach and support for multiple expansions and platforms attract WoW enthusiasts and tech researchers.
uses: WoW players: experience a custom client and explore classic versions
Game dev learners: study modern rendering, networking, and engine implementation
Reverse engineering enthusiasts: analyze game protocols and client architecture
Open source contributors: participate in feature development, testing, and documentation

zh.tag: 为 AMD 硬件优化的 llama.cpp 实验性量化格式家族
zh.what: ROCmFPX 为 llama.cpp 添加了针对 AMD 硬件的实验性 2、3、4、6、8 位 GGUF 模型权重格式，包含 CPU 参考路径和加速的 HIP/ROCm 与 Vulkan 内核。它旨在提升 AMD GPU 上的推理性能，并提供了多种量化选项。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ROCmFP2、ROCmFP4 等格式的实现，以及相关的内核、验证工具和基准测试。当前 ROCmFP2 和 ROCmFP4 已优化并验证，而 ROCmFP3、ROCmFP6 和 ROCmFP8 仍处于开发预览阶段。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，依赖 llama.cpp、HIP/ROCm 和 Vulkan 技术栈，用于 AMD GPU 加速。
zh.hot: 本周新增 82 颗星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（C++ 周榜第 11 名）。AMD 官方提供硬件支持，且 ROCmFP2 在 Vulkan 上相比 ROCmFP4 有 18.5% 的性能提升，吸引了 AMD 用户和量化爱好者。
uses: AMD GPU 用户：希望在 llama.cpp 上获得更好推理性能的开发者。
量化研究者：探索新的低比特量化格式和性能优化。
开源 AI 爱好者：关注 AMD 生态和开源大模型推理的进展。

en.tag: Experimental AMD-focused GGUF quantization formats for llama.cpp
en.what: ROCmFPX adds experimental 2-, 3-, 4-, 6-, and 8-bit GGUF model-weight formats to llama.cpp, with CPU reference paths and accelerated HIP/ROCm and Vulkan kernels. It aims to improve inference performance on AMD hardware and offers a range of quantization options.
en.content: The repository contains implementations of formats like ROCmFP2 and ROCmFP4, along with associated kernels, validation tools, and benchmarks. ROCmFP2 and ROCmFP4 are optimized and validated, while ROCmFP3, ROCmFP6, and ROCmFP8 are in development preview.
en.stack: Built on C++, leveraging llama.cpp, HIP/ROCm, and Vulkan for AMD GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Gained 82 stars this week, ranking 11th on GitHub Trending (C++ weekly). AMD officially provides hardware support, and ROCmFP2 shows up to 18.5% performance improvement over ROCmFP4 on Vulkan, attracting AMD users and quantization enthusiasts.
uses: AMD GPU users: developers seeking better inference performance on llama.cpp.
Quantization researchers: exploring new low-bit formats and performance optimizations.
Open-source AI enthusiasts: following AMD ecosystem and open-source LLM inference progress.

zh.tag: 单文件分发与运行大模型的工具
zh.what: llamafile 是一个 Mozilla 项目，旨在通过将 llama.cpp 与 Cosmopolitan Libc 结合，将大语言模型打包成单个可执行文件，用户无需安装即可在多种操作系统和 CPU 架构上本地运行。它还包含 whisperfile，一个基于 whisper.cpp 的单文件语音转文字工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 llamafile 的源代码、构建系统、文档以及预构建的 llamafile 示例（如 LLaVA 模型）。项目从 0.10.0 版本开始采用新构建系统，以保持与最新 llama.cpp 的兼容性。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，依赖 llama.cpp、whisper.cpp 和 Cosmopolitan Libc。
zh.hot: llamafile 简化了 LLM 的分发和运行，无需安装即可跨平台使用，star 数达 25k+，本周新增 125，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 11。
uses: 开发者：快速分发和部署 LLM 应用，无需复杂环境配置
终端用户：直接运行预构建的 llamafile，体验本地大模型
语音处理：使用 whisperfile 进行音频转录和翻译

en.tag: Distribute and run LLMs with a single file
en.what: llamafile is a Mozilla project that combines llama.cpp with Cosmopolitan Libc to package large language models into a single executable file, allowing users to run them locally on most OSes and CPU architectures without installation. It also includes whisperfile, a single-file speech-to-text tool based on whisper.cpp.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build system, documentation, and pre-built llamafile examples (e.g., LLaVA models). Starting from version 0.10.0, it uses a new build system to stay aligned with the latest llama.cpp.
en.stack: Built on C++, leveraging llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, and Cosmopolitan Libc.
en.hot: llamafile simplifies LLM distribution and execution with cross-platform, no-install single files, amassing 25k+ stars with 125 new this week, ranking #11 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Developers: quickly distribute and deploy LLM apps without complex setup
End users: run pre-built llamafiles to experience local LLMs
Speech processing: use whisperfile for audio transcription and translation

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的开源框架
zh.what: Electron 是一个开源框架，允许开发者使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用。它基于 Node.js 和 Chromium，被 Visual Studio Code 等众多知名应用采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 的完整源代码、文档、示例以及构建和测试脚本。它提供了预编译的二进制文件，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 JavaScript，依赖 Chromium 和 Node.js。通过 npm 安装，支持多种平台架构。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 12 万颗星，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的桌面应用框架之一。今日新增 8 颗星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 开发者：希望用 Web 技术快速构建跨平台桌面应用的开发者
团队：需要为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供一致体验的产品团队
学习者：想学习桌面应用开发或了解 Chromium 和 Node.js 集成的学习者

en.tag: Open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with web tech
en.what: Electron is an open-source framework that lets developers build cross-platform desktop apps using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It is based on Node.js and Chromium and is used by many well-known apps like Visual Studio Code.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build/test scripts for Electron. It provides prebuilt binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and JavaScript, relying on Chromium and Node.js. Installed via npm, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.hot: With over 120k stars, it's one of the most popular desktop app frameworks on GitHub. Gained 8 stars today, maintaining high popularity.
uses: Developers: those who want to quickly build cross-platform desktop apps using web technologies
Teams: product teams needing consistent experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Learners: those interested in desktop app development or the integration of Chromium and Node.js

zh.tag: 为 Antigravity 编辑器打造的免 TUN 强制代理工具
zh.what: 这是一个专为 Antigravity 编辑器设计的透明代理注入器，通过 DLL 注入和进程流量劫持，在 Windows 上无需 TUN 模式即可强制让 Antigravity 走 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理。它解决了在中国等地区访问 Antigravity 服务时的网络问题，并提供了详细的日志和诊断功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源码、构建配置、使用文档、故障排查指南、WSL 使用指南和进阶玩法。核心是一个 DLL 注入器，可注入到 language_server_windows_x64.exe 和 node.exe 等进程，并输出代理日志和 IP 诊断信息。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17，使用 MinHook 库进行 API 钩子，支持 Windows x86/x64 平台。构建系统为 GitHub Actions 自动构建，依赖 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理协议。
zh.hot: 获得 3654 星，本周新增 91 星，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 13 名。因其精准解决了 Antigravity 用户在中国等地区的网络痛点，且无需 TUN 模式，实用性强，社区反响热烈。
uses: 在中国或其他网络受限地区使用 Antigravity 编辑器的开发者
需要强制特定应用走代理但不想开启 TUN 模式的 Windows 用户
对 DLL 注入和进程流量劫持技术感兴趣的 C++ 开发者

en.tag: Force SOCKS5/HTTP proxy for Antigravity without TUN mode on Windows
en.what: A transparent proxy injector for the Antigravity editor, using DLL injection and process traffic hijacking to force Antigravity through a SOCKS5/HTTP proxy without TUN mode on Windows. It solves network access issues for Antigravity in regions like China, with detailed logging and diagnostics.
en.content: The repository contains complete C++ source code, build configurations, usage docs, troubleshooting guides, WSL guide, and advanced usage. Core is a DLL injector that hooks into processes like language_server_windows_x64.exe and node.exe, with proxy logs and IP diagnostics.
en.stack: Built with C++17, uses MinHook for API hooking, supports Windows x86/x64. Build via GitHub Actions, depends on SOCKS5/HTTP proxy protocols.
en.hot: With 3654 stars and 91 added this week, it ranked #13 on GitHub Trending C++ weekly. It's popular for precisely solving Antigravity users' network issues in China without TUN mode, highly practical and well-received.
uses: Developers using Antigravity editor in China or restricted networks
Windows users who need to force proxy for specific apps without TUN mode
C++ developers interested in DLL injection and process traffic hijacking

zh.tag: ESP32 的 WiFi/蓝牙攻防工具套件
zh.what: ESP32 Marauder 是一套运行在 ESP32 芯片上的 WiFi 和蓝牙攻击与防御工具，提供网络扫描、嗅探、欺骗、干扰等功能。它既可以用于安全测试，也可以用于网络监控和防御，适合渗透测试人员、安全研究者和爱好者。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、预编译的 release 固件、详细的 wiki 文档以及用于构建和测试的 CI 配置。固件通过交互式命令行界面提供多种攻击和监控模式，并支持通过 Web 界面或物理按键进行控制。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 编写，使用 Arduino 框架和 ESP32 SDK，依赖 ESP32 的 WiFi 和蓝牙硬件。支持 PlatformIO 和 Arduino IDE 构建，并包含单元测试框架。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 12k stars，本周新增 116 个，位列 C++ 周榜第 17。其热度源于将复杂的网络攻击工具集成到廉价的 ESP32 硬件上，降低了安全测试的门槛，吸引了大量安全爱好者和硬件玩家。
uses: 渗透测试人员：用于评估 WiFi/蓝牙网络的安全性，测试网络防御能力。
安全研究者：研究无线攻击技术，开发新的防御措施。
硬件爱好者：在 ESP32 上体验黑客工具，学习无线通信原理。
教育场景：作为网络安全课程的教学演示工具。

en.tag: A suite of WiFi/Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools for ESP32
en.what: ESP32 Marauder is a suite of WiFi and Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools for the ESP32, offering network scanning, sniffing, spoofing, jamming, and more. It can be used for security testing or network monitoring and defense, suitable for penetration testers, security researchers, and enthusiasts.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, precompiled release firmware, a detailed wiki, and CI configurations for building and testing. The firmware provides an interactive command-line interface with various attack and monitoring modes, controllable via a web interface or physical buttons.
en.stack: Written in C++, built on the Arduino framework and ESP32 SDK, leveraging ESP32's WiFi and Bluetooth hardware. Supports PlatformIO and Arduino IDE builds, and includes a unit testing framework.
en.hot: With over 12k stars and 116 new stars this week, ranking #17 on the C++ weekly trending list, its popularity stems from integrating complex network attack tools onto cheap ESP32 hardware, lowering the barrier to security testing and attracting security enthusiasts and hardware tinkerers.
uses: Penetration testers: to assess WiFi/Bluetooth network security and test defenses.
Security researchers: to study wireless attack techniques and develop countermeasures.
Hardware enthusiasts: to experiment with hacking tools on ESP32 and learn wireless communication.
Educational settings: as a teaching demo tool for cybersecurity courses.

zh.tag: 原生集成AI代理的Windows终端
zh.what: Intelligent Terminal是Windows Terminal的实验性分支，原生集成了AI代理功能。它支持任何符合Agent Client Protocol (ACP)的代理CLI，如GitHub Copilot CLI，使用户能在命令行中直接与AI交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的终端应用源码，基于Windows Terminal，新增了代理状态栏、代理面板、代理管理、错误检测和命令面板等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++开发，依赖Windows Terminal的代码库，并遵循ACP协议与代理CLI通信。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，将AI代理直接集成到终端，吸引了大量开发者关注，今日新增26星，登上GitHub Trending C++日榜第三。
uses: 开发者：在命令行中直接使用AI代理辅助编码，如代码生成、错误排查。
Windows用户：喜欢Windows Terminal但希望集成AI功能的用户。
AI爱好者：希望体验ACP协议和AI代理集成的新兴技术。

en.tag: Windows Terminal fork with native AI agent integration
en.what: Intelligent Terminal is an experimental fork of Windows Terminal with native agent integration. It works with any Agent Client Protocol (ACP)-compatible agent CLI, such as GitHub Copilot CLI, enabling direct AI interaction within the command line.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the terminal application, based on Windows Terminal, with added features like agent status bar, agent pane, agent management, error detection, and command palette.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, building upon the Windows Terminal codebase, and communicates with agent CLIs via the ACP protocol.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, it integrates AI agents directly into the terminal, attracting significant developer attention with 26 stars today, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending for C++.
uses: Developers: Use AI agents directly in the command line for coding assistance, such as code generation and error debugging.
Windows users: Those who like Windows Terminal but want integrated AI features.
AI enthusiasts: Those interested in experiencing ACP protocol and emerging AI agent integration.

zh.tag: 基于 Citra 的开源 3DS 模拟器
zh.what: Azahar 是一个开源的 3DS 模拟器，由 PabloMK7 的 Citra 分支和 Lime3DS 项目合并而成，旨在成为未来开发的默认平台。它支持 Windows、macOS 和 Android 等多个平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器的完整源代码、构建脚本、文档和发布资源，支持安装程序、压缩包和 APK 等多种分发形式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 等库，支持 CMake 构建，并集成 CI 自动化测试。
zh.hot: 在 Citra 被下架后，Azahar 迅速成为社区关注的焦点，合并了两个主要分支，吸引了大量用户和贡献者，star 数已接近 8000。
uses: 3DS 游戏爱好者：在 PC 或 Android 设备上玩 3DS 游戏。
模拟器开发者：参与开源开发，贡献代码或测试。
怀旧玩家：体验经典 3DS 游戏库。

en.tag: Open-source 3DS emulator based on Citra
en.what: Azahar is an open-source 3DS emulator that emerged from the merge of PabloMK7's Citra fork and the Lime3DS project, aiming to be the de-facto platform for future development. It supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, and Android.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, build scripts, documentation, and release assets for the emulator, with distribution via installers, archives, and APKs.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, using libraries like Qt, built with CMake, and integrated with CI for automated testing.
en.hot: After Citra was taken down, Azahar quickly became a community focus, merging two major forks and attracting many users and contributors, with stars nearing 8k.
uses: 3DS gaming enthusiasts: play 3DS games on PC or Android.
Emulator developers: contribute code or testing to the open-source project.
Retro gamers: experience the classic 3DS game library.

zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢思维协作平台
zh.what: Buzz是一个自托管的团队协作空间，人类和AI代理可以在同一频道中共同工作。所有消息、操作和事件都记录在Nostr中继上，形成统一的审计日志。它让代理像人类队友一样参与代码审查、工作流运行和项目管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含Rust实现的核心中继、客户端界面、文档（愿景、架构等）以及截图示例。提供频道、画布、工作流、语音会议等功能，并支持代理自主操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用Rust编写，基于Nostr协议，依赖大量Rust crate。前端可能使用Web技术，但核心是Rust后端。
zh.hot: 在GitHub Trending月榜排名第一，28.7k星，本月新增301星。它解决了AI代理协作中的信任和审计问题，提供统一的事件日志，吸引了开发者和团队。
uses: 团队希望让AI代理参与开发流程，同时保持完整审计记录。
开发者需要自托管的协作平台，数据完全掌控。
对Nostr协议感兴趣，想探索去中心化社交与工作结合。
研究AI代理安全与权限管理的场景。

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate on a Nostr relay
en.what: Buzz is a self-hosted team workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate in shared channels. Every message, action, and event is recorded on a Nostr relay, creating a unified audit trail. Agents can participate in code review, workflow runs, and project management like human teammates.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-implemented core relay, client UI, documentation (vision, architecture, etc.), and screenshot examples. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and agent autonomy.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Nostr protocol, with a suspicious number of Rust crates. The frontend may use web technologies, but the core is Rust backend.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending monthly with 28.7k stars and +301 this month. It addresses trust and audit in AI agent collaboration with a unified event log, attracting developers and teams.
uses: Teams wanting AI agents in dev workflows with full audit trails.
Developers needing self-hosted collaboration with data ownership.
Those interested in Nostr and decentralized social-work integration.
Researchers exploring AI agent security and permissioning.

zh.tag: 蓝牙mesh+ Nostr 双通道去中心化聊天，无账号无服务器
zh.what: BitChat 是一款去中心化的点对点消息应用，采用双传输架构：本地蓝牙 mesh 网络用于离线通信，互联网 Nostr 协议用于全球连接。无需账号、手机号或中央服务器，支持位置频道和端到端加密。
zh.content: 仓库包含 iOS/macOS 原生应用源码、Android 版本、技术白皮书、构建验证文档及许可文件。核心功能包括双传输架构、地理频道、智能路由、IRC 风格命令等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Swift 开发，依赖 Bluetooth LE、Nostr 协议、Noise Protocol 加密、LZ4 压缩等。
zh.hot: 本月新增近万星，因去中心化、抗审查特性及离线通信能力而备受关注，尤其适合灾难场景和隐私敏感用户。
uses: 隐私敏感用户：无需手机号或账号，端到端加密聊天
离线场景：灾难或网络中断时通过蓝牙 mesh 通信
开发者：学习去中心化消息架构和蓝牙 mesh 实现
社区组织：创建基于地理位置的频道进行本地讨论

en.tag: Decentralized P2P chat with Bluetooth mesh + Nostr, no accounts/servers
en.what: BitChat is a decentralized peer-to-peer messaging app with dual transport: local Bluetooth mesh for offline and Nostr protocol for global reach. No accounts, phone numbers, or central servers; supports location-based channels and E2E encryption.
en.content: Repo contains native iOS/macOS app source, Android version, whitepaper, build verification docs, and license. Key features: dual transport, geo-channels, smart routing, IRC-style commands.
en.stack: Primarily Swift, using Bluetooth LE, Nostr protocol, Noise Protocol encryption, LZ4 compression.
en.hot: Gained ~9.5k stars this month due to its decentralized, censorship-resistant nature and offline capability, appealing to privacy advocates and disaster scenarios.
uses: Privacy-conscious users: chat without phone number or account, E2E encrypted
Offline scenarios: communicate via Bluetooth mesh during disasters or outages
Developers: learn decentralized messaging architecture and Bluetooth mesh
Community groups: create location-based channels for local discussions

zh.tag: 让 AI 助手直接给答案，告别啰嗦铺垫
zh.what: 这是一个用于编码助手的技能包，强制 AI 输出简洁、可操作的答案，避免冗长铺垫和无关内容。它基于 ADHD 友好原则，让回复直接给出行动步骤，适合所有希望提高效率的用户。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，定义了 10 条规则，如“先行动”“步骤编号”“结尾给出下一步”等。还提供安装说明、多语言 README 和示例对比，展示启用前后的输出差异。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Claude Code 的插件系统，使用 Markdown 定义技能规则。无复杂依赖，仅需 Python 环境（用于仓库元数据）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 20926 星，总星数 21466，登顶 GitHub Trending 月榜。它精准击中开发者对 AI 助手冗长回复的痛点，以极简方式提升效率，引发广泛共鸣。
uses: 开发者：希望 AI 编程助手直接给出可执行步骤，减少阅读负担。
团队：统一 AI 输出风格，提升代码审查和协作效率。
任何 AI 用户：厌倦了“Great question!”式开场，想要更直接的答案。

en.tag: Make coding agents answer directly, no fluff.
en.what: A skill for coding assistants that enforces concise, actionable answers, cutting out verbose preambles and tangents. Based on ADHD-friendly principles, it makes responses direct and step-by-step, benefiting anyone who wants faster, clearer outputs.
en.content: The repo contains a SKILL.md file with 10 rules like 'Lead with the next action' and 'Number multi-step tasks'. It also includes installation instructions, multilingual READMEs, and before/after examples showing the output difference.
en.stack: Built on Claude Code's plugin system, using Markdown to define skill rules. No heavy dependencies; Python is only for repo metadata.
en.hot: With 20,926 stars added this month (total 21,466), it topped the GitHub Trending monthly chart. It hits the pain point of verbose AI responses, offering a minimalist fix that resonates widely.
uses: Developers who want coding assistants to give actionable steps without extra reading.
Teams standardizing AI output style for faster code reviews and collaboration.
Any AI user tired of 'Great question!' preambles and seeking direct answers.

zh.tag: AI 代理团队级记忆中枢，沉淀对话、文档与代码为可复用资产
zh.what: TencentDB Agent Memory 是一个为 AI 代理设计的团队级记忆中枢，将对话、文档和代码转化为四种可复用的记忆资产（聊天记忆、技能、LLM 维基、代码图谱），并支持跨代理和框架的治理、共享与装备。它旨在减少重复工作，让代理在团队中持续积累知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含部署脚本（一键启动 memory-core、memory-hub 和 proxy）、核心服务代码、迁移工具，以及详细的安装文档（中英文）。提供面板用于管理记忆资产。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js >=22.16，支持 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 等代理框架，使用 TencentDB 作为存储后端。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1057 星，总星数达 16543，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。其“团队记忆”理念切中 AI 代理协作痛点，且提供一键部署，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理添加持久记忆，减少重复上下文输入。
团队协作场景：共享代理记忆，提升团队知识复用效率。
个人开发者：构建“一人公司”式的代理团队，自动化工作流。
研究爱好者：探索代理记忆管理与跨框架集成。

en.tag: Team-level memory hub for AI agents, turning conversations, docs, and code into reusable assets
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents, transforming conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks. It aims to reduce repetitive work by enabling agents to accumulate knowledge persistently.
en.content: The repo includes deployment scripts (one-click start for memory-core, memory-hub, and proxy), core service code, migration tools, and detailed installation docs (EN/CN). A panel is provided for managing memory assets.

en.tag: Run 70B LLMs on a single 4GB GPU, no quantization/distillation/pruning
en.what: AirLLM dramatically reduces inference memory usage via layer-wise offloading and expert streaming, enabling 70B models on a single 4GB GPU, and even supports 405B, 671B, and 2.8T-parameter models. It requires no quantization, distillation, or pruning, preserving model accuracy.
en.content: The repo includes a Python library, Jupyter example notebooks, configuration docs, and FAQ, supporting various model architectures with a simple API and CLI.
en.stack: Built on PyTorch, depends on transformers and flash-attn, supports CUDA and MacOS, primarily written in Jupyter Notebook and Python.
en.hot: Gained 8,681 stars this month, total over 31k, because it lets hobbyists run huge models on low-end GPUs, dramatically lowering the barrier to AI.
uses: Individual developers: run 70B-level models locally on low-end GPUs without cloud services
Researchers: quickly test huge models (e.g., 405B, 671B) without high-end hardware
Education: demonstrate LLM inference principles, reducing learning costs
Edge computing: deploy large model applications on resource-constrained devices

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.

en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 把书、视频、播客蒸馏成可调用的 AI 技能包
zh.what: 这是一个将书籍、长视频、播客等高价值内容中的方法论，通过 RIA-TV++ 流水线蒸馏成结构化、可调用的 AI Skills 的工具。它解决了知识停留在“看过/听过”层面、无法在真实场景中被 AI 调用的问题，让知识真正变成可执行的工具。

zh.hot: 本月新增 4632 星，总星数达 6991，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 12 名。它切中了知识管理痛点，将内容蒸馏成 AI 可调用的技能，与 nuwa-skill 等热门项目形成生态，引发广泛关注。
uses: 知识工作者：希望将阅读的书籍、观看的视频转化为可复用的 AI 技能，提升工作效率。
AI 应用开发者：需要从大量文本中提取结构化方法论，构建 agent 工具链。
终身学习者：解决“看过但用不上”的问题，让知识在真实场景中被调用。
内容创作者：将自己的课程、演讲等系统性内容蒸馏成可交互的 AI 技能包。

en.tag: Distill books, videos, podcasts into executable AI skill packs
en.what: This tool distills methodologies from high-value content like books, long videos, and podcasts into structured, callable AI Skills using the RIA-TV++ pipeline. It addresses the problem of knowledge remaining at the 'watched/listened' level and not being usable by AI in real scenarios, turning knowledge into executable tools.
en.content: The repo contains the full RIA-TV++ methodology implementation, Python scripts, templates (e.g., BOOK_OVERVIEW.md, INDEX.md, DIGEST.md), and example outputs. It generates a multi-skill repository including overview, extracted frameworks/principles/cases/counterexamples/terms, triple verification, RIA++ structuring, Zettelkasten linking, stress tests, and final deliverables.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relies on OpenAI/Claude APIs for LLM calls, supports platforms like Claude Code and Cursor, and can be used with skills like video-downloader.
en.hot: Gained 4,632 stars this month, reaching 6,991 total, ranking 12th on GitHub Trending monthly. It addresses the pain point of knowledge management by distilling content into AI-callable skills, forming an ecosystem with popular projects like nuwa-skill, sparking widespread interest.
uses: Knowledge workers: Want to turn books and videos into reusable AI skills to boost productivity.
AI app developers: Need to extract structured methodologies from large texts to build agent toolchains.
Lifelong learners: Solve the 'consumed but not applied' problem, making knowledge callable in real scenarios.
Content creators: Distill their courses, talks, etc., into interactive AI skill packs.

zh.tag: 让Claude具备看视频能力的Agent插件，一键解析任意视频

zh.hot: 在 8992 颗 Star 的基础上本周再增 1876，跻身 GitHub Python 周榜第 15 名。它精准解决了 AI Agent 无法感知视频这一痛点，以零配置、多平台兼容和“真正看懂视频”的体验迅速获得开发者青睐。
uses: 内容创作者与营销人员：快速拆解竞品视频结构、分析热门视频开场钩子与广告创意

en.tag: Agent plugin that gives Claude eyes: downloads, frames & transcribes any video
en.what: It gives Claude and other AI agents the ability to "watch" videos via a simple /watch command. The tool downloads the video, extracts scene-aware frames, pulls timestamped transcripts (free captions first, Whisper as fallback), and feeds everything to the AI. This lets Claude actually see what's on screen and hear the audio instead of guessing from titles or partial transcripts.
en.content: The repo contains the Python core of the /watch plugin, plus installation configs and docs for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and over 50 Agent Skills hosts. It ships as a CLI plugin with zero-config setup, automatically installing yt-dlp and ffmpeg on first run.
en.stack: Built in Python, it relies on yt-dlp for video fetching, ffmpeg for frame extraction and audio demuxing, and falls back to the OpenAI Whisper API when free captions are unavailable. It integrates with agent environments via plugin protocols.
en.hot: With 8,992 stars and 1,876 added this week alone, it hit #15 on GitHub's Python Trending list. It solves the critical gap of AI agents being unable to perceive video, winning developers over with zero-config setup, multi-platform support, and a true "see-and-hear" experience.
uses: Content creators & marketers: analyze competitor video structures, viral hooks, and ad creatives
Developers & QA engineers: diagnose bugs from screen recordings by having the AI pinpoint issue frames
Learners & researchers: turn long videos or course playlists into searchable, timestamped notes
Product managers & analysts: strip hype from launch videos and extract substantive feature updates

Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: 开源低延迟语音代理框架，支持全本地模块化VAD-STT-LLM-TTS流水线

zh.hot: 在语音 Agent 爆发期，它以「全模块可替换 + 全本地可运行」直击开发者对隐私与可控性的痛点；本月新增 1,334 Star，总星数 6,149，冲上 Python 月榜第 10，并已实际部署在数千台 Reachy Mini 机器人上。

需要将 LLM 快速接入语音交互、并要求兼容 OpenAI Realtime 协议的硬件/机器人厂商

en.tag: Low-latency modular voice-agent pipeline with fully local VAD-STT-LLM-TTS stack
en.what: An open-source voice-agent framework from Hugging Face that chains VAD → STT → LLM → TTS into a low-latency, fully modular pipeline for local or hybrid deployments. It exposes an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket API so any compatible client can connect, with every component swappable for self-hosted or open-source models.
en.content: The repo includes a pluggable pipeline engine, an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket server, a ready-to-use CLI, plus scripts and docs supporting multi-language and Pocket TTS.
en.stack: Built in Python, defaulting to Parakeet TDT for STT and Qwen3-TTS for synthesis, with the LLM slot supporting any OpenAI-compatible backend including hosted APIs, HF Inference Providers, vLLM, and llama.cpp.
en.hot: It hits the sweet spot for privacy and control with a fully swappable, fully local stack amid the voice-agent boom; it gained 1,334 stars this month for a total of 6,149, hitting #10 on the Python monthly trending list, and already powers thousands of Reachy Mini robots in production.
uses: Developers and startups building local voice assistants who need to keep data on-premise
Hardware/robotics vendors looking to add LLM-powered voice interfaces via an OpenAI Realtime-compatible protocol
Researchers and engineers experimenting with low-latency dialog systems who want to swap VAD, STT, or TTS components

en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 为编码智能体注入 ADHD：并行发散思维 + 剪枝
zh.what: ADHD 是一个针对编码智能体（如 Claude Code）的技能包，通过树状思维（Tree-of-Thought）架构解决自回归推理中的过早收敛问题。它生成多个隔离的推理进程，在不同认知框架下并行发散，再通过批评者模型评分、聚类、剪枝陷阱并深化幸存分支。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能实现（TypeScript）、文档、基准测试（bench/results.json）、CI 配置和 npm 包（adhd-agent）。核心是并行发散思维引擎，支持设计决策、模糊调试、命名、API 设计等场景。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，构建在 Claude & Codex Agent SDK 之上，依赖 Node.js >=18，通过 npm 分发，支持 CI 和预印本论文。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2705 星（总计 3700），登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 19 名，因其创新的推理架构和神经多样性灵感引发关注，被 The New Stack 报道。
uses: 编码智能体用户：希望提升 Claude Code 等工具在创意和跨学科任务上的表现
开发者：处理设计决策、模糊调试、命名、API 设计等需要多角度思考的问题

en.tag: ADHD skill for coding agents: parallel divergent thinking with pruning
en.what: ADHD is a skill for coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) that addresses premature convergence in autoregressive reasoning via a Tree-of-Thought architecture. It spawns isolated reasoning processes under deliberately distorted cognitive frames, then uses a critic pass to score, cluster, prune traps, and deepen survivors.
en.content: The repo contains the skill implementation (TypeScript), docs, benchmarks (bench/results.json), CI config, and an npm package (adhd-agent). Core is a parallel divergent ideation engine for design decisions, fuzzy debugging, naming, API design, etc.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript on the Claude & Codex Agent SDK, requires Node.js >=18, distributed via npm, with CI and a preprint paper.
en.hot: Gained 2,705 stars this month (3,700 total), ranking #19 on GitHub Trending monthly, due to its novel reasoning architecture and neurodivergence-inspired approach, featured by The New Stack.
uses: Coding agent users: want to boost Claude Code etc. on creative and interdisciplinary tasks
Developers: tackling design decisions, fuzzy debugging, naming, API design needing diverse perspectives
AI researchers: interested in reasoning architectures, tree-of-thought, and premature convergence

en.tag: Lightweight self-hosted Bitwarden server
en.what: Vaultwarden is an alternative lightweight server implementation of Bitwarden, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It enables self-hosted password management on low-resource environments, replacing the official resource-heavy service.
en.content: The repository contains the complete server-side code, supports deployment via Docker, Podman, and others, and provides Web Vault, API, and admin features.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Rocket framework, supports SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL databases, and offers Docker containerization.
en.hot: With 64,210 stars, it's a benchmark in self-hosted password management. Its lightweight, secure, and fully compatible nature attracts users seeking privacy and resource efficiency.
uses: Individual users — self-host password manager on low-end VPS or NAS
Small teams — use Bitwarden features without paid subscription
Privacy enthusiasts — full control over password data, avoiding cloud dependency

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it uses Silero VAD for voice-activity detection and supports local Whisper (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large) and Parakeet V3 models with optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Amid rising privacy concerns and cloud-service costs, Handy's 'fully open-source and fully offline' positioning has resonated strongly with developers, adding nearly 3,000 stars this month to reach 26.7K+ and ranking 17th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — writers and professionals who need local voice input without cloud uploads.
Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: 一站式开发环境管理工具
zh.what: mise 是一个开发工具、环境变量和任务运行器的统一 CLI。它通过一个 mise.toml 文件管理项目工具、环境变量和任务，确保新 shell、检出和 CI 作业从相同的设置开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、演示 GIF 和配置文件。核心功能包括安装和切换数百种开发工具、按项目目录加载环境变量（包括 .env 文件），以及定义和运行构建、测试、lint 和部署任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。支持多种后端，如 npm、pip、go 等，用于安装工具。
zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。
uses: 开发者：需要管理多个项目工具版本和环境的个人开发者
团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files. Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.
en.hot: mise is trending in the Rust community with 258 stars today and 31,926 total. It solves the pain point of dev environment setup by consolidating multiple tools into one CLI, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers: individuals managing multiple project tool versions and environments
Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost
CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的编程语言，让代理少犯错
zh.what: BAML 是一种专为 AI 代理设计的编程语言，它看起来像 TypeScript，但内置了类型安全、运行时类型、静态错误分析等特性，帮助开发者构建更可靠的代理应用。它提供了代理专用的标准库和测试框架，并支持从多种主流语言调用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 BAML 编译器的 Rust 实现、命令行工具（baml）、IDE 插件、Python 包（baml-py）以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 Python 绑定（baml-py），并支持从 TypeScript、Python、Go、C#、Java 等语言调用。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理开发热潮，BAML 提供了更严谨的编程范式，解决了代理开发中常见的错误问题，因此迅速获得关注，近 9000 星且持续增长。
uses: AI 代理开发者，希望用类型安全的方式构建复杂代理逻辑
需要从多种语言调用代理功能的团队，BAML 支持多语言互操作
对代理可靠性要求高的场景，如自动化工作流、智能客服等

en.tag: A programming language for AI agents, designed to reduce agent mistakes
en.what: BAML is a programming language designed specifically for AI agents. It looks like TypeScript but includes type safety, runtime types, static error analysis, and other features to help developers build more reliable agent applications. It provides an agent-specific standard library and testing framework, and can be called from multiple mainstream languages.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust implementation of the BAML compiler, command-line tools (baml), IDE plugins, Python package (baml-py), and documentation/examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings (baml-py), and callable from TypeScript, Python, Go, C#, Java, etc.
en.hot: With the surge in AI agent development, BAML offers a more rigorous programming paradigm that addresses common errors in agent development, quickly gaining attention with nearly 9k stars and growing.
uses: AI agent developers who want to build complex agent logic with type safety
Teams needing to call agent functions from multiple languages, as BAML supports interop
Scenarios requiring high reliability, such as automated workflows and intelligent customer service

zh.tag: MCP 官方 Rust SDK，异步运行时实现
zh.what: 这是 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方 Rust SDK，提供协议实现和工具宏，支持客户端与服务器开发。它实现了最新的 MCP 规范，并保持向后兼容。
zh.content: 包含核心 crate `rmcp` 和过程宏 crate `rmcp-macros`，提供工具、资源、提示、采样、订阅、缓存、任务等功能，支持多种传输方式。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 tokio 异步运行时，依赖 serde 进行序列化，使用 schemars 生成 JSON Schema。
zh.hot: 作为 MCP 官方 SDK，随着 MCP 生态爆发而备受关注，本月新增 180 stars，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 13。
uses: Rust 开发者构建 MCP 客户端或服务器
需要类型安全和异步性能的 AI 工具集成
希望利用官方支持并紧跟 MCP 规范的项目

en.tag: Official Rust SDK for Model Context Protocol with async runtime
en.what: This is the official Rust SDK for the Model Context Protocol, providing protocol implementation and tool macros for both client and server development. It implements the latest MCP spec while maintaining backward compatibility.
en.content: Contains the core crate `rmcp` and procedural macro crate `rmcp-macros`, offering tools, resources, prompts, sampling, subscriptions, caching, tasks, and multiple transports.
en.stack: Built on Rust with tokio async runtime, uses serde for serialization and schemars for JSON Schema generation.
en.hot: As the official MCP SDK, it gains attention with the MCP ecosystem boom, adding 180 stars this month and ranking #13 on Rust trending.
uses: Rust developers building MCP clients or servers
AI tool integration requiring type safety and async performance
Projects wanting official support and up-to-date MCP spec compliance

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的极速 Python 包与项目管理工具
zh.what: uv 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 Python 包和项目管理工具，旨在替代 pip、pip-tools、pipx、poetry、pyenv、twine、virtualenv 等多个工具。它提供统一的锁文件、脚本运行、Python 版本管理等功能，并兼容 pip 接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含 uv 的 Rust 源码、文档、基准测试（BENCHMARKS.md）以及安装脚本，支持通过 curl 或 pip 安装，无需 Rust 或 Python 环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Cargo 构建，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。
zh.hot: uv 因其比 pip 快 10-100 倍的性能而广受关注，star 数已达 88k，本月新增 1485，成为 Rust 月度趋势榜第 20 名。
uses: Python 开发者：需要快速安装和管理依赖，提升开发效率。
项目维护者：使用统一锁文件和项目管理功能，简化多环境配置。
DevOps 工程师：在 CI/CD 中加速依赖安装，减少构建时间。

en.tag: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
en.what: uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust, designed to replace pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, twine, virtualenv, and more. It offers a universal lockfile, script running, Python version management, and a pip-compatible interface.
en.content: The repository contains uv's Rust source code, documentation, benchmarks (BENCHMARKS.md), and installation scripts, installable via curl or pip without requiring Rust or Python.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, built with Cargo, and supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: uv gains attention for being 10-100x faster than pip, with 88k stars and 1,485 new stars this month, ranking 20th on the Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Python developers: need fast dependency installation and management to boost productivity.
Project maintainers: use universal lockfile and project management to simplify multi-environment setups.
DevOps engineers: accelerate dependency installation in CI/CD pipelines to reduce build times.

zh.tag: 用 SQLite 和加密同步重塑 shell 历史记录
zh.what: Atuin 将 shell 历史记录存储在 SQLite 数据库中，并记录命令的额外上下文（如退出码、时长、目录等）。它提供全屏搜索界面，并支持跨机器加密同步历史记录。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的命令行工具、可选的同步服务器、文档和演示。核心功能包括重新绑定 ctrl-r 和上箭头以打开搜索界面，以及通过 Atuin 服务器进行加密同步。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 SQLite 数据库，支持多种 shell（如 bash、zsh、fish）。
zh.hot: 31k+ 星标，本月新增 740，因其显著提升命令行效率而广受开发者喜爱。
uses: 开发者：想要更高效地搜索和复用历史命令。
多设备用户：需要在不同机器间同步 shell 历史。
安全敏感者：希望历史记录加密存储。

en.tag: Replace shell history with SQLite and encrypted sync
en.what: Atuin stores shell history in a SQLite database and records additional context for commands, such as exit code, duration, and directory. It provides a full-screen search UI and optional encrypted synchronization of history across machines.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust CLI tool, an optional sync server, documentation, and demos. Key features include rebinding ctrl-r and up arrow to a search UI, and encrypted sync via an Atuin server.
en.stack: Written in Rust, uses SQLite database, supports multiple shells like bash, zsh, and fish.
en.hot: With 31k+ stars and 740 added this month, it's popular for significantly boosting command-line productivity.
uses: Developers who want to search and reuse command history more efficiently.
Users with multiple machines who need to sync shell history.
Security-conscious users who want encrypted history storage.

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需配置。它允许用户完全控制自己的数据，支持自建中继/中转服务器，是 TeamViewer 的隐私友好替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端和服务器端代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。提供二进制下载、Docker 构建方式，以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: 多服务器构建与部署平台
zh.what: Komodo 是一个开源的 DevOps 平台，用于在多个服务器上构建和部署软件。它提供统一的界面来管理服务器、部署应用、监控状态，并支持自动化操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、截图（亮色/暗色主题）、演示链接和构建服务器链接。主要组件包括核心服务、外围代理（periphery）和 Web 界面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，可能涉及 Web 框架（如 Actix-web）、数据库（如 PostgreSQL）和前端技术（如 React）。
zh.hot: 随着多服务器管理和自动化部署需求的增长，Komodo 提供了免费开源的解决方案，吸引了大量开发者。其 star 数接近 1.2 万，今日新增 19，持续受到关注。
uses: DevOps 工程师：需要跨多服务器管理部署和监控。
小型团队：希望自托管部署平台，避免云服务成本。
开发者：想要自动化构建和部署流程，提高效率。

en.tag: Build and deploy software across many servers
en.what: Komodo is an open-source DevOps platform for building and deploying software across many servers. It provides a unified interface to manage servers, deploy applications, monitor status, and automate operations.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, screenshots (light/dark themes), demo links, and build server links. Main components include core services, periphery agents, and a web UI.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, likely using web frameworks (e.g., Actix-web), databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), and frontend technologies (e.g., React).
en.hot: With the growing need for multi-server management and automated deployment, Komodo offers a free open-source solution, attracting many developers. Its star count is nearly 12k, with 19 new stars today, maintaining steady attention.
uses: DevOps engineers: need to manage deployments and monitoring across multiple servers.
Small teams: want a self-hosted deployment platform to avoid cloud costs.
Developers: looking to automate build and deployment processes for efficiency.

zh.tag: 数据中心级分布式推理服务编排层
zh.what: Dynamo 是一个开源的数据中心级推理服务框架，作为推理引擎（如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、vLLM）之上的编排层，将它们整合为协调的多节点推理系统。它通过分离式服务、智能路由、多级 KV 缓存和自动扩展，最大化吞吐量并最小化延迟，适用于 LLM、推理、多模态和视频生成等负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心、Python 扩展、文档、示例、recipes 和容器镜像，并提供设计提案和社区贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 实现高性能，Python 提供可扩展性；依赖推理引擎如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM 和 vLLM。
zh.hot: 本月新增 285 星，总星数 7813，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust）月榜第 20 名。作为 NVIDIA 支持的开源项目，它填补了推理引擎之上的编排层空白，吸引大量关注。
uses: AI 基础设施团队：构建大规模多节点推理服务，优化 GPU 利用率和成本。
模型部署工程师：需要为 LLM、多模态或视频生成模型设计高吞吐、低延迟的服务架构。
平台开发者：希望扩展或定制推理编排逻辑，利用 Rust 和 Python 的混合开发。
研究与实验：在数据中心规模下测试分离式推理、KV 缓存等先进技术。

en.tag: Datacenter-scale distributed inference serving orchestration layer
en.what: Dynamo is an open-source, datacenter-scale inference serving framework that acts as an orchestration layer above inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, turning them into a coordinated multi-node inference system. It uses disaggregated serving, intelligent routing, multi-tier KV caching, and automatic scaling to maximize throughput and minimize latency for LLM, reasoning, multimodal, and video generation workloads.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust core, Python extensions, documentation, examples, recipes, and container images, along with design proposals and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility; relies on inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM.
en.hot: With 285 stars added this month and 7,813 total, it ranks #20 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly. As an NVIDIA-backed open-source project, it fills the orchestration gap above inference engines, drawing significant attention.
uses: AI infrastructure teams: building large-scale multi-node inference services to optimize GPU utilization and cost.
Model deployment engineers: designing high-throughput, low-latency serving architectures for LLMs, multimodal, or video generation models.
Platform developers: extending or customizing inference orchestration logic with Rust and Python.
Research and experimentation: testing advanced techniques like disaggregated serving and KV caching at datacenter scale.

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建更小、更快、更安全的桌面与移动应用
zh.what: Tauri 是一个用于构建跨平台桌面和移动应用的框架，前端使用任何可编译为 HTML/JS/CSS 的框架，后端采用 Rust 编写的二进制核心。它通过系统 WebView 渲染界面，相比 Electron 体积更小、内存占用更低、安全性更高。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tauri 框架的核心代码、架构文档（ARCHITECTURE.md）、示例应用以及构建工具链。核心组件包括窗口处理库 tao 和 WebView 统一接口 wry，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux、Android 和 iOS。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，前端无关，支持任意编译为 HTML/JS/CSS 的框架。依赖 tao 处理窗口，WRY 提供系统 WebView 统一接口，并内置打包器、自动更新、系统托盘等功能。
zh.hot: Tauri 作为 Electron 的轻量级替代方案持续受到关注，本月新增 1372 星，总星数超 11 万，稳居 Rust 趋势榜前列。其强调的小体积、高性能和安全性吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 希望用 Web 技术构建桌面应用但追求更小安装包和更低内存占用的开发者
需要跨平台（桌面+移动）统一开发的团队，可复用前端代码
对安全性有高要求，希望减少攻击面的应用场景
想要利用 Rust 后端性能优势的前端开发者

en.tag: Build smaller, faster, and more secure desktop and mobile apps with web frontends
en.what: Tauri is a framework for building cross-platform desktop and mobile applications with a web frontend and a Rust backend. It leverages the system webview for rendering, resulting in smaller binaries, lower memory usage, and enhanced security compared to Electron.
en.content: The repository contains the core framework code, architecture documentation, sample apps, and build tooling. Key components include the windowing library tao and the webview abstraction wry, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, and iOS.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, frontend-agnostic, supporting any framework that compiles to HTML/JS/CSS. Uses tao for windowing and WRY for a unified system webview interface, with built-in bundler, auto-updater, and system tray support.
en.hot: Tauri continues to gain traction as a lightweight Electron alternative, adding 1,372 stars this month and surpassing 110k total, ranking high on the Rust trending list. Its emphasis on small size, performance, and security attracts many developers.
uses: Developers who want to build desktop apps with web tech but seek smaller bundles and lower memory usage
Teams needing cross-platform (desktop + mobile) development with reusable frontend code
Use cases with high security requirements, aiming to reduce attack surface
Frontend developers who want to leverage Rust backend performance

zh.tag: AI 工程化开源控制平面，编排跨工具工作流
zh.what: SuperPlane 是一个面向 AI 驱动工程的开源自动化引擎，用于编排跨 Git、LLM、CI/CD、可观测性等工具的工作流。它提供持久执行、审批和操作 UI，确保人类与 AI 安全地交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎（Go 编写）、命令行工具、文档和示例。核心概念包括应用（Apps）、画布（Canvases）、组件（Components）和事件驱动编排，支持自托管或使用云服务。

AI app developers: add human approvals and policy checks to agents for controlled execution.

en.tag: A distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents with persistent structured memory
en.what: Beads is a distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents, providing persistent structured memory. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, helping agents handle long-horizon tasks without losing context.

en.hot: Gaining 95 stars daily, total 25601, ranking #11 on Go daily trending. The demand for persistent memory in AI coding agents is high, and Beads addresses it with a lightweight CLI and distributed graph approach.

Developers using Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc. — integrate Beads to improve long-horizon task handling
Team collaboration — multiple agents sync work status and dependency graph via Dolt

zh.tag: 电话号OSINT信息收集框架
zh.what: PhoneInfoga 是一个用于扫描国际电话号码的信息收集框架，可获取国家、地区、运营商和线路类型等基本信息，并利用多种技术尝试查找 VoIP 提供商或识别机主。它通过可配置的扫描器集合工作，旨在辅助调查而非自动化一切。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心框架、命令行界面、Web 图形界面以及 REST API 文档，支持通过外部 API、电话簿和搜索引擎进行 OSINT 足迹收集，并检查信誉报告、社交媒体和一次性号码等。

调查记者验证电话号码相关信息
渗透测试人员辅助社会工程学攻击前侦察
普通用户查询陌生号码的基本信息

en.tag: OSINT framework for phone number reconnaissance
en.what: PhoneInfoga is an information gathering framework for scanning international phone numbers, providing basic details like country, area, carrier, and line type, and using various techniques to find VoIP providers or identify owners. It works with a collection of configurable scanners to assist investigations, not fully automate them.
en.content: The repository includes a Go-based core framework, CLI, web GUI, and REST API docs, enabling OSINT footprinting via external APIs, phone books, and search engines, plus checks for reputation reports, social media, and disposable numbers.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, offering a REST API and Go modules for programmatic use, with Docker support and Swagger documentation.

Investigative journalists verifying phone-related information
Penetration testers for pre-engagement reconnaissance
General users looking up basic info on unknown numbers

zh.tag: 云原生应用代理，自动发现服务并动态配置路由
zh.what: Traefik 是一个现代 HTTP 反向代理和负载均衡器，旨在简化微服务的部署。它能够与 Docker、Kubernetes 等基础设施组件集成，自动且动态地配置自身，无需手动维护路由规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Traefik 的源代码、文档、示例配置以及 Web UI 资源。主要目录包括 docs（文档）、pkg（核心代码）、cmd（入口命令）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种后端集成库（如 Docker、Kubernetes、Consul 等），并支持 ACME 自动 HTTPS 证书。

uses: 微服务架构中作为入口网关，自动路由到 Docker/Kubernetes 等服务
需要动态更新路由规则的场景，如频繁扩缩容或服务变更
希望简化 HTTPS 证书管理的开发者，利用内置 ACME 自动签发证书
边缘代理或 API 网关，支持多种协议和中间件

en.tag: Cloud-native application proxy with automatic service discovery and dynamic routing
en.what: Traefik is a modern HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer that simplifies microservices deployment. It integrates with infrastructure components like Docker and Kubernetes, automatically and dynamically configuring itself without manual route management.
en.content: The repository contains Traefik's source code, documentation, example configurations, and Web UI assets. Key directories include docs, pkg (core code), and cmd (entry commands).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with integrations for various backends (Docker, Kubernetes, Consul, etc.) and support for automatic HTTPS via ACME.
en.hot: With 64k+ stars, it's one of the most popular reverse proxies in cloud-native. Its automatic service discovery and dynamic configuration greatly simplify microservice routing, keeping it in the spotlight.
uses: As an ingress gateway in microservices, automatically routing to services in Docker/Kubernetes
Scenarios needing dynamic route updates, such as frequent scaling or service changes
Developers wanting simplified HTTPS management with built-in ACME auto-certificates
Edge proxy or API gateway supporting multiple protocols and middleware

zh.tag: 免费开源自托管网页文件管理器

小型团队：内部文件共享与协作，支持用户权限控制。
开发者：快速部署文件管理服务，集成到现有系统或作为独立工具。

NAS users: replace traditional file management interface with a more modern and feature-rich web UI.

zh.tag: 默认 HTTPS 的极速可扩展 Web 服务器
zh.what: Caddy 是一个快速、可扩展、跨平台的 Web 服务器，支持 HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3，并默认启用 TLS，自动为站点配置 HTTPS 证书。它旨在让 HTTPS 成为每个网站的默认配置，简化部署和运维。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Caddy 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置和构建脚本。核心是一个基于 Go 的模块化服务器，通过 Caddyfile 或 JSON 配置，支持丰富的插件和中间件。

uses: 个人开发者或小团队快速部署静态网站或反向代理，无需手动配置证书
需要自动 HTTPS 和 HTTP/3 支持的生产环境 Web 服务器
作为微服务或容器化应用的反向代理和负载均衡器
学习和研究 Go 语言高性能服务器开发的参考项目

Production web servers requiring automatic HTTPS and HTTP/3 support
Reverse proxy and load balancer for microservices or containerized applications
Reference project for learning high-performance server development in Go

en.tag: Comprehensive Kubernetes security platform from dev to runtime
en.what: Kubescape is an open-source Kubernetes security platform covering IDE, CI/CD pipelines, and clusters, offering risk analysis, security compliance, and misconfiguration scanning. It saves Kubernetes users and administrators time, effort, and resources.

Learning & research — study API gateway and multi-account load balancing

zh.tag: 一键追溯进程/端口/容器/文件来源的 CLI+TUI 工具
zh.what: witr 是一个命令行工具，用于回答“为什么这个在运行？”的问题。它能追溯进程、端口、容器或文件是由谁启动的，并展示完整的启动链，如 systemd → PM2 → node。支持 CLI 输出、机器可读 JSON 和交互式 TUI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 和 TUI 程序，提供安装脚本、文档和浏览器演示。核心功能是解析进程树、服务管理器、容器和文件系统，生成因果链。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖系统工具如 ps、lsof、ss、systemctl、docker 等来收集信息。支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 和 FreeBSD。
zh.hot: 解决了开发者常遇到的“这个进程/端口是谁启动的”痛点，提供直观的因果链展示，且支持多平台和多种包管理器，上线后迅速获得近 2 万星。
uses: 系统管理员排查异常进程或端口占用，快速定位源头。
开发者在容器或微服务环境中追踪服务启动链，便于调试。
安全分析师调查可疑进程或文件来源，辅助取证。
DevOps 工程师理解系统启动流程，优化服务管理。

en.tag: Trace any process, port, container, or file back to its origin with CLI+TUI
en.what: witr is a CLI tool that answers 'Why is this running?' by tracing any process, port, container, or file back to the exact chain that started it, such as systemd → PM2 → node. It offers CLI output, machine-readable JSON, and an interactive TUI.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI and TUI program, along with installation scripts, documentation, and a browser demo. It parses process trees, service managers, containers, and file systems to generate causal chains.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it leverages system utilities like ps, lsof, ss, systemctl, and docker to gather information. Supports Linux, macOS, Windows, and FreeBSD.
en.hot: It solves the common pain point of 'who started this process/port' with intuitive causal chain visualization, multi-platform support, and multiple package managers, quickly gaining nearly 20k stars.
uses: System admins investigating abnormal processes or port usage to quickly locate the source.
Developers tracing service startup chains in container or microservice environments for debugging.
Security analysts investigating suspicious processes or file origins for forensics.
DevOps engineers understanding system startup flows to optimize service management.

开发者：作为库集成到自己的项目中，或使用其 API 构建自定义流媒体应用。

en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging the Pion WebRTC library, FFmpeg for transcoding, and supporting various streaming protocols.
en.hot: With zero-latency, multi-protocol support, and easy integration, go2rtc is popular in smart home and security domains, gaining 455 stars this month and reaching 13,870 total.

Developers: embed as a library or use its API to build custom streaming apps.
Security surveillance: scenarios requiring low-latency, multi-protocol camera streams.

zh.tag: Cloudflare 官方内网穿透客户端，安全暴露本地服务
zh.what: cloudflared 是 Cloudflare Tunnel 的命令行客户端，通过守护进程将 Cloudflare 网络与你的源站（如 Web 服务器）连接起来。它允许 Cloudflare 将客户端请求转发到你的源站，而无需在防火墙上开放端口，保持源站尽可能封闭。
zh.content: 仓库包含 cloudflared 的源代码、构建脚本和文档，支持通过命令行管理隧道，包括创建、运行和访问隧道，以及用于 Layer 4 流量（如 SSH、RDP）的访问控制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Cloudflare 的 API 和协议，支持多种安装方式（二进制、Docker、Debian、RPM、Homebrew）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 439 星，总星数 15285，位列 Go 月榜第 19。作为 Cloudflare 官方工具，它提供免费且安全的隧道方案，深受开发者喜爱。
uses: 开发者：无需公网 IP 即可将本地 Web 服务暴露到互联网，适合演示或测试。
运维人员：通过 Cloudflare 网络保护源站，避免直接暴露端口，增强安全性。
远程访问：通过 Layer 4 隧道安全访问内网 SSH、RDP 等服务。
企业用户：利用 Cloudflare 的全球网络加速和防护，替代传统 VPN 或端口转发。

en.tag: Cloudflare's official tunnel client for secure local service exposure
en.what: cloudflared is the command-line client for Cloudflare Tunnel, a daemon that connects the Cloudflare network to your origin (e.g., a web server). It allows Cloudflare to forward client requests to your origin without opening firewall ports, keeping your origin as closed as possible.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build scripts, and documentation for cloudflared, supporting tunnel management via CLI, including creating, running, and accessing tunnels, as well as access control for Layer 4 traffic (e.g., SSH, RDP).
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging Cloudflare's APIs and protocols, with multiple installation methods (binaries, Docker, Debian, RPM, Homebrew).
en.hot: Gained 439 stars this month, total 15,285, ranking 19th on the Go monthly list. As an official Cloudflare tool, it offers a free and secure tunneling solution, popular among developers.
uses: Developers: Expose local web services to the internet without a public IP, ideal for demos or testing.
Ops: Protect origins via Cloudflare network, avoiding direct port exposure for enhanced security.
Remote access: Securely access internal SSH, RDP, etc., via Layer 4 tunnels.
Enterprises: Leverage Cloudflare's global network for acceleration and protection, replacing traditional VPN or port forwarding.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 的包管理器，像 apt/yum 一样管理应用

zh.tag: 高颜值现代化终端文件管理器

需要跨平台文件管理工具的用户，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的零配置安全组网与远程访问基础设施
zh.what: Tailscale 基于 WireGuard 协议构建安全的虚拟专用网络，让用户无需公网 IP 或端口转发即可将设备组成私有网络。它集成了身份验证和两因素认证（2FA），简化了团队和设备之间的安全远程访问与内网穿透。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含 tailscaled 守护进程与 tailscale 命令行工具的核心源码，覆盖 Linux、Windows、macOS 及 BSD 系统的网络栈与控制逻辑。移动端 App 的底层网络库亦来源于此，但各平台 GUI 包装代码位于其他独立仓库。
zh.stack: 项目以 Go 语言为主开发，要求使用最新版 Go 1.26 编译，并基于 WireGuard 协议实现加密通信。构建脚本 `build_dist.sh` 用于将版本信息嵌入二进制，支持多种 Linux 发行版及跨平台打包。
zh.hot: 凭借“零配置”即可在任意设备间建立加密组网的能力，Tailscale 已成为远程办公和云原生时代的核心网络工具，GitHub 累计获得 34k+ Stars，本周再以 583 新增 Star 登上 Go 语言 Trending 榜第 2 名。
uses: 远程办公团队 —— 无需公网 IP 即可安全访问公司内网与私有云资源
开发运维人员 —— 快速搭建跨云、跨地域的容器与服务器调试网络
个人技术爱好者 —— 将家庭 NAS、树莓派等设备组成加密私有网络
安全合规企业 —— 基于 SSO/2FA 的零信任网络替代传统 VPN 方案

en.tag: Zero-config WireGuard VPN for secure remote access and private networking
en.what: Tailscale builds secure virtual private networks on top of WireGuard, allowing devices to form a private mesh network without public IPs or port forwarding. It integrates identity-based authentication and two-factor authentication (2FA) to simplify secure remote access and intranet penetration for teams and devices.
en.content: The repository primarily contains the core source code for the `tailscaled` daemon and the `tailscale` CLI tool, covering the networking stack and control logic for Linux, Windows, macOS, and BSD systems. It also serves as the underlying network library for mobile apps, while platform-specific GUI wrappers reside in separate repositories.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go and requiring the latest Go 1.26 release, it implements encrypted communication over the WireGuard protocol. The `build_dist.sh` script embeds version metadata into binaries, supporting packaging for multiple Linux distributions and cross-platform deployments.
en.hot: Its "zero-config" approach to encrypted mesh networking across any device has made it an essential tool for remote work and cloud-native environments. With over 34k total stars and 583 new stars this week, it ranks #2 on GitHub's Go Trending chart, reflecting strong community traction.
uses: Remote teams — Securely access corporate intranets and private cloud resources without public IPs
DevOps engineers — Quickly build debug networks across multi-cloud and multi-region servers and containers
Homelab enthusiasts — Encrypt and interconnect personal devices like NAS and Raspberry Pi into a private mesh
Security-focused enterprises — Replace legacy VPNs with zero-trust networking based on SSO and 2FA

zh.tag: 无守护进程的容器与 Pod 管理工具
zh.what: Podman 是一个用于管理 OCI 容器、镜像、卷和 Pod 的工具，无需守护进程即可运行，兼容 Docker CLI。它基于 libpod 库，提供完整的容器生命周期管理 API，支持 Linux、Mac 和 Windows（通过虚拟机）。

en.tag: Daemonless container and pod management tool
en.what: Podman is a tool for managing OCI containers, images, volumes, and pods without a daemon, compatible with the Docker CLI. It is based on the libpod library, offering APIs for full container lifecycle management, and runs on Linux, Mac, and Windows via a VM.

en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on OCI runtimes (e.g., runc), conmon, and supporting multiple container image formats.
en.hot: As a daemonless alternative to Docker, Podman gains significant attention, adding 389 stars this month, reaching 32,646 total, ranking #21 on the Go trending list.
uses: System administrators: need a daemonless, more secure container management environment
Developers: run containers locally or in CI, compatible with Docker CLI
Kubernetes users: generate and debug Pod manifests with Podman

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台

高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production.
